## Project inputs and execution

Keep this complete R Markdown document in the project root. Supply the original
HMM CSV, three smart-scale BW CSVs and BW workbook, GreenFeed workbooks and
annual steer CSVs, and GIS shapefiles in the YAML input directories. No input
data are included with this revision. Knitting runs all chunks in order in one
environment. For interactive RStudio use, run the shared runtime and analysis
setup chunks first, followed by the data chunks required by the selected result.

Relative paths are resolved from the document/project working directory. Change
YAML `params` or pass a named `params` list to `rmarkdown::render()`; the runtime
chunk also provides these defaults when run interactively. `export_results:
false` computes results without writing the final export collection.

The workflow retains the revised HMM/GPS Sections 1–5.5, then runs BW,
GreenFeed, integrated spatial and two-scale questions, retained Gaussian LMM
inference, publication tables, and the final map inventory. A monthly behavior
question and a whole-season productivity question have different observation
units; their results are not substituted for one another. Whole-season occupied
area is computed directly from pooled season GPS fixes, never by adding period
areas. Three spatial denominators remain distinct: all-pasture period area,
inside-RGP period area, and independent whole-season occupied area.

Repeated animal observations do not provide independent pasture-level treatment
replication. Model tables retain the actual model sample size and design audit.
Management comparisons in this six-pasture design must be read with the stated
exploratory-inference limitation. Significant Shapiro–Wilk tests and singular
fits are reported alongside visual and convergence checks; neither automatically
changes a model or removes its experimental grouping factors.

The latest requested specifications use random Year and physical Pasture
intercepts for both season and period responses. Period models retain TRT × SR
and add Period as a main effect: `TRT * SR + Period`. Global GreenFeed uses
`TRT * SR + RotationPeriod` with random Year and Pasture. No management-by-period
interaction, additional pasture-year intercept, or animal intercept is fitted.
Management differences are assumed constant across periods; correlation within
repeated units beyond Year/Pasture clustering remains a stated limitation. The
Global GreenFeed F specification matches its primary model, so it reuses that fit.
The protected baseline models and initial-weight-adjusted final-weight ANCOVA
retain their previous formulas.

All final output is under `params$output_dir`:

```text
Chapter_2_Results/
├── 01_Grazing_Behavior_Spatial_Aera/
│   ├── 01_Tables/
│   ├── 02_Model_Results/
│   ├── 03_Figures/
│   ├── 04_Maps/                  # behavior, area, and integrated metric maps
│   └── 05_Spatial_Data/
├── 02_Grazing_BW_AFRI/
├── 03_Grazing_GreenFeed_AFRI/
├── 05_Two_Scale_Analysis_maps/   # distinct conditional/two-scale questions
└── 06_Statistical_Analysis/
```

The user-requested two-scale root is a sibling of the behavior/spatial, BW,
GreenFeed, and statistical folders. It retains unique two-scale tables, model
results, figures, maps, and spatial datasets in their existing numbered
subfolders. Behavior, active-area, and integrated metric maps remain under
`01_Grazing_Behavior_Spatial_Aera/04_Maps`.

Subdirectories are created by their actual output writers; existing obsolete
folders are left untouched. See the accompanying audit for files, ownership,
model questions, changes to the reference integration, and validation limits.

```{r shared-runtime, include=FALSE}

  greenfeed_data_dir = "GreenFeed_input",
  gis_data_dir = "GIS_input",
  output_dir = "Chapter_2_Results",
  maroto_grid_m = 10,
  active_cell_min_grazing_fixes = 1,

  gf_min_period_sampling_days = NULL
)
if (!exists("params", inherits = FALSE) || is.null(params)) {
  params <- afri_param_defaults
} else {

  params <- utils::modifyList(afri_param_defaults, params)
}

afri_required_packages <- c(

  "lme4", "lmerTest", "emmeans", "car", "multcomp", "multcompView",

]

}
# Optional ragg improves PNG export; pbkrtest enables Kenward-Roger inference.
# No packages are installed and no working directory is changed during knitting.
afri_run_started <- Sys.time()
set.seed(20261008)  # Reproducible simulated reference diagnostics, not model selection.
afri_report_figure_path <- function(prefix) {
  file.path(tempdir(), "afri-report-figures", paste0(prefix, "-"))
}
# Report-only graphics stay separate from the single final export for each plot.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = afri_report_figure_path("hmm"))

if (!exists("afri_model_registry", inherits = FALSE)) {
  afri_model_registry <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  afri_inference_registry <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  afri_diagnostic_registry <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  afri_reference_test_registry <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
}
afri_model_signature <- function(model) {
  digest::digest(list(formula = deparse(stats::formula(model)),
                      frame = stats::model.frame(model),
                      REML = lme4::isREML(model)), algo = "xxhash64")
}
afri_reference_anova <- function(model) {
  # Preserve the reference sections' existing car Type III tests exactly.
  key <- afri_model_signature(model)
  if (!exists(key, envir = afri_reference_test_registry, inherits = FALSE)) {
    assign(key, car::Anova(model, type = 3), afri_reference_test_registry)
  }
  get(key, afri_reference_test_registry, inherits = FALSE)
}
afri_shapiro <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 3L || n > 5000L || length(unique(x)) < 2L) {
    reason <- if (n < 3L) "fewer than 3 finite residuals" else if (n > 5000L) {
      "more than 5000 finite residuals; full-residual Shapiro-Wilk not applicable"
    } else "constant residuals"
    return(structure(list(statistic = c(W = NA_real_), p.value = NA_real_,
                          method = paste("Shapiro-Wilk not run:", reason),
                          data.name = "finite model residuals"), class = "htest"))
  }
  stats::shapiro.test(x)
}
afri_fit_lmm <- function(formula, data, question_id, REML = FALSE) {
  stopifnot(is.character(question_id), length(question_id) == 1L,
            nzchar(question_id), inherits(formula, "formula"))
  local_data <- as.data.frame(data)
  # Sum contrasts make Type III main effects refer to marginal factorial effects.
  for (nm in intersect(c("TRT", "SR", "Period", "RGP", "RotationPeriod", "YearFactor"), all.vars(formula))) {
    if (nm %in% names(local_data)) {
      local_data[[nm]] <- droplevels(factor(local_data[[nm]]))
      if (nlevels(local_data[[nm]]) > 1L) {
        contrasts(local_data[[nm]]) <- stats::contr.sum(nlevels(local_data[[nm]]))
      }
    }
  }
  candidate_frame <- stats::model.frame(lme4::subbars(formula),
                                        data = local_data, na.action = stats::na.omit)
  signature <- digest::digest(list(formula = deparse(formula),
                                   frame = candidate_frame, REML = REML),
                              algo = "xxhash64")
  if (exists(question_id, afri_model_registry, inherits = FALSE)) {
    entry <- get(question_id, afri_model_registry, inherits = FALSE)
    if (!identical(entry$input_signature, signature)) {
      stop("Conflicting model or data for retained question '", question_id,
           "'. Use a separately documented sensitivity question or reuse its model.")
    }
    return(entry$model)
  }
  fit_warnings <- character()
  model <- withCallingHandlers(
    lme4::lmer(formula, data = local_data, REML = REML, na.action = stats::na.omit),
    warning = function(w) fit_warnings <<- unique(c(fit_warnings, conditionMessage(w)))
  )
  model <- withCallingHandlers(
    lmerTest::as_lmerModLmerTest(model),
    warning = function(w) fit_warnings <<- unique(c(fit_warnings, conditionMessage(w)))
  )
  attr(model, "afri_model_id") <- question_id
  attr(model, "afri_fit_warnings") <- fit_warnings
  assign(question_id, list(model = model, input_signature = signature,
                            question_id = question_id, warnings = fit_warnings),
         afri_model_registry)
  model
}
afri_register_existing <- function(model, question_id) {
  # Aliasing an existing fitted model never fits a replacement model.
  if (exists(question_id, afri_model_registry, inherits = FALSE)) {
    previous <- get(question_id, afri_model_registry, inherits = FALSE)$model
    if (!identical(afri_model_signature(previous), afri_model_signature(model))) {
      stop("Conflicting existing fit for ", question_id)
    }
    return(invisible(previous))
  }
  assign(question_id, list(model = model, input_signature = NULL,
                            question_id = question_id, warnings = character()),
         afri_model_registry)
  invisible(model)
}
afri_inference <- function(model, emm_specs = ~ TRT * SR) {
  stopifnot(inherits(model, "lmerMod"))
  key <- paste(afri_model_signature(model),
               digest::digest(deparse(emm_specs), algo = "xxhash64"), sep = "_")
  if (exists(key, afri_inference_registry, inherits = FALSE)) {
    return(get(key, afri_inference_registry, inherits = FALSE))
  }
  inference_model <- if (inherits(model, "lmerModLmerTest")) model else {
    lmerTest::as_lmerModLmerTest(model)
  }
  kr <- lme4::isREML(model) && stats::nobs(model) <= 3000L &&
    requireNamespace("pbkrtest", quietly = TRUE)
  method <- if (kr) "Kenward-Roger" else "Satterthwaite"
  tab <- as.data.frame(stats::anova(inference_model, type = 3, ddf = method))
  pick_numeric <- function(candidates) {
    nm <- intersect(candidates, names(tab))
    if (!length(nm)) rep(NA_real_, nrow(tab)) else as.numeric(tab[[nm[1L]]])
  }
  anova <- data.frame(term = rownames(tab),
                       F_value = pick_numeric(c("F value", "F.value")),
                       NumDF = pick_numeric(c("NumDF")),
                       DenDF = pick_numeric(c("DenDF")),
                       p.value = pick_numeric(c("Pr(>F)")), row.names = NULL)
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(inference_model, specs = emm_specs,
                           lmer.df = tolower(method),
                           pbkrtest.limit = 3000L, lmerTest.limit = Inf)
  pairs <- as.data.frame(emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "pairwise", adjust = "tukey"))
  cld_error <- NA_character_
  cld <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(multcomp::cld(emm, Letters = letters,
                                             adjust = "tukey", sort = FALSE)),
                  error = function(e) {
                    cld_error <<- conditionMessage(e)
                    data.frame()
                  })
  output <- list(anova = anova, emm = emm, emmeans = as.data.frame(emm),
                  pairs = pairs, contrasts = pairs, cld = cld,
                  cld_status = if (is.na(cld_error)) "computed" else cld_error,
                  df_method = method,
                  df_reason = if (kr) "REML fit; n <= 3000; pbkrtest available" else {
                    "ML fit, size limit, or pbkrtest unavailable; no model refit"
                  })
  assign(key, output, afri_inference_registry)
  output
}
afri_diagnose_lmm <- function(model, model_id, existing_shapiro = NULL) {
  key <- afri_model_signature(model)
  if (exists(key, afri_diagnostic_registry, inherits = FALSE)) {
    result <- get(key, afri_diagnostic_registry, inherits = FALSE)
    result$summary$model_id <- model_id
    return(result)
  }
  residual <- as.numeric(stats::residuals(model))
  fitted <- as.numeric(stats::fitted(model))
  standardized <- residual / stats::sigma(model)
  shapiro <- if (is.null(existing_shapiro)) afri_shapiro(standardized) else existing_shapiro
  convergence <- unique(c(unlist(model@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages),
                           attr(model, "afri_fit_warnings")))
  optimizer_code <- unlist(model@optinfo$conv$opt)
  dropped_columns <- attr(lme4::getME(model, "X"), "col.dropped")
  if (length(optimizer_code) && any(optimizer_code != 0L)) {
    convergence <- unique(c(convergence, paste("Optimizer code:",
                                               paste(optimizer_code, collapse = ","))))
  }
  residual_data <- data.frame(fitted = fitted, residual = residual,
                               standardized = standardized,
                               sqrt_abs_standardized = sqrt(abs(standardized)))
  frame <- stats::model.frame(model)
  variance_groups <- intersect(c("TRT", "SR", "Period", "RGP", "RotationPeriod", "Year", "YearFactor"), names(frame))
  variance_review <- do.call(rbind, lapply(variance_groups, function(nm) {
    parts <- split(residual, frame[[nm]], drop = TRUE)
    data.frame(grouping = nm, level = names(parts),
                 n = lengths(parts),
                 residual_sd = vapply(parts, stats::sd, numeric(1)), row.names = NULL)
  }))
  if (is.null(variance_review)) variance_review <- data.frame()
  residual_fitted <- ggplot2::ggplot(residual_data, ggplot2::aes(fitted, standardized)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.35) + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Fitted value", y = "Standardized conditional residual",
                    title = model_id) + ggplot2::theme_bw()
  qq <- ggplot2::ggplot(residual_data, ggplot2::aes(sample = standardized)) +
    ggplot2::stat_qq() + ggplot2::stat_qq_line() + ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste(model_id, "residual Q-Q"))
  scale_location <- ggplot2::ggplot(residual_data,
                                    ggplot2::aes(fitted, sqrt_abs_standardized)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.35) + ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Fitted value", y = "sqrt(abs(standardized residual))",
                    title = paste(model_id, "residual variance review"))
  summary <- data.frame(
    model_id = model_id, n = stats::nobs(model),
    shapiro_W = unname(shapiro$statistic), shapiro_p = shapiro$p.value,
    shapiro_status = shapiro$method,
    singular = lme4::isSingular(model, tol = 1e-4),
    n_dropped_fixed_columns = length(dropped_columns),
    dropped_fixed_columns = if (length(dropped_columns)) {
      paste(names(dropped_columns), collapse = " | ")
    } else "None",
    convergence = if (length(convergence)) paste(convergence, collapse = " | ") else "OK",
    heteroscedasticity_note = paste(
      "Review residual-fitted and scale-location plots and residual SD by group.",
      "No automatic model change follows Shapiro significance or singularity."
    )
  )
  result <- list(summary = summary, residuals = residual_data,
                  plots = list(residual_fitted = residual_fitted, qq = qq,
                               scale_location = scale_location),
                  variances = as.data.frame(lme4::VarCorr(model)),
                  variance_review = variance_review)
  assign(key, result, afri_diagnostic_registry)
  result
}
```

# 1. HMM_AFRI_IDEAS_VF


## 1. Reproducibility, Data Import, and Preparation

This report organizes the complete HMM results workflow into five reproducible
sections: data preparation, movement analysis, behavioral time-budget analysis,
spatial analysis, and centralized export. File locations can be changed in the
YAML `params` block without editing the analysis code.

### 1.1 Analysis Environment

#### 1.1.1 Load Required Packages and Set Global Options

```{r hmm-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Core data management and graphics
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

# Statistical models, inference, and diagnostics
library(lme4)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
library(DHARMa)

# Spatial analysis and file export
library(sf)
library(openxlsx)

# Report generation
library(knitr)

# Keep interactive select() calls on dplyr when model packages attach MASS.
select <- dplyr::select

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dev = "svg"
)

# Robust PNG device used for files explicitly exported as PNG.
safe_png_device <- function(filename, width = 7, height = 7,
                            units = "in", res = 300,
                            bg = "white", ...) {
  if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) {
    ragg::agg_png(
      filename = filename,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      units = units,
      res = res,
      background = bg
    )
  } else if (capabilities("cairo")) {
    grDevices::png(
      filename = filename,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      units = units,
      res = res,
      bg = bg,
      type = "cairo-png"
    )
  } else {
    stop(
      "No reliable PNG graphics device is available. Install package 'ragg'."
    )
  }
}

# Resolve relative paths from the directory used to render this report while
# preserving absolute paths supplied through the YAML parameters.
resolve_project_path <- function(path) {
  path <- path.expand(as.character(path))
  if (grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:[/\\\\])", path)) path else file.path(getwd(), path)
}

# Centralized project paths. Raw inputs are separated by data source, while all
# generated outputs are written beneath the single Chapter_2_Results root.
hmm_data_dir <- resolve_project_path(params$hmm_data_dir)
hmm_input_file <- as.character(params$hmm_input_file)
if (!grepl("^(/|[A-Za-z]:)", hmm_input_file)) {
  input_file <- file.path(hmm_data_dir, hmm_input_file)
} else {
  input_file <- resolve_project_path(hmm_input_file)
}
gis_data_dir <- resolve_project_path(params$gis_data_dir)
master_output_root <- resolve_project_path(params$output_dir)
output_root <- file.path(
  master_output_root,
  "01_Grazing_Behavior_Spatial_Aera"
)
export_results <- isTRUE(params$export_results)

# One 10 x 10 m grid summarizes grazing-like GPS locations.
# The minimum-fix parameter allows a transparent
# sensitivity analysis while retaining one grazing fix as the primary rule.
maroto_grid_m <- as.numeric(params$maroto_grid_m)
active_cell_min_grazing_fixes <- as.integer(
  params$active_cell_min_grazing_fixes
)

if (!is.finite(maroto_grid_m) || maroto_grid_m <= 0) {
  stop("params$maroto_grid_m must be a positive number in metres.")
}
if (maroto_grid_m != 10) {
  stop("This RGP analysis uses only a 10 x 10 m grid; set maroto_grid_m to 10.")
}
if (
  is.na(active_cell_min_grazing_fixes) ||
    active_cell_min_grazing_fixes < 1L
) {
  stop("params$active_cell_min_grazing_fixes must be at least 1.")
}
```

### 1.2 Import and Audit the HMM Results

#### 1.2.1 Import the Combined HMM Dataset

```{r hmm-import-hmm-results}
if (!file.exists(input_file)) {
  stop("Input file was not found: ", normalizePath(input_file, mustWork = FALSE))
}

HMM_Results <- read.csv(
  input_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

required_columns <- c(
  "Date", "RFID", "sequence_id", "Pasture", "Year", "Distance"
)
missing_required_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(HMM_Results))

if (length(missing_required_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The input dataset is missing required columns: ",
    paste(missing_required_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```

#### 1.2.2 Inspect Structure, Dimensions, and Missingness

The audit below confirms variable names and types before any recoding. Keeping
this check near the import step makes changes in upstream files easy to detect.

```{r hmm-audit-hmm-results}
cat("Dimensions:", nrow(HMM_Results), "rows ×", ncol(HMM_Results), "columns\n\n")
cat("Column names:\n")

str(HMM_Results)

head(HMM_Results)
tail(HMM_Results)
```

### 1.3 Standardize Identifiers and Experimental Factors

#### 1.3.1 Parse Dates and Animal Identifiers

```{r hmm-standardize-identifiers}
# Parse two- or four-digit years in day-month-year, month-day-year, or ISO form.
HMM_Results$Date <- as.Date(suppressWarnings(lubridate::parse_date_time(
  as.character(HMM_Results$Date),
  orders = c("dmy", "mdy", "ymd"),
  tz = "UTC"
)))

format_rfid <- function(x) {
  numeric_x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  output <- as.character(x)
  numeric_rows <- !is.na(numeric_x)
  output[numeric_rows] <- sprintf("%.0f", numeric_x[numeric_rows])
  output[is.na(x)] <- NA_character_
  output
}

# Store the 15-digit RFID as text to avoid scientific notation in outputs.
HMM_Results <- HMM_Results %>%
  mutate(
    RFID = format_rfid(RFID),
    # Remove the segment suffix while retaining the collar-year identity.
    REAL_ID = sub("_seg.*$", "", sequence_id)
  )
```

#### 1.3.2 Derive Treatment and Stocking-Rate Classes

```{r hmm-derive-experimental-factors}
dat_all <- HMM_Results %>%
  mutate(
    TRT = case_when(
      Pasture %in% c("Pasture_1", "Pasture_5", "Pasture_6") ~ "Continuous",
      Pasture %in% c("Pasture_2", "Pasture_3", "Pasture_4") ~ "Rotational",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    SR = case_when(
      Pasture %in% c("Pasture_6", "Pasture_3") ~ "Light",
      Pasture %in% c("Pasture_2", "Pasture_5") ~ "Moderate",
      Pasture %in% c("Pasture_1", "Pasture_4") ~ "Heavy",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    TRT = factor(TRT, levels = c("Continuous", "Rotational")),
    SR = factor(SR, levels = c("Light", "Moderate", "Heavy"))
  )

# Verify that each pasture maps to one treatment and one stocking rate.
table(dat_all$Pasture, dat_all$TRT, useNA = "ifany")
table(dat_all$Pasture, dat_all$SR, useNA = "ifany")
```

## 2. Movement Analysis

Movement is summarized at daily, weekly, and monthly scales. Daily distance is
converted from meters to kilometers for inferential summaries and figures.

### 2.1 Daily Distance Traveled

```{r hmm-daily-ddt-analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Use the date format from HMM_Analysis.Rmd, while retaining already parsed dates.
analysis_date <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) {
    return(x)
  }

  parsed <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(as.character(x), format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
  missing_date <- is.na(parsed)

  if (any(missing_date)) {
    parsed[missing_date] <- as.Date(suppressWarnings(
      parse_date_time(
        as.character(x)[missing_date],
        orders = c("ymd", "mdy", "dmy"),
        tz = "UTC"
      )
    ))
  }

  parsed
}

dat_all <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(Date = analysis_date(Date))

if (any(is.na(dat_all$Date))) {
  warning(sum(is.na(dat_all$Date)), " observations have an unparseable Date.")
}

Daily_DDT <- dat_all %>%
  group_by(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR, REAL_ID, Date) %>%
  summarise(
    DDT = sum(Distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(log_DDT = log1p(DDT))

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
qqnorm(Daily_DDT$DDT, main = "Daily DDT")
qqline(Daily_DDT$DDT)
qqnorm(Daily_DDT$log_DDT, main = "log(1 + Daily DDT)")
qqline(Daily_DDT$log_DDT)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

### 2.3 Monthly Distance Traveled
```{r hmm-month-ddt-diagnostics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
Monthly_DDT <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    Year = lubridate::year(Date),
    Month_Start = lubridate::floor_date(Date, unit = "month")
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Year, Month_Start, Pasture, TRT,
    SR, REAL_ID, Date
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    # Convert daily distance from meters to kilometers.
    Daily_DDT = sum(Distance, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Year, Month_Start, Pasture,
    TRT, SR, REAL_ID
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Monthly_DDT = sum(Daily_DDT, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_DDT_day = mean(Daily_DDT, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_DDT_day = sd(Daily_DDT, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_days = n_distinct(Date),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_mean_DDT_day = if_else(
      mean_DDT_day > 0,
      log(mean_DDT_day),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

qqnorm(Monthly_DDT$mean_DDT_day, main = "Mean daily DDT by month")
qqline(Monthly_DDT$mean_DDT_day)
qqnorm(Monthly_DDT$log_mean_DDT_day, main = "log(mean daily DDT) by month")
qqline(Monthly_DDT$log_mean_DDT_day)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

monthly_ddt_for_shapiro <- Monthly_DDT$log_mean_DDT_day[
  is.finite(Monthly_DDT$log_mean_DDT_day)
]

if (length(monthly_ddt_for_shapiro) >= 3L) {
  # shapiro.test accepts at most 5,000 observations.
  shapiro.test(head(monthly_ddt_for_shapiro, 5000L))
}
```

#### 2.3.1 Screen Monthly Summaries with the IQR Rule

The 1.5 × IQR rule is used as a transparent screening procedure. Flagged
records are retained in `Monthly_DDT` and excluded only from the filtered
sensitivity dataset used below.

```{r hmm-monthly-ddt-iqr-screening}
Q1 <- quantile(Monthly_DDT$mean_DDT_day, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3 <- quantile(Monthly_DDT$mean_DDT_day, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR_value <- Q3 - Q1

lower_limit <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value
upper_limit <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value

Monthly_DDT <- Monthly_DDT |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    IQR_outlier = mean_DDT_day < lower_limit |
                  mean_DDT_day > upper_limit
  )

table(Monthly_DDT$IQR_outlier, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r hmm-monthly-ddt-flagged-records}
Monthly_DDT |>
  dplyr::filter(IQR_outlier)
```

```{r hmm-monthly-ddt-filtered-data}
Monthly_DDT_filtered <- Monthly_DDT |>
  dplyr::filter(!IQR_outlier | is.na(IQR_outlier))
```

```{r hmm-monthly-ddt-filtered-diagnostics}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
qqnorm(Monthly_DDT_filtered$mean_DDT_day, main = "Mean daily DDT by month")
qqline(Monthly_DDT_filtered$mean_DDT_day)
qqnorm(Monthly_DDT_filtered$log_mean_DDT_day, main = "log(mean daily DDT) by month")
qqline(Monthly_DDT_filtered$log_mean_DDT_day)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

#### 2.3.2 Fit the Monthly Distance Mixed Model

```{r hmm-monthly-ddt-model, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mod.Monthly_DDT_filtered <- lme4::lmer(
  mean_DDT_day ~ TRT * SR +
    (1 | Year) +
    (1 | Pasture),
  data = Monthly_DDT_filtered,
  REML = FALSE
)

afri_reference_anova(mod.Monthly_DDT_filtered)
summary(mod.Monthly_DDT_filtered)

emm_DDT <- emmeans(
  mod.Monthly_DDT_filtered,
  ~ SR * TRT
)

contrast_DDT <- pairs(emm_DDT, adjust = "tukey")

print(emm_DDT)
print(contrast_DDT)
```

## 3. Behavioral State Time-Budget Analysis

Behavior labels are standardized to **Grazing**, **Resting**, and **Traveling**.
Walking, relocation, and similar HMM labels are treated as traveling so the
same workflow can be used across model outputs.

### 3.1 Derive Daily Behavior Durations

```{r hmm-daily-behavior-time-hmm-analysis, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
duration_candidates <- c(
  "Duration", "duration", "Behavior_Minutes", "behavior_minutes", "minutes"
)
duration_column <- duration_candidates[
  duration_candidates %in% names(dat_all)
][1]

behavior_column <- c("Behavior", "Behaviour", "State", "state")
behavior_column <- behavior_column[behavior_column %in% names(dat_all)][1]

if (is.na(behavior_column)) {
  stop("No Behavior, Behaviour, State, or state column was found.")
}

analysis_behavior_data <- dat_all

if (!is.na(duration_column)) {
  analysis_behavior_data <- analysis_behavior_data %>%
    mutate(
      Duration_for_analysis = suppressWarnings(
        as.numeric(.data[[duration_column]])
      )
    )
} else {
  timestamp_candidates <- c(
    "DateTime", "Datetime", "datetime", "Timestamp", "timestamp",
    "Date_Time", "date_time", "Date.Time", "time", "Hour"
  )
  timestamp_column <- timestamp_candidates[
    timestamp_candidates %in% names(analysis_behavior_data)
  ][1]

  if (is.na(timestamp_column)) {
    stop(
      "Behavior time requires either a duration column (",
      paste(duration_candidates, collapse = ", "),
      ") or a timestamp column."
    )
  }

  timestamp_text <- as.character(analysis_behavior_data[[timestamp_column]])
  time_only <- str_detect(
    timestamp_text,
    "^\\s*\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(:\\d{2})?\\s*([AaPp][Mm])?\\s*$"
  )
  timestamp_text[time_only] <- paste(
    analysis_behavior_data$Date[time_only],
    timestamp_text[time_only]
  )

  observation_datetime <- suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
    timestamp_text,
    orders = c(
      "ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd IMS p", "ymd IM p",
      "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "mdy IMS p", "mdy IM p",
      "dmy HMS", "dmy HM", "dmy IMS p", "dmy IM p"
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  ))

  analysis_behavior_data <- analysis_behavior_data %>%
    mutate(Observation_DateTime_for_analysis = observation_datetime) %>%
    group_by(Year, Pasture, REAL_ID) %>%
    arrange(Observation_DateTime_for_analysis, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      Next_DateTime_for_analysis = lead(Observation_DateTime_for_analysis),
      Interval_Minutes_for_analysis = as.numeric(difftime(
        Next_DateTime_for_analysis,
        Observation_DateTime_for_analysis,
        units = "mins"
      )),
      Median_Interval_for_analysis = median(
        Interval_Minutes_for_analysis[
          is.finite(Interval_Minutes_for_analysis) &
            Interval_Minutes_for_analysis > 0
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      Duration_for_analysis = case_when(
        is.na(Interval_Minutes_for_analysis) ~ 0,
        as.Date(Next_DateTime_for_analysis) != Date ~ 0,
        Interval_Minutes_for_analysis <= 0 ~ 0,
        is.finite(Median_Interval_for_analysis) &
          Interval_Minutes_for_analysis > 3 * Median_Interval_for_analysis ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ Interval_Minutes_for_analysis
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

behavior_time <- analysis_behavior_data %>%
  mutate(
    Behavior_raw = str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(.data[[behavior_column]]))),
    Behavior = case_when(
      Behavior_raw == "1" ~ "Resting",
      Behavior_raw == "2" ~ "Grazing",
      Behavior_raw == "3" ~ "Traveling",
      str_detect(Behavior_raw, "graz|forag|feed") ~ "Grazing",
      str_detect(Behavior_raw, "rest|station|inactive|bed|lying") ~ "Resting",
      str_detect(Behavior_raw, "travel|walk|relocat|move|locom") ~ "Traveling",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Behavior)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR, REAL_ID, Date, Behavior) %>%
  summarise(
    minutes = sum(Duration_for_analysis, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_fixes = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
qqnorm(behavior_time$minutes, main = "Daily behavior minutes")
qqline(behavior_time$minutes)
qqnorm(log1p(behavior_time$minutes), main = "log(1 + behavior minutes)")
qqline(log1p(behavior_time$minutes))
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

### 3.2 Apply Daily Time-Budget Quality Control

```{r hmm-behavior-hours-quality-control, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
behavior_hours <- behavior_time %>%
  filter(
    Behavior %in% c(
      "Grazing",
      "Resting",
      "Traveling"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Behavior = factor(
      Behavior,
      levels = c(
        "Grazing",
        "Resting",
        "Traveling"
      )
    ),
    hours = minutes / 60
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Year, Pasture, TRT, SR,
    REAL_ID, Date, Behavior
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    hours = sum(hours, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Year, Pasture, TRT, SR,
    REAL_ID, Date
  ) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    Behavior,
    fill = list(hours = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

## Convert to wide format and calculate total recorded hours
behavior_hours_wide <- behavior_hours %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Behavior,
    values_from = hours,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_expand = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_hours = Grazing + Resting + Traveling
  )

## Retain days with at least 20 hours and no more than 24.2 hours
behavior_hours_wide_qc <- behavior_hours_wide %>%
  filter(
    Total_hours >= 20,
    Total_hours <= 24.2
  )

## Save excluded days and indicate the reason
excluded_days <- behavior_hours_wide %>%
  filter(
    Total_hours < 20 |
      Total_hours > 24.2
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    exclusion_reason = case_when(
      Total_hours < 20 ~ "Less than 20 hours",
      Total_hours > 24.2 ~ "More than 24.2 hours"
    )
  )

## Return retained observations to long format
behavior_hours_long <- behavior_hours_wide_qc %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Grazing,
      Resting,
      Traveling
    ),
    names_to = "Behavior",
    values_to = "hours"
  )

## Create separate behavior datasets
df.Grazing <- behavior_hours_long %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Grazing")

df.Resting <- behavior_hours_long %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Resting")

df.Traveling <- behavior_hours_long %>%
  filter(Behavior == "Traveling")

## QC summary
cat(
  "Days retained within the 20–24.2-hour range:",
  nrow(behavior_hours_wide_qc),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Days excluded with less than 20 hours:",
  sum(behavior_hours_wide$Total_hours < 20),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Days excluded with more than 24.2 hours:",
  sum(behavior_hours_wide$Total_hours > 24.2),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Total days excluded:",
  nrow(excluded_days),
  "\n"
)
```

### 3.4 Summarize Monthly Behavior

```{r hmm-monthly-behavior-summaries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_monthly_behavior <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      Date = as.Date(Date),
      Month = lubridate::floor_date(Date, unit = "month")
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      Year, Pasture, TRT, SR,
      REAL_ID, Behavior, Month
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_hours = mean(hours, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

df.Grazing_monthly <- make_monthly_behavior(df.Grazing)
df.Resting_monthly <- make_monthly_behavior(df.Resting)
df.Traveling_monthly <- make_monthly_behavior(df.Traveling)

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
qqnorm(df.Grazing_monthly$mean_hours, main = "Monthly grazing")
qqline(df.Grazing_monthly$mean_hours, col = "red")
qqnorm(df.Resting_monthly$mean_hours, main = "Monthly resting")
qqline(df.Resting_monthly$mean_hours, col = "red")
qqnorm(df.Traveling_monthly$mean_hours, main = "Monthly traveling")
qqline(df.Traveling_monthly$mean_hours, col = "red")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```


#### 3.4.1 Apply the IQR Rule Within Each Month

```{r hmm-monthly-behavior-summaries-filtered, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
apply_monthly_iqr <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    group_by(Month) %>%
    mutate(
      Q1 = quantile(mean_hours, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      Q3 = quantile(mean_hours, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR_value = Q3 - Q1,
      lower_limit = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value,
      upper_limit = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value,
      IQR_outlier = mean_hours < lower_limit |
                    mean_hours > upper_limit
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Flag outliers
df.Grazing_monthly_flagged <-
  apply_monthly_iqr(df.Grazing_monthly)

df.Resting_monthly_flagged <-
  apply_monthly_iqr(df.Resting_monthly)

df.Traveling_monthly_flagged <-
  apply_monthly_iqr(df.Traveling_monthly)

# Create filtered datasets
df.Grazing_monthly_filtered <- df.Grazing_monthly_flagged %>%
  filter(!IQR_outlier, is.finite(mean_hours))

df.Resting_monthly_filtered <- df.Resting_monthly_flagged %>%
  filter(!IQR_outlier, is.finite(mean_hours))

df.Traveling_monthly_filtered <- df.Traveling_monthly_flagged %>%
  filter(!IQR_outlier, is.finite(mean_hours))
```

#### 3.5.4 Evaluate Model Diagnostics

Standardized conditional residuals are reviewed with Shapiro–Wilk tests, Q–Q
plots, and residual-versus-fitted plots. Visual diagnostics carry more weight
than a single normality-test p-value for these mixed models.

```{r hmm-behavior-model-shapiro-tests, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Standardized conditional residuals
res.Grazing <- residuals(mod.Monthly_Grazing) /
  sigma(mod.Monthly_Grazing)

res.Resting <- residuals(mod.Monthly_Resting) /
  sigma(mod.Monthly_Resting)

res.Traveling <- residuals(mod.Monthly_Traveling) /
  sigma(mod.Monthly_Traveling)

## Shapiro–Wilk tests
shapiro.Grazing <- afri_shapiro(res.Grazing)
shapiro.Resting <- afri_shapiro(res.Resting)
shapiro.Traveling <- afri_shapiro(res.Traveling)

shapiro.Grazing
shapiro.Resting
shapiro.Traveling
```

**Residual Q–Q plots**

```{r hmm-behavior-model-residual-qq, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

qqnorm(
  res.Grazing,
  main = "Grazing residuals"
)
qqline(res.Grazing, col = "red", lwd = 2)

qqnorm(
  res.Resting,
  main = "Resting residuals"
)
qqline(res.Resting, col = "red", lwd = 2)

qqnorm(
  res.Traveling,
  main = "Traveling residuals"
)
qqline(res.Traveling, col = "red", lwd = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
