#### 3.5.5 Plot Estimated Marginal Means

This creates separate bar plots, using estimated marginal means and 95% confidence intervals from each monthly model.

```{r hmm-behavior-estimated-mean-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_behavior_plot <- function(emm_object, behavior_name) {
  
  plot_data <- as.data.frame(
    confint(emm_object)
  )

  ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(
      x = SR,
      y = emmean,
      fill = TRT
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
      width = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = lower.CL,
        ymax = upper.CL
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
      width = 0.18,
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Continuous" = "yellow",
        "Rotational" = "blue"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Effects of Treatment and Stocking on Monthly ",
        behavior_name
      ),
      x = "Stocking Rate",
      y = paste0(
        "Mean ",
        tolower(behavior_name),
        " time (hours/day)"
      ),
      fill = "Treatment"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# Create the three plots:

p.Grazing <- make_behavior_plot(
  emm.Monthly_Grazing,
  "Grazing"
)

p.Resting <- make_behavior_plot(
  emm.Monthly_Resting,
  "Resting"
)

p.Traveling <- make_behavior_plot(
  emm.Monthly_Traveling,
  "Traveling"
)

# Display each plot:
p.Grazing
p.Resting
p.Traveling
```

## 4. Spatial Analysis by Rotation Period

This section assigns every HMM GPS observation to the documented grazing rotation period, displays the GPS locations classified as **Grazing**, **Resting**, or **Walking**, and calculates the amount of time spent in each behavior. The time calculation follows the same grouping logic used for Daily Distance Travel: first calculate a daily animal-level response, then summarize it over each rotation period.

The code automatically searches for common timestamp, longitude, latitude, and HMM-state column names. Review the printed column choices before interpreting the results. When the decoded HMM state is numeric, edit `numeric_state_labels` so that state numbers match the biological interpretation used when the model was fitted.

### 4.1 Define the Rotation Schedule

```{r hmm-behavior-rotation-schedule, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
behavior_rotation_schedule <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Year, ~Rotation_Period, ~Rotation_Start, ~Rotation_End, ~P2_Rotation, ~P3_Rotation, ~P4_Rotation,
  2023, 1L, "2023-06-19", "2023-07-03", 1L, 1L, 1L,
  2023, 2L, "2023-07-04", "2023-07-17", 2L, 2L, 2L,
  2023, 3L, "2023-07-18", "2023-07-31", 3L, 3L, 3L,
  2023, 4L, "2023-08-01", "2023-08-14", 4L, 4L, 1L,
  2023, 5L, "2023-08-15", "2023-08-28", 1L, 1L, 2L,
  2024, 1L, "2024-06-13", "2024-06-27", 4L, 4L, 3L,
  2024, 2L, "2024-06-28", "2024-07-11", 3L, 3L, 2L,
  2024, 3L, "2024-07-12", "2024-07-26", 2L, 2L, 1L,
  2024, 4L, "2024-07-27", "2024-08-10", 1L, 1L, 3L,
  2024, 5L, "2024-08-11", "2024-08-25", 4L, 4L, 2L,
  2025, 1L, "2025-06-12", "2025-06-25", 1L, 1L, 1L,
  2025, 2L, "2025-06-26", "2025-07-09", 2L, 2L, 2L,
  2025, 3L, "2025-07-10", "2025-07-23", 3L, 3L, 3L,
  2025, 4L, "2025-07-24", "2025-08-06", 4L, 4L, 1L,
  2025, 5L, "2025-08-07", "2025-08-20", 1L, 1L, 2L
) %>%
  mutate(
    Rotation_Start = as.Date(Rotation_Start),
    Rotation_End = as.Date(Rotation_End),
    Rotation_Label = paste0("RGP", Rotation_Period)
  )

behavior_rotation_schedule
```

### 4.2 Standardize Coordinates, Timestamps, and Behavior States

```{r hmm-prepare-behavior-gps-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Return the first existing column from a vector of possible names.
first_existing_column <- function(data, candidates, required = TRUE) {
  exact_match <- candidates[candidates %in% names(data)]

  if (length(exact_match) == 0L) {
    lower_names <- tolower(names(data))
    lower_candidates <- tolower(candidates)
    matched_position <- match(lower_candidates, lower_names, nomatch = 0L)
    matched_position <- matched_position[matched_position > 0L]
    exact_match <- names(data)[matched_position]
  }

  if (length(exact_match) == 0L) {
    if (required) {
      stop(
        "None of these required columns were found: ",
        paste(candidates, collapse = ", ")
      )
    }
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  exact_match[[1L]]
}

longitude_col <- first_existing_column(
  dat_all,
  c("Longitude", "longitude", "Lon", "lon", "LONGITUDE", "location.long", "x")
)
latitude_col <- first_existing_column(
  dat_all,
  c("Latitude", "latitude", "Lat", "lat", "LATITUDE", "location.lat", "y")
)
state_col <- first_existing_column(
  dat_all,
  c("Behavior", "Behaviour", "State", "state", "HMM_State", "HMM.state", "decoded_state", "mostLikelyState")
)
timestamp_col <- first_existing_column(
  dat_all,
  c("DateTime", "Datetime", "datetime", "Timestamp", "timestamp", "Date_Time", "date_time", "Date.Time", "time"),
  required = FALSE
)

cat("Longitude column:", longitude_col, "\n")
cat("Latitude column:", latitude_col, "\n")
cat("HMM state column:", state_col, "\n")
cat("Timestamp column:", ifelse(is.na(timestamp_col), "not found", timestamp_col), "\n")

# IMPORTANT: edit this vector if the fitted HMM used a different state order.
numeric_state_labels <- c(
  `1` = "Resting",
  `2` = "Grazing",
  `3` = "Walking"
)

parse_hmm_timestamp <- function(x, fallback_date = NULL) {
  parsed <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::parse_date_time(
    as.character(x),
    orders = c(
      "ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd IMS p", "ymd IM p",
      "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "mdy IMS p", "mdy IM p",
      "dmy HMS", "dmy HM", "dmy IMS p", "dmy IM p"
    ),
    tz = "UTC"
  ))

  # Some files store only a clock time in one column and the date separately.
  if (all(is.na(parsed)) && !is.null(fallback_date)) {
    parsed <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::parse_date_time(
      paste(as.character(fallback_date), as.character(x)),
      orders = c(
        "ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd IMS p", "ymd IM p",
        "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "mdy IMS p", "mdy IM p"
      ),
      tz = "UTC"
    ))
  }

  parsed
}

raw_state <- dat_all[[state_col]]
raw_state_character <- stringr::str_trim(as.character(raw_state))
raw_state_lower <- stringr::str_to_lower(raw_state_character)

behavior_standardized <- dplyr::case_when(
  raw_state_character %in% names(numeric_state_labels) ~
    unname(numeric_state_labels[raw_state_character]),
  stringr::str_detect(raw_state_lower, "graz|forag|feed") ~ "Grazing",
  stringr::str_detect(raw_state_lower, "rest|station|inactive|lying") ~ "Resting",
  stringr::str_detect(raw_state_lower, "walk|travel|move|locom") ~ "Walking",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

if (all(is.na(behavior_standardized))) {
  stop(
    "The HMM state values could not be translated to Grazing, Resting, and Walking. ",
    "Inspect unique(dat_all[[state_col]]) and edit numeric_state_labels or the text rules."
  )
}

if (!is.na(timestamp_col)) {
  observation_datetime <- parse_hmm_timestamp(
    dat_all[[timestamp_col]],
    fallback_date = if ("Date" %in% names(dat_all)) dat_all$Date else NULL
  )
} else {
  stop(
    "A timestamp column is required to calculate behavior time. ",
    "Rename the date-time field to one of the names listed in timestamp_col, ",
    "or add its current name to that candidate vector."
  )
}

# Build the whole grazing season from the source HMM/GPS records before
# attaching RGP dates. Season boundaries are data-derived for each pasture-year:
# the first and last valid GPS date classified as Grazing. This retains grazing
# fixes on valid season dates that fall outside RGP1-RGP5 and avoids hard-coded
# calendar windows.
behavior_gps_source <- dat_all %>%
  mutate(
    Observation_DateTime = observation_datetime,
    Observation_Date = as.Date(Observation_DateTime),
    Year = as.integer(as.character(Year)),
    Pasture_ID = suppressWarnings(as.integer(
      stringr::str_extract(as.character(Pasture), "[1-6]")
    )),
    Longitude = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[longitude_col]])),
    Latitude = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[latitude_col]])),
    Behavior = factor(
      behavior_standardized,
      levels = c("Grazing", "Resting", "Walking")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Observation_DateTime),
    !is.na(Observation_Date),
    !is.na(Pasture_ID),
    !is.na(Longitude),
    !is.na(Latitude),
    !is.na(Behavior)
  )

season_grazing_dates_by_pasture <- behavior_gps_source %>%
  dplyr::filter(as.character(Behavior) == "Grazing") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture, Pasture_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Trial_Start = min(Observation_Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    Trial_End = max(Observation_Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    Grazing_GPS_Days = dplyr::n_distinct(Observation_Date),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(as.numeric(Trial_Start)),
    is.finite(as.numeric(Trial_End)),
    Trial_End >= Trial_Start
  )

if (anyDuplicated(
  season_grazing_dates_by_pasture[c("Year", "Pasture_ID")]
)) {
  stop("Duplicate pasture-year season boundaries derived from grazing GPS.")
}
if (nrow(season_grazing_dates_by_pasture) == 0L) {
  stop("No valid grazing GPS records were available to define season dates.")
}

# Retain a year-level lookup for legacy body-weight sections that require one
# common annual window. Spatial whole-season calculations below use the
# pasture-year-specific lookup, not this collapsed table.
season_grazing_dates <- season_grazing_dates_by_pasture %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Trial_Start = min(Trial_Start),
    Trial_End = max(Trial_End),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

behavior_gps_season <- behavior_gps_source %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    season_grazing_dates_by_pasture,
    by = c("Year", "Pasture", "Pasture_ID"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Observation_Date >= Trial_Start,
    Observation_Date <= Trial_End
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Year, Pasture, REAL_ID, Observation_DateTime)
behavior_gps <- behavior_gps_season %>%
  left_join(
    behavior_rotation_schedule,
    by = "Year",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Observation_Date >= Rotation_Start,
    Observation_Date <= Rotation_End
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, Pasture, REAL_ID, Observation_DateTime)

cat("Behavior GPS observations assigned to rotation periods:", nrow(behavior_gps), "\n")
print(table(behavior_gps$Behavior, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(behavior_gps$Year, behavior_gps$Rotation_Period, useNA = "ifany"))
```

### 4.3 Import Pasture and Rotation Polygons

The maps below use the same `CTWD_Pastures.shp` and `P2_R1`–`P4_R4` polygon files, coordinate-reference-system assumptions, CTWD feature-to-pasture mapping, and rotation schedule used in `Grazing_BW_AFRI_Master_Code_Final_Two`. For rotational Pastures 2–4, the highlighted polygon is the subdivision actually scheduled for that year and period. For continuous Pastures 1, 5, and 6, the complete pasture polygon is highlighted.

Set `params$gis_data_dir` in the YAML header to the folder that contains the
pasture and rotation shapefiles.

```{r hmm-behavior-map-shapefile-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ranch_shapefile <- file.path(gis_data_dir, "CTWD_Pastures.shp")
rotation_shapefiles <- list.files(
  path = gis_data_dir,
  pattern = "^P[234]_R[1-4].*\\.shp$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (!file.exists(ranch_shapefile)) {
  stop("CTWD_Pastures.shp was not found in gis_data_dir: ", normalizePath(gis_data_dir, mustWork = FALSE))
}
if (length(rotation_shapefiles) == 0L) {
  stop("No P2/P3/P4 rotation shapefiles were found in gis_data_dir.")
}

# Same CRS assumptions used in Grazing_BW_AFRI_Master_Code_Final_Two.
ranch_source_crs <- 32614
rotation_source_crs <- 4326
spatial_analysis_crs <- 32614

# Geometry-only reader copied from the BW master code. It permits use of the
# supplied .shp geometry even when .dbf/.shx/.prj sidecars are unavailable.
read_shp_geometry_only <- function(path, crs = NA) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Shapefile does not exist: ", path)

  con <- file(path, open = "rb")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  header <- readBin(con, what = "raw", n = 100L)
  if (length(header) != 100L) stop("Invalid or truncated shapefile header: ", path)

  geometries <- list()
  source_records <- integer()

  repeat {
    record_number <- readBin(con, integer(), n = 1L, size = 4L, signed = TRUE, endian = "big")
    if (length(record_number) == 0L) break
    content_length_words <- readBin(con, integer(), n = 1L, size = 4L, signed = TRUE, endian = "big")
    if (length(content_length_words) == 0L || content_length_words < 2L) {
      stop("Invalid record header in: ", path)
    }
    content_length_bytes <- as.integer(content_length_words) * 2L
    record_raw <- readBin(con, "raw", n = content_length_bytes)
    if (length(record_raw) != content_length_bytes) stop("Truncated shape record in: ", path)

    record_con <- rawConnection(record_raw, open = "rb")
    shape_type <- readBin(record_con, integer(), n = 1L, size = 4L, signed = TRUE, endian = "little")
    if (length(shape_type) == 0L || shape_type == 0L) {
      close(record_con)
      next
    }
    if (!shape_type %in% c(5L, 15L, 25L)) {
      close(record_con)
      stop("Unsupported polygon shape type ", shape_type, " in ", basename(path))
    }

    invisible(readBin(record_con, numeric(), n = 4L, size = 8L, endian = "little"))
    n_parts <- readBin(record_con, integer(), n = 1L, size = 4L, signed = TRUE, endian = "little")
    n_points <- readBin(record_con, integer(), n = 1L, size = 4L, signed = TRUE, endian = "little")
    if (length(n_parts) == 0L || length(n_points) == 0L || n_parts < 1L || n_points < 4L) {
      close(record_con)
      next
    }

    part_starts <- readBin(record_con, integer(), n = n_parts, size = 4L, signed = TRUE, endian = "little") + 1L
    xy_values <- readBin(record_con, numeric(), n = 2L * n_points, size = 8L, endian = "little")
    close(record_con)
    if (length(xy_values) != 2L * n_points) stop("Incomplete coordinate array in: ", path)

    xy_matrix <- matrix(xy_values, ncol = 2L, byrow = TRUE)
    part_ends <- c(part_starts[-1L] - 1L, n_points)
    rings <- lapply(seq_along(part_starts), function(j) {
      ring <- xy_matrix[part_starts[j]:part_ends[j], , drop = FALSE]
      if (!all(ring[1L, ] == ring[nrow(ring), ])) ring <- rbind(ring, ring[1L, ])
      ring
    })
    rings <- rings[vapply(rings, nrow, integer(1)) >= 4L]
    if (length(rings) == 0L) next

    geometries[[length(geometries) + 1L]] <- sf::st_polygon(rings)
    source_records <- c(source_records, as.integer(record_number))
  }

  if (length(geometries) == 0L) stop("No valid polygon records were found in: ", path)
  sf::st_sf(Source_Record = source_records, geometry = sf::st_sfc(geometries, crs = crs))
}

ranch_raw_sf <- read_shp_geometry_only(ranch_shapefile, ranch_source_crs) %>%
  sf::st_make_valid()

rotation_metadata <- tibble::tibble(
  Path = rotation_shapefiles,
  File = basename(rotation_shapefiles)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pasture_ID = as.integer(sub("^P([234])_.*$", "\\1", File)),
    Rotation_Number = as.integer(
      sub("^P[234]_R([1-4]).*$", "\\1", File)
    ),
    Rotation_Key = paste0("P", Pasture_ID, "_R", Rotation_Number)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Pasture_ID, Rotation_Number)

rotation_raw_list <- purrr::map2(
  rotation_metadata$Path,
  rotation_metadata$Rotation_Key,
  function(path, rotation_key) {
    x <- read_shp_geometry_only(path, rotation_source_crs) %>%
      sf::st_make_valid() %>%
      sf::st_transform(spatial_analysis_crs)
    sf::st_sf(Rotation_Key = rotation_key, geometry = sf::st_union(sf::st_geometry(x)))
  }
)

rotation_sf <- do.call(rbind, rotation_raw_list) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    rotation_metadata %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Rotation_Key,
        Pasture_ID,
        Rotation_Number,
        File
      ),
    by = "Rotation_Key"
  )


# The P2 polygon in the supplied image extends west of the black P1/P2
# fence. Remove this overlap with P1 before GPS classification or gridding.
# Fail if the expected geometry is absent; a PNG cannot supply a reliable
# geographic cut line by itself.
correct_pasture2_boundary <- function(x) {
  if (!inherits(x, "sf") || !all(1:2 %in% x$Pasture_ID) ||
      anyDuplicated(x$Pasture_ID))
    stop("Pasture 1 and 2 must each have exactly one polygon")
  i1 <- which(x$Pasture_ID == 1L)
  i2 <- which(x$Pasture_ID == 2L)
  p1 <- sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_geometry(x)[i1])
  p2 <- sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_geometry(x)[i2])
  overlap <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(p2, p1))
  removed_ha <- sum(as.numeric(sf::st_area(overlap))) / 10000
  if (!is.finite(removed_ha) || removed_ha <= 1e-5)
    stop("The P2/P1 overlap shown in the annotated map was not found. Supply actual fence geometry before computing P2 areas.")
  corrected <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_difference(p2, p1))
  corrected <- sf::st_union(sf::st_collection_extract(
    sf::st_make_valid(corrected), "POLYGON"))
  if (length(corrected) != 1L || sf::st_is_empty(corrected))
    stop("Correcting the Pasture 2 boundary produced empty geometry")
  sf::st_geometry(x)[i2] <- corrected
  residual <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(
    sf::st_geometry(x)[i2], p1))
  if (sum(as.numeric(sf::st_area(residual))) / 10000 > 1e-6)
    stop("Corrected Pasture 2 still overlaps Pasture 1")
  x$Pasture2_excluded_overlap_ha <- ifelse(
    x$Pasture_ID == 2L, removed_ha, 0)
  x
}

# Same feature mapping verified in the BW master code.
pasture_feature_map <- tibble::tibble(
  Pasture_ID = 1:6,
  Ranch_Feature_ID = c(9L, 8L, 10L, 13L, 12L, 11L)
)

pasture_sf <- ranch_raw_sf %>%
  dplyr::rename(Ranch_Feature_ID = Source_Record) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    pasture_feature_map,
    by = "Ranch_Feature_ID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Pasture_ID) %>%
  correct_pasture2_boundary()

if (nrow(pasture_sf) != 6L) {
  stop("The CTWD record mapping did not return all six summer pastures.")
}

# Clip each rotational subdivision to its parent pasture, as in the BW code.
rotation_clipped_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(rotation_sf)), function(i) {
  this_rotation <- rotation_sf[i, ]

  this_pasture <- pasture_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(Pasture_ID == this_rotation$Pasture_ID)

  clipped <- sf::st_intersection(
    sf::st_geometry(this_rotation),
    sf::st_geometry(this_pasture)
  )

  clipped <- clipped[!sf::st_is_empty(clipped)]

  if (length(clipped) == 0L) {
    clipped <- sf::st_geometry(this_rotation)
  }

  sf::st_sf(
    Rotation_Key = this_rotation$Rotation_Key,
    Pasture_ID = this_rotation$Pasture_ID,
    Rotation_Number = this_rotation$Rotation_Number,
    geometry = sf::st_union(clipped)
  )
})

rotation_sf <- do.call(rbind, rotation_clipped_list)
```

### 4.4 Prepare GPS Points and Scheduled Active Polygons

```{r hmm-behavior-map-spatial-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
behavior_map_data <- behavior_gps %>%
  mutate(
    Pasture_ID = suppressWarnings(as.integer(stringr::str_extract(as.character(Pasture), "[1-6]"))),
    Map_Group = paste(Year, Pasture, sep = " — "),
    Rotation_Label = factor(Rotation_Label, levels = paste0("RGP", 1:5)),
    Active_Rotation_Number = case_when(
      Pasture_ID == 2L ~ P2_Rotation,
      Pasture_ID == 3L ~ P3_Rotation,
      Pasture_ID == 4L ~ P4_Rotation,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    Rotation_Key = if_else(
      Pasture_ID %in% 2:4,
      paste0("P", Pasture_ID, "_R", Active_Rotation_Number),
      NA_character_
    )
  )

if (any(is.na(behavior_map_data$Pasture_ID))) {
  stop("Some Pasture values could not be translated to Pasture_ID 1–6.")
}

# GPS source coordinates are longitude/latitude and are transformed to the
# same UTM CRS used for the pasture polygons.
behavior_gps_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
  behavior_map_data,
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
) %>%
  sf::st_transform(spatial_analysis_crs)

# Season GPS points come from the full date window, including uncovered RGP
# days, but use the same animal, coordinate, and pasture checks as RGP points.
# ============================================================
# WHOLE-SEASON GPS SPATIAL OBJECT
# ============================================================
# Pasture_ID was already created and validated upstream.
# Do NOT reconstruct it from the Pasture text label here.
# ============================================================

season_map_data <- behavior_gps_season %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year = as.integer(
      as.character(Year)
    ),
    Pasture_ID = as.integer(
      as.character(Pasture_ID)
    ),
    Behavior = as.character(
      Behavior
    )
  )


if (
  any(
    is.na(
      season_map_data$Pasture_ID
    )
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season GPS contains missing Pasture_ID values."
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# QC BEFORE SPATIAL CONVERSION
# ------------------------------------------------------------

season_map_qc <- season_map_data %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    Behavior,
    name = "N_fixes"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    Behavior
  )


print(
  season_map_qc
)


# There MUST be grazing fixes
season_grazing_qc <- season_map_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Behavior == "Grazing"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    name = "N_grazing_fixes"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID
  )


print(
  season_grazing_qc
)


if (
  nrow(
    season_grazing_qc
  ) == 0L
) {
  stop(
    "behavior_gps_season contains zero Grazing fixes."
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CONVERT TO SF
# ------------------------------------------------------------

behavior_gps_season_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
  season_map_data,
  coords = c(
    "Longitude",
    "Latitude"
  ),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
) %>%
  sf::st_transform(
    spatial_analysis_crs
  )

map_period_index <- behavior_map_data %>%
  distinct(
    Year, Pasture, Pasture_ID, Map_Group,
    Rotation_Period, Rotation_Label,
    Active_Rotation_Number, Rotation_Key
  )

active_period_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(map_period_index)), function(i) {
  row_i <- map_period_index[i, ]

  if (row_i$Pasture_ID %in% c(1L, 5L, 6L)) {
    selected_geometry <- sf::st_geometry(
      pasture_sf %>% filter(Pasture_ID == row_i$Pasture_ID)
    )
  } else {
    selected_geometry <- sf::st_geometry(
      rotation_sf %>% filter(Rotation_Key == row_i$Rotation_Key)
    )
  }

  if (length(selected_geometry) != 1L || sf::st_is_empty(selected_geometry)) {
    stop(
      "Could not match an active polygon for ", row_i$Map_Group,
      ", ", as.character(row_i$Rotation_Label), "."
    )
  }

  sf::st_sf(row_i, geometry = selected_geometry)
})

active_period_sf <- do.call(rbind, active_period_list)
```

### 4.5 Calculate GPS-Observed Active Grazing Area

The analysis uses a fixed **10 × 10-m grid** to summarize regularly timed
grazing-like GPS locations and their relative spatial use. Maroto-Molina et al.
(2023) provide precedent for GNSS pixel summaries and evenness metrics. They then used the
pixel values to describe land-use evenness with Lorenz curves and a Gini-type
coefficient. The calculation below is an explicit extension of its pixel-based
framework to the HMM locations classified as **Grazing**.

For each pasture and RGP, one stable 10 × 10-m grid is clipped to the pasture. Map 1 marks every cell with a grazing-like GPS fix within the pasture, including locations beyond the assigned RGP. Map 2 marks only cells with a grazing-like fix inside the assigned RGP, using the actual area of each cell clipped to that RGP. Outside-RGP fixes within the pasture remain a separate diagnostic category. The two map areas are calculated independently; Map 1 cells crossing an RGP line are counted once over their entire pasture-clipped area. A cell is classified as active when it contains at least
`r active_cell_min_grazing_fixes` grazing GPS observation(s). Boundary cells are split at the scheduled RGP boundary and clipped to the pasture fence. Cell areas are converted from square
metres to hectares before the active area is calculated:

\[
A_{j,\mathrm{ha}} = \frac{A_{j,\mathrm{m^2}}}{10{,}000}
\]

\[
A_{\mathrm{active,ha}} =
\sum_{j=1}^{J} I(n_j \geq k)A_{j,\mathrm{ha}}
\]

\[
\mathrm{Active\ area\ (\%)} =
100\times\frac{A_{\mathrm{active,ha}}}{A_{\mathrm{available,ha}}}
\]

Here, \(n_j\) is the number of grazing GPS observations in cell \(j\), \(k\)
is the selected minimum number of observations, and
\(A_{\mathrm{available,ha}}\) is the scheduled pasture or rotation area. Thus,
**Active area** is interpreted as *GPS-observed grazed area*, not as proof that
every square metre within an active cell was defoliated.


#### 4.5.1 Construct the 10-m Grid and Calculate Area in Hectares

```{r hmm-active-grazing-area-maroto-molina, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# One 10-m grid has stable IDs for every year and rotation period. All areas
# below are actual polygon intersection areas, including boundary cells.
maroto_grid_template <- sf::st_as_sf(sf::st_make_grid(
  sf::st_union(sf::st_geometry(pasture_sf)),
  cellsize = maroto_grid_m, what = "polygons", square = TRUE
)) %>% dplyr::mutate(Grid_Cell_ID = dplyr::row_number())
stopifnot(sf::st_crs(maroto_grid_template)$epsg == 32614,
          !anyDuplicated(maroto_grid_template$Grid_Cell_ID))

gini_coefficient <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(as.numeric(x))
  if (!length(x) || anyNA(x) || sum(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  sum((2 * seq_along(x) - length(x) - 1) * x) /
    (length(x) * sum(x))
}

pasture_grid <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(pasture_sf)), function(i) {
  p <- pasture_sf[i, ]
  g <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(maroto_grid_template,
                                             sf::st_geometry(p)))
  g <- g[!sf::st_is_empty(g), , drop = FALSE]
  g$Pasture_ID <- p$Pasture_ID
  g$Pasture_Cell_ha <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(g)) / 10000
  g[g$Pasture_Cell_ha > 0, , drop = FALSE]
})
names(pasture_grid) <- as.character(pasture_sf$Pasture_ID)
pasture_area_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pasture_sf)), function(i) {
  p <- pasture_sf[i, ]
  tibble::tibble(Pasture_ID = p$Pasture_ID,
    Polygon_ha = as.numeric(sf::st_area(p)) / 10000,
    Grid_ha = sum(pasture_grid[[as.character(p$Pasture_ID)]]$Pasture_Cell_ha),
    Excluded_P2_overlap_ha = p$Pasture2_excluded_overlap_ha)
})) %>% dplyr::mutate(Difference_ha = Grid_ha - Polygon_ha)
if (any(abs(pasture_area_audit$Difference_ha) > 1e-5))
  stop("Pasture grid and polygon areas differ; inspect pasture_area_audit")

spatial_point_audit <- list()
active_grazing_grid_list <- list()
all_pasture_grid_list <- list()
active_area_summary_list <- list()
active_point_cells <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(map_period_index))) {
  k <- map_period_index[i, ]
  key <- paste(k$Year, k$Pasture_ID, k$Rotation_Period, sep = "_")
  pg <- pasture_grid[[as.character(k$Pasture_ID)]]
  pp <- pasture_sf %>% dplyr::filter(Pasture_ID == k$Pasture_ID)
  ap <- active_period_sf %>% dplyr::filter(
    Year == k$Year, Pasture_ID == k$Pasture_ID,
    Rotation_Period == k$Rotation_Period)
  if (nrow(ap) != 1L) stop("Missing or duplicate scheduled polygon: ", key)
  is_vf <- k$Pasture_ID %in% 2:4

  # Use the already pasture-clipped 10-m grid as the analysis pasture
  # geometry. This keeps the scheduled-rotation split and pasture-area audit
  # on exactly the same geometry used for Pasture_Cell_ha.
  pasture_grid_geom <- sf::st_union(sf::st_geometry(pg))
  ap_geom_raw <- sf::st_union(sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_geometry(ap)))

  if (is_vf) {
    ap_geom <- suppressWarnings(
      sf::st_intersection(ap_geom_raw, pasture_grid_geom)
    )
    if (length(ap_geom) == 0L || all(sf::st_is_empty(ap_geom)))
      stop("Scheduled rotation does not intersect pasture: ", key)
    ap_geom <- sf::st_union(sf::st_make_valid(ap_geom))
  } else {
    ap_geom <- pasture_grid_geom
  }

  raw_scheduled_ha <- sum(as.numeric(sf::st_area(ap_geom_raw))) / 10000
  clipped_scheduled_ha <- sum(as.numeric(sf::st_area(ap_geom))) / 10000

  # Only grazing-like fixes enter the active-area surface. The raw behavior
  # data remain available for movement and time-budget calculations.
  pts <- behavior_gps_sf %>% dplyr::filter(
    Year == k$Year, Pasture_ID == k$Pasture_ID,
    Rotation_Period == k$Rotation_Period, Behavior == "Grazing")
  pts$GPS_Point_ID <- seq_len(nrow(pts))
  in_pasture <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(pts, pasture_grid_geom)) > 0L
  in_rotation <- in_pasture & lengths(sf::st_intersects(pts, ap_geom)) > 0L
  pts$Spatial_Status <- ifelse(!in_pasture, "OUTSIDE_PASTURE",
    ifelse(is_vf & !in_rotation, "OUTSIDE_ROTATION_WITHIN_PASTURE",
           "INSIDE_CURRENT_ROTATION"))
  n_out_pasture <- sum(!in_pasture)
  pts_inside <- pts[in_pasture, , drop = FALSE]
  # Boundary ties are resolved by the smallest stable ID; each fix counts once.
  matches <- sf::st_join(pts_inside,
    pg %>% dplyr::select(Grid_Cell_ID), join = sf::st_intersects,
    left = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(GPS_Point_ID, Grid_Cell_ID) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(GPS_Point_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
  unmatched <- sum(is.na(matches$Grid_Cell_ID))
  if (unmatched) stop("Inside-pasture GPS fixes lack a grid cell: ", key)
  active_point_cells[[key]] <- sf::st_drop_geometry(matches) %>%
    dplyr::select(Year, Pasture, Pasture_ID, Rotation_Period,
      REAL_ID, Observation_Date, GPS_Point_ID, Grid_Cell_ID, Spatial_Status)
  spatial_point_audit[[key]] <- tibble::tibble(
    Year = k$Year, Pasture_ID = k$Pasture_ID,
    Rotation_Period = k$Rotation_Period, N_all = nrow(pts),
    N_inside = sum(in_rotation),
    N_outside_rotation = sum(is_vf & in_pasture & !in_rotation),
    N_outside_pasture = n_out_pasture, N_unmatched_grid = unmatched)

  counts <- sf::st_drop_geometry(matches) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Grid_Cell_ID, Spatial_Status) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Grazing_GPS_Points = dplyr::n(),
      Unique_Steers = dplyr::n_distinct(REAL_ID),
      Unique_Grazing_Days = dplyr::n_distinct(REAL_ID, Observation_Date),
      .groups = "drop")

  # Grid map 1: use all grazing fixes within the pasture, independent of the
  # RGP status. A boundary-crossing 10-m cell has one stable cell ID and counts
  # once; its area is the actual pasture-clipped polygon area.
  all_cell_counts <- sf::st_drop_geometry(matches) %>%
    dplyr::count(Grid_Cell_ID, name = "Grazing_GPS_Points_all")
  all_pasture_grid <- pg %>%
    dplyr::left_join(all_cell_counts, by = "Grid_Cell_ID",
      relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Grazing_GPS_Points_all = tidyr::replace_na(
        Grazing_GPS_Points_all, 0L),
      Active_Cell_all = Grazing_GPS_Points_all >=
        active_cell_min_grazing_fixes,
      Year = k$Year, Pasture = as.character(k$Pasture),
      Map_Group = as.character(k$Map_Group),
      Rotation_Period = k$Rotation_Period,
      Rotation_Label = as.character(k$Rotation_Label))
  all_pasture_grid_list[[key]] <- all_pasture_grid
  # Split each already pasture-clipped grid cell directly at the authorized
  # rotation boundary. For VF pastures: inside = pg intersect rotation and
  # outside = pg minus rotation. The two pieces therefore reconstruct pg.
  if (is_vf) {
    inside <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_intersection(pg, ap_geom))
    outside <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_difference(pg, ap_geom))

    inside <- inside[!sf::st_is_empty(inside), , drop = FALSE]
    outside <- outside[!sf::st_is_empty(outside), , drop = FALSE]

    inside$Spatial_Status <- "INSIDE_CURRENT_ROTATION"
    outside$Spatial_Status <- "OUTSIDE_ROTATION_WITHIN_PASTURE"
    available <- rbind(inside, outside)
  } else {
    available <- pg
    available$Spatial_Status <- "INSIDE_CURRENT_ROTATION"
  }

  available <- available[!sf::st_is_empty(available), , drop = FALSE]
  available$Cell_Area_ha <- as.numeric(sf::st_area(available)) / 10000
  available <- available %>% dplyr::filter(is.finite(Cell_Area_ha), Cell_Area_ha > 0)

  # Cell-by-cell audit: every clipped pasture cell must be reconstructed by its
  # inside/outside pieces before GPS counts are joined.
  cell_area_audit <- available %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Grid_Cell_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Reconstructed_Cell_ha = sum(Cell_Area_ha), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      sf::st_drop_geometry(pg) %>%
        dplyr::select(Grid_Cell_ID, Pasture_Cell_ha),
      by = "Grid_Cell_ID"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Difference_ha = Reconstructed_Cell_ha - Pasture_Cell_ha)

  bad_cells <- cell_area_audit %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.na(Difference_ha) | abs(Difference_ha) > 1e-7)

  if (nrow(bad_cells) > 0L) {
    print(
      bad_cells %>%
        dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(Difference_ha))) %>%
        utils::head(20)
    )
    stop("Grid-cell partition error: ", key)
  }

  available <- available %>%
    dplyr::left_join(counts,
      by = c("Grid_Cell_ID", "Spatial_Status")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Grazing_GPS_Points = tidyr::replace_na(Grazing_GPS_Points, 0L),
      Unique_Steers = tidyr::replace_na(Unique_Steers, 0L),
      Unique_Grazing_Days = tidyr::replace_na(Unique_Grazing_Days, 0L),
      Active_Cell = Grazing_GPS_Points >= active_cell_min_grazing_fixes,
      Year = k$Year, Pasture = as.character(k$Pasture),
      Map_Group = as.character(k$Map_Group),
      Rotation_Period = k$Rotation_Period,
      Rotation_Label = as.character(k$Rotation_Label),
      Period_Cell_ID = paste(Year, k$Pasture_ID, Rotation_Period,
                             Grid_Cell_ID, Spatial_Status, sep = "_"))
  if (anyDuplicated(available$Period_Cell_ID)) stop("Duplicate period cells: ", key)
  available_ha <- sum(available$Cell_Area_ha)
  pasture_ha <- sum(pg$Pasture_Cell_ha)
  rotation_ha <- if (is_vf) sum(available$Cell_Area_ha[
    available$Spatial_Status == "INSIDE_CURRENT_ROTATION"]) else pasture_ha
  scheduled_rotation_ha <- if (is_vf) clipped_scheduled_ha else pasture_ha
  pasture_area_difference <- available_ha - pasture_ha
  rotation_area_difference <- rotation_ha - scheduled_rotation_ha

  if (abs(pasture_area_difference) > 1e-5 ||
      abs(rotation_area_difference) > 1e-5) {
    stop(paste0(
      "\nClipped grid does not reproduce scheduled area: ", key,
      "\nPasture area: ", round(pasture_ha, 8), " ha",
      "\nGrid partition area: ", round(available_ha, 8), " ha",
      "\nPasture difference: ", round(pasture_area_difference, 10), " ha",
      "\nRaw scheduled polygon area: ", round(raw_scheduled_ha, 8), " ha",
      "\nScheduled area clipped to pasture: ", round(clipped_scheduled_ha, 8), " ha",
      "\nGrid inside-rotation area: ", round(rotation_ha, 8), " ha",
      "\nRotation difference: ", round(rotation_area_difference, 10), " ha"
    ))
  }
  inside_ha <- sum(available$Cell_Area_ha[available$Active_Cell &
    available$Spatial_Status == "INSIDE_CURRENT_ROTATION"])
  total_ha <- sum(all_pasture_grid$Pasture_Cell_ha[
    all_pasture_grid$Active_Cell_all])
  if (inside_ha > total_ha + 1e-5)
    stop("Inside-RGP active area exceeds whole-pasture grid: ", key)
  # Intensity is counts per unique steer-day, with zeros across all available
  # cells. Gini is undefined when no grazing fixes are observed.
  steer_days <- dplyr::n_distinct(paste(
    sf::st_drop_geometry(matches)$REAL_ID,
    sf::st_drop_geometry(matches)$Observation_Date))
  if (!nrow(matches)) steer_days <- 0L
  available$Fixes_per_Steer_Day <- if (steer_days > 0)
    available$Grazing_GPS_Points / steer_days else NA_real_
  grid_counts <- available %>% sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Grid_Cell_ID) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = sum(Grazing_GPS_Points), .groups = "drop")
  gini <- gini_coefficient(grid_counts$n)
  active_area_summary_list[[key]] <- tibble::tibble(
    Year = k$Year, Pasture = as.character(k$Pasture), Pasture_ID = k$Pasture_ID,
    TRT = as.character(behavior_map_data$TRT[
      behavior_map_data$Year == k$Year & behavior_map_data$Pasture_ID == k$Pasture_ID][1]),
    SR = as.character(behavior_map_data$SR[
      behavior_map_data$Year == k$Year & behavior_map_data$Pasture_ID == k$Pasture_ID][1]),
    Rotation_Period = k$Rotation_Period,
    Rotation_Label = as.character(k$Rotation_Label),
    Active_Rotation_Number = k$Active_Rotation_Number,
    Grid_Size_m = maroto_grid_m,
    Cell_Area_ha_Full = maroto_grid_m^2 / 10000,
    Minimum_Grazing_Fixes = active_cell_min_grazing_fixes,
    Pasture_area_ha = pasture_ha,
    Raw_scheduled_rotation_ha = raw_scheduled_ha,
    Scheduled_rotation_clipped_ha = scheduled_rotation_ha,
    Available_ha_rotation = rotation_ha,
    Available_Area_ha = rotation_ha,
    Active_ha_inside_rotation = inside_ha,
    Total_active_ha_period = total_ha,
    Active_Area_ha = total_ha,
    Active_Area_percent = if (pasture_ha > 0) 100 * total_ha / pasture_ha else NA_real_,
    Percent_rotation_area_active = if (rotation_ha > 0) 100 * inside_ha / rotation_ha else NA_real_,
    Total_Grid_Cells = nrow(all_pasture_grid),
    Active_Grid_Cells = sum(all_pasture_grid$Active_Cell_all),
    Grazing_GPS_Points = nrow(pts),
    N_grazing_fixes_inside = sum(in_rotation),
    N_grazing_fixes_outside_rotation = sum(is_vf & in_pasture & !in_rotation),
    N_grazing_fixes_outside_pasture = n_out_pasture,
    Percent_grazing_fixes_inside = if (nrow(pts)) 100*sum(in_rotation)/nrow(pts) else NA_real_,
    Percent_grazing_fixes_outside_rotation = if (is_vf && nrow(pts))
      100*sum(in_pasture & !in_rotation)/nrow(pts) else NA_real_,
    Observed_steer_days = steer_days,
    Gini = gini,
    Grazing_Evenness_1_minus_Gini = 1 - gini)
  active_grazing_grid_list[[key]] <- available
}
spatial_point_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(spatial_point_audit)
if (any(spatial_point_audit$N_all != spatial_point_audit$N_inside +
        spatial_point_audit$N_outside_rotation +
        spatial_point_audit$N_outside_pasture))
  stop("Unaccounted GPS fixes; inspect spatial_point_audit")
active_point_cells <- dplyr::bind_rows(active_point_cells)
all_pasture_active_grid_sf <- do.call(rbind, all_pasture_grid_list) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Rotation_Label = factor(Rotation_Label,
    levels = paste0("RGP", 1:5)),
    Active_Cell = factor(Active_Cell_all, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
      labels = c("Not observed grazed", "GPS-observed grazed")))
active_grazing_grid_sf <- do.call(rbind, active_grazing_grid_list) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Rotation_Label = factor(Rotation_Label,
    levels = paste0("RGP", 1:5)),
    Active_Cell = factor(Active_Cell, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
      labels = c("Not observed grazed", "GPS-observed grazed")))
inside_RGP_active_grid_sf <- active_grazing_grid_sf %>%
  dplyr::filter(Spatial_Status == "INSIDE_CURRENT_ROTATION")
active_area_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(active_area_summary_list) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Year, Pasture_ID, Rotation_Period) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(behavior_rotation_schedule %>%
    dplyr::select(Year, Rotation_Period, Period_start = Rotation_Start,
                  Period_end = Rotation_End),
    by = c("Year", "Rotation_Period")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Period_days = as.integer(Period_end - Period_start) + 1L,

    # Requested explicit period-level spatial denominators.
    active_ha_all_pasture = Total_active_ha_period,
    active_m2_all_pasture = active_ha_all_pasture * 10000,
    active_ha_inside_rgp = Active_ha_inside_rotation,
    active_m2_inside_rgp = active_ha_inside_rgp * 10000,
    total_rgp_area_ha = Available_ha_rotation,
    percent_rgp_actively_grazed = dplyr::if_else(
      is.finite(total_rgp_area_ha) & total_rgp_area_ha > 0,
      100 * active_ha_inside_rgp / total_rgp_area_ha,
      NA_real_
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# BUILD WHOLE-SEASON GRID DIRECTLY FROM ALL GRAZING GPS FIXES
# ============================================================
#
# CRITICAL DESIGN:
#   - rebuild the whole-season source from behavior_gps_source EVERY RUN
#   - never reuse a previously modified behavior_gps_season_sf object
#   - use Year + REAL_ID pasture assignment from the working behavior_gps_sf
#     as the primary animal-year pasture assignment
#   - fall back to the pasture ID already present in behavior_gps_source
#   - derive whole-season date windows AFTER pasture reconciliation
#   - use geometry only to decide whether a fix is physically inside its
#     assigned pasture; overlapping pasture polygons do not assign pasture
#   - count unique occupied 10 x 10 m cells directly for the whole season
#
# This is NOT the sum or union of period/RGP active-area estimates.
# ============================================================


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: robust pasture-number parser
# ------------------------------------------------------------

parse_pasture_id <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(
      stringr::str_extract(
        as.character(x),
        "[0-9]+"
      )
    )
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 1. REQUIRE A CLEAN PRE-RGP WHOLE-SEASON SOURCE
# ============================================================
#
# behavior_gps_source is created upstream directly from the HMM/GPS data,
# before the RGP-date join. Rebuilding from it prevents failed/repeated runs
# of this chunk from progressively filtering behavior_gps_season_sf.
# ============================================================

if (!exists("behavior_gps_source")) {
  stop(
    "behavior_gps_source does not exist. Run the upstream HMM behavior ",
    "source-preparation chunk before this active-area chunk."
  )
}

required_behavior_source_cols <- c(
  "Year",
  "REAL_ID",
  "Pasture_ID",
  "Longitude",
  "Latitude",
  "Observation_Date",
  "Behavior"
)

missing_behavior_source_cols <- setdiff(
  required_behavior_source_cols,
  names(behavior_gps_source)
)

if (length(missing_behavior_source_cols) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "behavior_gps_source is missing required column(s): ",
    paste(missing_behavior_source_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (!exists("behavior_gps_sf")) {
  stop(
    "behavior_gps_sf does not exist. Run the period/RGP GPS spatial-data ",
    "preparation before this active-area chunk."
  )
}

if (!inherits(behavior_gps_sf, "sf")) {
  stop("behavior_gps_sf must be an sf object.")
}

if (is.na(sf::st_crs(pasture_sf))) {
  stop("pasture_sf has no CRS.")
}


# ============================================================
# 2. VALIDATED ANIMAL-YEAR PASTURE LOOKUP FROM RGP SOURCE
# ============================================================
#
# The period/RGP analysis already works with behavior_gps_sf. Therefore the
# Year + REAL_ID pasture assignment in that object is used as the primary
# assignment for all whole-season dates for the same animal-year.
# ============================================================

required_rgp_lookup_cols <- c(
  "Year",
  "REAL_ID",
  "Pasture_ID"
)

missing_rgp_lookup_cols <- setdiff(
  required_rgp_lookup_cols,
  names(behavior_gps_sf)
)

if (length(missing_rgp_lookup_cols) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "behavior_gps_sf is missing required lookup column(s): ",
    paste(missing_rgp_lookup_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

rgp_animal_pasture_lookup <- behavior_gps_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Year = as.integer(as.character(Year)),
    REAL_ID = trimws(as.character(REAL_ID)),
    Pasture_ID_RGP = parse_pasture_id(Pasture_ID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Year),
    !is.na(REAL_ID),
    REAL_ID != "",
    !is.na(Pasture_ID_RGP)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

animal_year_pasture_conflicts <- rgp_animal_pasture_lookup %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, REAL_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    N_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(Pasture_ID_RGP),
    Pastures = paste(sort(unique(Pasture_ID_RGP)), collapse = ","),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_pastures > 1L)

if (nrow(animal_year_pasture_conflicts) > 0L) {
  print(animal_year_pasture_conflicts)
  stop(
    "At least one animal-year is assigned to more than one pasture in ",
    "behavior_gps_sf. Resolve this before calculating whole-season area."
  )
}

rgp_animal_pasture_lookup <- rgp_animal_pasture_lookup %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Year,
    REAL_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. REBUILD THE WHOLE-SEASON SOURCE FROM behavior_gps_source
# ============================================================
#
# This is intentionally rebuilt every time this chunk runs. Do NOT begin from
# behavior_gps_season_sf here, because that object may have been modified by a
# previous failed/partial execution in the current R session.
# ============================================================

whole_season_source_raw <- if (inherits(behavior_gps_source, "sf")) {
  sf::st_drop_geometry(behavior_gps_source)
} else {
  behavior_gps_source
}

whole_season_source_reconciled <- whole_season_source_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year = as.integer(as.character(Year)),
    REAL_ID = trimws(as.character(REAL_ID)),
    Observation_Date = as.Date(Observation_Date),
    Longitude = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Longitude)),
    Latitude = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Latitude)),
    Behavior = stringr::str_to_title(
      trimws(as.character(Behavior))
    ),
    Pasture_ID_source = parse_pasture_id(Pasture_ID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -dplyr::any_of(
      c(
        "Pasture_ID_RGP",
        "Pasture_assignment_source",
        "Trial_Start",
        "Trial_End",
        "Trial_Start.x",
        "Trial_Start.y",
        "Trial_End.x",
        "Trial_End.y"
      )
    ),
    -dplyr::matches("^Trial_(Start|End)(\\..*)?$")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    rgp_animal_pasture_lookup,
    by = c("Year", "REAL_ID"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pasture_ID = dplyr::coalesce(
      Pasture_ID_RGP,
      Pasture_ID_source
    ),
    Pasture_assignment_source = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(Pasture_ID_RGP) ~ "VALIDATED_RGP_ANIMAL_YEAR",
      is.na(Pasture_ID_RGP) & !is.na(Pasture_ID_source) ~
        "BEHAVIOR_GPS_SOURCE",
      TRUE ~ "UNASSIGNED"
    ),
    Source_vs_RGP_conflict =
      !is.na(Pasture_ID_RGP) &
      !is.na(Pasture_ID_source) &
      Pasture_ID_RGP != Pasture_ID_source,
    Pasture = paste0("Pasture_", Pasture_ID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Year),
    !is.na(REAL_ID),
    REAL_ID != "",
    !is.na(Observation_Date),
    !is.na(Pasture_ID),
    Pasture_ID %in% 1:6,
    is.finite(Longitude),
    is.finite(Latitude),
    !is.na(Behavior),
    Behavior %in% c("Grazing", "Resting", "Walking")
  )

whole_season_assignment_audit <- whole_season_source_reconciled %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    Pasture_assignment_source,
    Source_vs_RGP_conflict,
    name = "N_fixes"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    Pasture_assignment_source,
    Source_vs_RGP_conflict
  )

print(whole_season_assignment_audit)

source_rgp_conflict_audit <- whole_season_source_reconciled %>%
  dplyr::filter(Source_vs_RGP_conflict) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Year,
    REAL_ID,
    Pasture_ID_source,
    Pasture_ID_RGP,
    name = "N_fixes"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Year, REAL_ID)

if (nrow(source_rgp_conflict_audit) > 0L) {
  cat(
    "\nNOTE:",
    sum(source_rgp_conflict_audit$N_fixes),
    "GPS fixes had source-pasture versus validated animal-year disagreement.\n",
    "The validated behavior_gps_sf animal-year assignment was used.\n"
  )
  print(source_rgp_conflict_audit)
}


# ============================================================
# 4. DERIVE WHOLE-SEASON WINDOWS AFTER PASTURE RECONCILIATION
# ============================================================
#
# This prevents a bad/stale pasture label from defining the season window.
# The whole season is the first through last Grazing GPS date for each
# reconciled pasture-year.
# ============================================================

season_windows <- whole_season_source_reconciled %>%
  dplyr::filter(Behavior == "Grazing") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Pasture = paste0("Pasture_", dplyr::first(Pasture_ID)),
    Trial_Start = min(Observation_Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    Trial_End = max(Observation_Date, na.rm = TRUE),
    Grazing_GPS_Days = dplyr::n_distinct(Observation_Date),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(as.numeric(Trial_Start)),
    is.finite(as.numeric(Trial_End)),
    Trial_End >= Trial_Start
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Year, Pasture_ID)

if (nrow(season_windows) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No valid whole-season Grazing observations remain after pasture ",
    "reconciliation."
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(season_windows[c("Year", "Pasture_ID")])) {
  stop("Duplicate reconciled pasture-year season windows detected.")
}

print(season_windows)

# Keep the analysis season-date object synchronized for downstream sections.
season_grazing_dates_by_pasture <- season_windows

season_grazing_dates <- season_grazing_dates_by_pasture %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Trial_Start = min(Trial_Start),
    Trial_End = max(Trial_End),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 5. APPLY RECONCILED PASTURE-YEAR WHOLE-SEASON WINDOWS
# ============================================================

behavior_gps_season <- whole_season_source_reconciled %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    season_windows %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Year,
        Pasture_ID,
        Trial_Start,
        Trial_End,
        Grazing_GPS_Days
      ),
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Trial_Start),
    !is.na(Trial_End),
    Observation_Date >= Trial_Start,
    Observation_Date <= Trial_End
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    REAL_ID,
    Observation_Date
  )


# ============================================================
# 6. REBUILD behavior_gps_season_sf FROM THE CLEAN SOURCE
# ============================================================

if (
  any(abs(behavior_gps_season$Longitude) > 180, na.rm = TRUE) ||
  any(abs(behavior_gps_season$Latitude) > 90, na.rm = TRUE)
) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season Longitude/Latitude values fall outside valid geographic ",
    "coordinate ranges."
  )
}

behavior_gps_season_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
  behavior_gps_season,
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
) %>%
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(pasture_sf))


# ============================================================
# 7. STANDARDIZE ACTIVE-AREA KEYS
# ============================================================

active_area_summary <- active_area_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year = as.integer(as.character(Year)),
    Pasture_ID = parse_pasture_id(Pasture_ID)
  )


# ============================================================
# 8. WHOLE-SEASON SOURCE QC BEFORE ANY SPATIAL CLIPPING
# ============================================================

season_grazing_source_qc <- behavior_gps_season_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::filter(Behavior == "Grazing") %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    name = "N_grazing_fixes"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Year, Pasture_ID)

rgp_grazing_source_qc <- behavior_gps_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year = as.integer(as.character(Year)),
    Pasture_ID = parse_pasture_id(Pasture_ID),
    Behavior = stringr::str_to_title(
      trimws(as.character(Behavior))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Behavior == "Grazing") %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    name = "N_RGP_grazing_fixes"
  )

season_index <- active_area_summary %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Year, Pasture_ID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Year, Pasture_ID)

season_source_comparison <- season_index %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    season_grazing_source_qc,
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    rgp_grazing_source_qc,
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    N_grazing_fixes = tidyr::replace_na(N_grazing_fixes, 0L),
    N_RGP_grazing_fixes = tidyr::replace_na(N_RGP_grazing_fixes, 0L)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Year, Pasture_ID)

cat("\nWHOLE-SEASON SOURCE VS RGP SOURCE QC\n")
print(season_source_comparison)

missing_whole_season_grazing <- season_source_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(N_grazing_fixes == 0L)

if (nrow(missing_whole_season_grazing) > 0L) {
  print(missing_whole_season_grazing)
  stop(
    "At least one required pasture-year contains zero whole-season Grazing ",
    "fixes even after rebuilding from behavior_gps_source. This is now an ",
    "upstream source-data problem rather than a grid/pasture-clipping problem."
  )
}

total_source_grazing_fixes <- sum(
  behavior_gps_season_sf$Behavior == "Grazing",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (total_source_grazing_fixes == 0L) {
  stop("Rebuilt whole-season source contains zero Grazing fixes.")
}

cat(
  "\nWhole-season source grazing fixes:",
  total_source_grazing_fixes,
  "\n"
)

print(season_index)


# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# DATA-MASK SAFETY CHECK BEFORE WHOLE-SEASON LOOP
# ============================================================
#
# IMPORTANT:
# behavior_gps_season_sf may contain coordinate columns named x and y.
# Therefore the loops below NEVER use bare y / p variables inside
# dplyr::filter(). They use this_year / this_pasture and .env$...
# explicitly so dplyr cannot accidentally resolve a data column instead.
# ============================================================

preloop_2023_p1_check <- behavior_gps_season_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Year == 2023L,
    Pasture_ID == 1L,
    Behavior == "Grazing"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    N_grazing_fixes = dplyr::n()
  )

print(preloop_2023_p1_check)

if (
  nrow(preloop_2023_p1_check) != 1L ||
  preloop_2023_p1_check$N_grazing_fixes[1] == 0L
) {
  stop(
    "Immediately before the whole-season spatial loop, ",
    "2023 Pasture 1 has zero Grazing fixes. ",
    "Inspect season_source_comparison before continuing."
  )
}


# 9. ASSIGN WHOLE-SEASON GRAZING FIXES TO STABLE PASTURE CELLS
# ============================================================

season_cell_counts_list <- vector(
  "list",
  nrow(season_index)
)

season_gps_coverage_list <- vector(
  "list",
  nrow(season_index)
)

for (j in seq_len(nrow(season_index))) {

  this_year <- as.integer(
    season_index$Year[j]
  )

  this_pasture <- as.integer(
    season_index$Pasture_ID[j]
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Stable 10 x 10 m grid for this pasture
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  pg <- pasture_grid[[as.character(this_pasture)]]

  if (is.null(pg) || nrow(pg) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "Missing pasture grid for Pasture ",
      this_pasture,
      "."
    )
  }

  pg <- pg %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Grid_Cell_ID = as.character(Grid_Cell_ID)
    )

  parent_geom <- sf::st_union(
    sf::st_geometry(pg)
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # All states assigned to this pasture-year
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  all_state_pts <- behavior_gps_season_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Year == .env$this_year,
      Pasture_ID == .env$this_pasture
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Grazing fixes assigned to this pasture-year
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  pts <- behavior_gps_season_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Year == .env$this_year,
      Pasture_ID == .env$this_pasture,
      Behavior == "Grazing"
    )

  cat(
    "Year ",
    this_year,
    " | Pasture ",
    this_pasture,
    " | Grazing fixes before pasture clipping: ",
    nrow(pts),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  if (nrow(pts) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No whole-season Grazing GPS fixes found for ",
      "Year ",
      this_year,
      ", Pasture ",
      this_pasture,
      "."
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Keep only fixes physically inside the assigned pasture
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  in_pasture <- lengths(
    sf::st_intersects(
      pts,
      parent_geom
    )
  ) > 0L

  pts_inside <- pts[
    in_pasture,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  cat(
    "Year ",
    this_year,
    " | Pasture ",
    this_pasture,
    " | Grazing fixes inside pasture: ",
    nrow(pts_inside),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  if (nrow(pts_inside) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "All whole-season Grazing fixes fall outside the assigned pasture ",
      "for Year ",
      this_year,
      ", Pasture ",
      this_pasture,
      ". Check CRS or animal-year pasture assignment."
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Unique ID within this pasture-year subset
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  pts_inside$Season_GPS_ID <- seq_len(
    nrow(pts_inside)
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Assign each grazing fix to one stable 10 x 10 m cell
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  matched <- sf::st_join(
    pts_inside,
    pg %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Grid_Cell_ID
      ),
    join = sf::st_intersects,
    left = TRUE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Grid_Cell_ID = as.character(Grid_Cell_ID)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      Season_GPS_ID,
      Grid_Cell_ID
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      Season_GPS_ID,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  if (nrow(matched) != nrow(pts_inside)) {
    stop(
      "Whole-season GPS-to-grid assignment changed GPS row count: ",
      this_year,
      " P",
      this_pasture
    )
  }

  if (any(is.na(matched$Grid_Cell_ID))) {
    stop(
      "A whole-season grazing fix lacks a pasture grid cell: ",
      this_year,
      " P",
      this_pasture
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Count grazing fixes per stable cell
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  season_cell_counts_list[[j]] <- matched %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::count(
      Grid_Cell_ID,
      name = "Season_fixes"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Year = this_year,
      Pasture_ID = this_pasture,
      Grid_Cell_ID = as.character(Grid_Cell_ID)
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Coverage audit
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  this_season <- season_windows %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Year == .env$this_year,
      Pasture_ID == .env$this_pasture
    )

  if (nrow(this_season) != 1L) {
    stop(
      "Missing or duplicate pasture-year season boundary: ",
      this_year,
      " P",
      this_pasture
    )
  }

  scheduled_days <- behavior_rotation_schedule %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Year = as.integer(as.character(Year)),
      Rotation_Start = as.Date(Rotation_Start),
      Rotation_End = as.Date(Rotation_End)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Year == .env$this_year
    )

  is_scheduled <- vapply(
    pts_inside$Observation_Date,
    function(day) {
      any(
        day >= scheduled_days$Rotation_Start &
          day <= scheduled_days$Rotation_End,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    },
    logical(1)
  )

  season_gps_coverage_list[[j]] <- tibble::tibble(
    Year = this_year,
    Pasture_ID = this_pasture,
    Season_start_date = this_season$Trial_Start,
    Season_end_date = this_season$Trial_End,
    Season_calendar_days =
      as.integer(
        this_season$Trial_End -
          this_season$Trial_Start
      ) + 1L,
    GPS_recorded_days_all_states =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        all_state_pts$Observation_Date
      ),
    GPS_grazing_days =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        pts_inside$Observation_Date
      ),
    Season_grazing_fixes_inside_pasture =
      nrow(pts_inside),
    Season_grazing_fixes_outside_pasture =
      sum(!in_pasture),
    Grazing_fixes_outside_RGP_calendar =
      sum(!is_scheduled, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 10. COMBINE WHOLE-SEASON CELL COUNTS
# ============================================================

season_cell_counts <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  season_cell_counts_list
)

season_gps_coverage <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  season_gps_coverage_list
)

cat(
  "\nTotal grazing fixes in season_cell_counts:",
  sum(
    season_cell_counts$Season_fixes,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)

if (
  nrow(season_cell_counts) == 0L ||
    sum(
      season_cell_counts$Season_fixes,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) == 0L
) {
  stop(
    "season_cell_counts contains zero whole-season grazing fixes."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 11. BUILD FULL WHOLE-SEASON PASTURE GRID
# ============================================================

season_active_grid_list <- vector(
  "list",
  nrow(season_index)
)

for (j in seq_len(nrow(season_index))) {

  this_year <- as.integer(
    season_index$Year[j]
  )

  this_pasture <- as.integer(
    season_index$Pasture_ID[j]
  )

  cells <- pasture_grid[[as.character(this_pasture)]] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Grid_Cell_ID = as.character(Grid_Cell_ID)
    )

  this_counts <- season_cell_counts %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Year == .env$this_year,
      Pasture_ID == .env$this_pasture
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Grid_Cell_ID,
      Season_fixes
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Grid_Cell_ID = as.character(Grid_Cell_ID)
    )

  if (anyDuplicated(this_counts$Grid_Cell_ID)) {
    stop(
      "Duplicate whole-season grid-cell count for ",
      this_year,
      " P",
      this_pasture,
      "."
    )
  }

  x <- cells %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      this_counts,
      by = "Grid_Cell_ID",
      relationship = "one-to-one"
    )

  x$Season_fixes <- tidyr::replace_na(
    x$Season_fixes,
    0L
  )

  x$Year <- this_year
  x$Pasture_ID <- this_pasture

  # Apply the same minimum-fix rule used for the period grids.
  x$Active_Cell <-
    x$Season_fixes >=
    active_cell_min_grazing_fixes

  season_active_grid_list[[j]] <- x
}

season_active_grid_sf <- do.call(
  rbind,
  season_active_grid_list
)


# ============================================================
# 12. FINAL WHOLE-SEASON GRID QC
# ============================================================

cat(
  "\nTotal Season_fixes in season_active_grid_sf:",
  sum(
    season_active_grid_sf$Season_fixes,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Occupied whole-season cells:",
  sum(
    season_active_grid_sf$Active_Cell,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)

if (
  sum(
    season_active_grid_sf$Season_fixes,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) == 0L
) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season grid still contains zero grazing fixes."
  )
}

expected_inside_fixes <- sum(
  season_gps_coverage$
    Season_grazing_fixes_inside_pasture,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

observed_grid_fixes <- sum(
  season_active_grid_sf$
    Season_fixes,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (expected_inside_fixes != observed_grid_fixes) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season source/grid fix mismatch: ",
    expected_inside_fixes,
    " inside-pasture fixes versus ",
    observed_grid_fixes,
    " fixes assigned to grid cells."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 13. WHOLE-SEASON ACTIVE-AREA SUMMARY
# ============================================================

season_active_summary <- season_active_grid_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Season_unique_active_ha =
      sum(
        Pasture_Cell_ha[
          Active_Cell
        ],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    Pasture_area_ha =
      sum(
        Pasture_Cell_ha,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    Season_grazing_fixes =
      sum(
        Season_fixes,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Percent_pasture_active_season =
      dplyr::if_else(
        Pasture_area_ha > 0,
        100 *
          Season_unique_active_ha /
          Pasture_area_ha,
        NA_real_
      ),
    active_ha_whole_season =
      Season_unique_active_ha,
    active_m2_whole_season =
      active_ha_whole_season *
      10000
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    season_gps_coverage,
    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID"
    ),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  )

if (
  any(
    season_active_summary$
      Season_unique_active_ha >
      season_active_summary$
        Pasture_area_ha +
      1e-5,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season active area exceeds pasture area."
  )
}

if (
  any(
    season_active_summary$
      Season_grazing_fixes !=
      season_active_summary$
        Season_grazing_fixes_inside_pasture,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {
  print(
    season_active_summary %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        Season_grazing_fixes !=
          Season_grazing_fixes_inside_pasture
      )
  )

  stop(
    "Whole-season grid grazing-fix counts do not match ",
    "the inside-pasture coverage audit."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 14. RGP-STATUS WHOLE-SEASON QC
# ============================================================
#
# These fields summarize the period/RGP classification across
# the season. They are kept separate from the independent
# whole-season occupied-cell denominator above.
# ============================================================

season_status_fixes <- active_point_cells %>%
  dplyr::count(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    Spatial_Status,
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Spatial_Status,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

for (
  status in c(
    "INSIDE_CURRENT_ROTATION",
    "OUTSIDE_ROTATION_WITHIN_PASTURE"
  )
) {
  if (!status %in% names(season_status_fixes)) {
    season_status_fixes[[status]] <- 0L
  }
}

season_outside_source <- active_grazing_grid_sf %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Spatial_Status ==
      "OUTSIDE_ROTATION_WITHIN_PASTURE",
    as.character(Active_Cell) ==
      "GPS-observed grazed"
  )

if (nrow(season_outside_source) > 0L) {

  season_outside_area <- season_outside_source %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      Year,
      Pasture_ID
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Season_unique_outside_rotation_ha =
        as.numeric(
          sf::st_area(.)
        ) /
        10000
    ) %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry()

} else {

  season_outside_area <- tibble::tibble(
    Year = integer(),
    Pasture_ID = integer(),
    Season_unique_outside_rotation_ha = numeric()
  )
}

season_active_summary <- season_active_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    season_status_fixes,
    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    season_outside_area,
    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID"
    ),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Season_grazing_fixes_inside =
      tidyr::replace_na(
        INSIDE_CURRENT_ROTATION,
        0L
      ),
    Season_grazing_fixes_outside_rotation =
      tidyr::replace_na(
        OUTSIDE_ROTATION_WITHIN_PASTURE,
        0L
      ),
    RGP_classified_fixes_within_pasture =
      Season_grazing_fixes_inside +
      Season_grazing_fixes_outside_rotation,
    Percent_season_grazing_fixes_inside =
      dplyr::if_else(
        RGP_classified_fixes_within_pasture > 0,
        100 *
          Season_grazing_fixes_inside /
          RGP_classified_fixes_within_pasture,
        NA_real_
      ),
    Percent_season_grazing_fixes_outside_rotation =
      dplyr::if_else(
        RGP_classified_fixes_within_pasture > 0,
        100 *
          Season_grazing_fixes_outside_rotation /
          RGP_classified_fixes_within_pasture,
        NA_real_
      ),
    Season_unique_outside_rotation_ha =
      dplyr::if_else(
        Pasture_ID %in% 2:4,
        tidyr::replace_na(
          Season_unique_outside_rotation_ha,
          0
        ),
        NA_real_
      )
  )


# ============================================================
# 15. WHOLE-SEASON GRAZING DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

season_distribution <- season_active_grid_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Season_Gini =
      gini_coefficient(
        Season_fixes
      ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

season_active_summary <- season_active_summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    season_distribution,
    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID"
    ),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    active_ha_whole_season =
      Season_unique_active_ha,
    active_m2_whole_season =
      active_ha_whole_season *
      10000
  )


# ============================================================
# 16. FINAL WHOLE-SEASON QC
# ============================================================

if (
  any(
    season_active_summary$
      active_ha_whole_season >
      season_active_summary$
        Pasture_area_ha +
      1e-5,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Seasonal unique active area exceeds pasture area."
  )
}

if (
  any(
    season_active_summary$
      Season_grazing_fixes !=
      season_active_summary$
        Season_grazing_fixes_inside_pasture,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season grid fix counts do not match the coverage audit."
  )
}

print(season_active_summary)

# The existing production and emission code uses the independent all-pasture
# grid as its denominator; the paired analysis below also uses inside-RGP area.
gps_active_area_lookup <- active_area_summary %>% dplyr::transmute(
  Year, Pasture_ID, Rotation_Period,
  HMM_Area_Start = Period_start, HMM_Area_End = Period_end,
  Active_Hectares = active_ha_all_pasture,
  Active_Hectares_All_Pasture = active_ha_all_pasture,
  Active_Hectares_Inside_RGP = active_ha_inside_rgp,
  Available_Hectares = Pasture_area_ha,
  RGP_Area_Hectares = total_rgp_area_ha,
  Active_Area_Percent = Active_Area_percent,
  Percent_RGP_Actively_Grazed = percent_rgp_actively_grazed,
  Grid_Size_m, Minimum_Grazing_Fixes, Active_Grid_Cells,
  Grazing_GPS_Points, Gini, Grazing_Evenness_1_minus_Gini,
  Active_Area_Source = "HMM grazing GPS occupied clipped 10-m cells within pasture")
if (anyDuplicated(gps_active_area_lookup[c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period")]))
  stop("Duplicate HMM active-area lookup keys")
if (any(!is.finite(gps_active_area_lookup$Active_Hectares) |
        gps_active_area_lookup$Active_Hectares < 0))
  stop("Invalid negative or non-finite active hectares; inspect active_area_summary")
gps_active_area_geometry_sf <- all_pasture_active_grid_sf %>%
  dplyr::filter(Active_Cell_all) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture_ID, Rotation_Period) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Active_Hectares_Geometry_Check = sum(Pasture_Cell_ha),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::right_join(
    gps_active_area_lookup,
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Active_Hectares_Geometry_Check = tidyr::replace_na(
      Active_Hectares_Geometry_Check, 0
    )
  )
if (any(abs(gps_active_area_geometry_sf$Active_Hectares_Geometry_Check -
            gps_active_area_geometry_sf$Active_Hectares) > 1e-5))
  stop("Active geometry and lookup differ")
knitr::kable(spatial_point_audit)
knitr::kable(pasture_area_audit)
knitr::kable(active_area_summary)
knitr::kable(season_active_summary)
```

#### 4.5.2 Map the GPS-Observed Active Area

```{r hmm-active-grazing-area-maps, fig.width=14, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Third requested grid: unique occupied cells pooled across the whole season.
#
# Build the map list from the explicit Year x Pasture index rather than
# split() alone. This guarantees one map object for each pasture-year and
# prevents all six pastures from collapsing into one map per year.

season_active_grid_for_maps <- season_active_grid_sf %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year = as.integer(as.character(Year)),
    Pasture_ID = as.integer(as.character(Pasture_ID)),
    Season_Map_Group = sprintf(
      "%d_Pasture_%d",
      Year,
      Pasture_ID
    ),
    Season_Active_Label = factor(
      Active_Cell,
      levels = c(
        FALSE,
        TRUE
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Not observed grazed",
        "GPS-observed grazed"
      )
    )
  )

if (
  any(
    is.na(season_active_grid_for_maps$Year) |
      is.na(season_active_grid_for_maps$Pasture_ID)
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season map grid contains missing Year or Pasture_ID; ",
    "map filenames would be invalid."
  )
}


season_map_index <- season_active_grid_for_maps %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    Season_Map_Group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID
  )


if (
  nrow(
    season_map_index
  ) != nrow(
    season_index
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season map index has ",
    nrow(season_map_index),
    " pasture-year groups; expected ",
    nrow(season_index),
    "."
  )
}


if (
  anyDuplicated(
    season_map_index$Season_Map_Group
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Duplicate whole-season map names detected."
  )
}


whole_season_area_map_list <- vector(
  "list",
  nrow(
    season_map_index
  )
)

names(
  whole_season_area_map_list
) <- season_map_index$Season_Map_Group


for (i in seq_len(nrow(season_map_index))) {

  y <- as.integer(
    season_map_index$Year[i]
  )

  pasture_id <- as.integer(
    season_map_index$Pasture_ID[i]
  )

  group_name <- as.character(
    season_map_index$Season_Map_Group[i]
  )

  season_grid <- season_active_grid_for_maps %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Year == y,
      Pasture_ID == pasture_id
    )

  if (nrow(season_grid) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "No whole-season grid cells found for ",
      group_name,
      "."
    )
  }

  if (
    dplyr::n_distinct(
      season_grid$Pasture_ID
    ) != 1L ||
      unique(
        season_grid$Pasture_ID
      )[1] != pasture_id
  ) {
    stop(
      "Whole-season map contains cells from more than one pasture: ",
      group_name
    )
  }

  background <- pasture_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Pasture_ID == pasture_id
    )

  if (nrow(background) != 1L) {
    stop(
      "Missing or duplicate pasture polygon for whole-season map: ",
      group_name
    )
  }

  rgp_boundaries <- active_period_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Year == y,
      Pasture_ID == pasture_id
    )

  whole_season_area_map_list[[group_name]] <-
    ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data = background,
      fill = "grey96",
      color = "grey45",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data = season_grid,
      ggplot2::aes(
        fill = Season_Active_Label
      ),
      color = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data = rgp_boundaries,
      fill = NA,
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.55,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Not observed grazed" = "grey88",
        "GPS-observed grazed" = "#2E8B57"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_sf(
      datum = NA,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste0(
        y,
        " — Pasture ",
        pasture_id,
        " — whole-season unique active grazing grid"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        maroto_grid_m,
        " × ",
        maroto_grid_m,
        " m grid; each occupied cell counts once for the whole season"
      ),
      fill = NULL,
      caption = paste(
        "Green: unique whole-season occupied grazing cells.",
        "Black: RGP boundaries shown for spatial context."
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold"
        )
    )
}


if (
  length(
    whole_season_area_map_list
  ) != nrow(
    season_index
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season map list contains ",
    length(whole_season_area_map_list),
    " maps; expected ",
    nrow(season_index),
    "."
  )
}


if (
  !setequal(
    names(
      whole_season_area_map_list
    ),
    season_map_index$Season_Map_Group
  )
) {
  stop(
    "Whole-season map-list names do not match the expected ",
    "Year x Pasture map names."
  )
}

  dplyr::mutate(

message(

)
```

### 4.6 Map GPS Behaviors by Rotation Period

Each map uses the complete parent pasture as context and highlights the active grazing polygon. The first figure separates behavior into rows and rotation periods into columns. The scheduled subdivision is repeated across the three behavior rows so the Grazing, Resting, and Walking locations can be compared against the same boundary.

#### 4.6.1 Create Full-Extent Maps for Spatial Quality Control

These maps display all transformed GPS records before pasture-boundary
filtering and are retained as a spatial quality-control product.


#### 4.6.2 Create Pasture-Filtered Maps by Behavior

Only observations intersecting the parent pasture are retained in the final
map series.

```{r hmm-behavior-gps-maps-pasture-filtered, fig.width=14, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
behavior_gps_map_list <- split(
  behavior_gps_sf,
  behavior_gps_sf$Map_Group
) %>%
  lapply(function(map_points) {

    group_name <- unique(map_points$Map_Group)[1]
    pasture_id <- unique(map_points$Pasture_ID)[1]

    background <- pasture_sf %>%
      filter(Pasture_ID == pasture_id)

    active_shapes <- active_period_sf %>%
      filter(Map_Group == group_name)

    # Make sure every spatial object uses the same CRS
    map_points <- st_transform(map_points, st_crs(background))
    active_shapes <- st_transform(active_shapes, st_crs(background))

    # Retain only GPS points located within the pasture
    map_points_inside <- st_filter(
      map_points,
      background,
      .predicate = st_intersects
    )

    ggplot() +
      geom_sf(
        data = background,
        fill = "grey96",
        color = "grey35",
        linewidth = 0.7
      ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = active_shapes,
        fill = NA,
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 1
      ) +
      geom_sf(
        data = map_points_inside,
        aes(color = Behavior),
        alpha = 0.60,
        size = 0.9
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Grazing" = "#2E8B57","Resting" = "#4169E1","Walking" = "#E76F51")) +
      facet_grid(Behavior ~ Rotation_Label) +
      coord_sf(
        xlim = c(st_bbox(background)["xmin"],
                 st_bbox(background)["xmax"]),
        ylim = c(st_bbox(background)["ymin"],
                 st_bbox(background)["ymax"]),
        datum = NA,
        expand = FALSE
      ) +
      labs(
        title = group_name,
        subtitle = paste(
          nrow(map_points_inside),
          "GPS observations located within the pasture"
        ),
        color = "Behavior"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8)
      )
  })

```
To exclude points that lie exactly on a pasture boundary, replace
`.predicate = st_intersects` with `.predicate = st_within`.

```{r hmm-combined-behavior-gps-map-pasture-filtered, fig.width=14, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    active_shapes <- st_transform(active_shapes, st_crs(background))

    # Keep GPS points inside or on the pasture boundary
    map_points_inside <- st_filter(

    )

    pasture_bbox <- st_bbox(background)

    ggplot() +
      geom_sf(
        data = background,
```
