```{r pasture-use-mixed-model, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Three authoritative Gaussian LMMs. Period models use TRT * SR plus an
# additive RGP effect and Year/physical Pasture random intercepts. Seasonal
# models use TRT * SR and the same grouping factors. Keep required
# Year/Pasture terms even when variance is small or the fit is singular.
pasture_design <- pasture_use_RGP %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Pasture_ID, TRT, SR) %>% dplyr::arrange(TRT, SR, Pasture_ID)
pasture_design_replication <- pasture_design %>% dplyr::count(TRT, SR, name = "N_pastures")
if (any(pasture_design_replication$N_pastures < 2L)) {
  warning("One pasture per TRT x SR cell: management inference is conditional/exploratory; repeated years/RGPs do not create independent pasture replication.")
}

# Assemble final reporting tables from the retained inference grid.
bw_final_statistical_table <- function(model, inference, response, model_id) {
  tab <- inference$cld
  if (is.null(tab) || !nrow(tab)) tab <- inference$emmeans
  if (is.null(tab) || !nrow(tab)) return(tibble::tibble(
    Model = model_id, Response = response, Status = "Inference unavailable"))
  tab <- tibble::as_tibble(tab)
  if (!".group" %in% names(tab)) tab$.group <- NA_character_
  grouping <- intersect(c("TRT", "SR", "RGP"), names(tab))
  mf <- stats::model.frame(model)
  pasture_column <- intersect(c("Pasture", "Pasture_ID"), names(mf))[1L]
  counts <- tibble::as_tibble(mf) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(grouping))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(),
      n_pastures = if (!is.na(pasture_column)) dplyr::n_distinct(.data[[pasture_column]]) else NA_integer_,
      n_years = if ("Year" %in% names(mf)) dplyr::n_distinct(Year) else NA_integer_,
      .groups = "drop")
  tab <- dplyr::left_join(tab, counts, by = grouping)
  get_p <- function(term) {
    value <- inference$anova$p.value[inference$anova$term == term]
    if (length(value) && is.finite(value[1L])) value[1L] else NA_real_
  }
  tab %>% dplyr::mutate(Model = model_id, Response = response,
    EMM_SE = sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", emmean, SE),
    P_Treatment = get_p("TRT"), P_Stocking_Rate = get_p("SR"),
    P_TRT_x_SR = get_p("TRT:SR"),
    Inference_status = ifelse(is.finite(emmean) & is.finite(SE) &
      is.finite(P_Treatment) & is.finite(P_Stocking_Rate) & is.finite(P_TRT_x_SR),
      "Conditional/exploratory; review diagnostics", "Inference unavailable or unstable"),
    Letters = ifelse(Inference_status == "Inference unavailable or unstable", NA_character_, trimws(.group)),
    df_method = inference$df_method,
    Inference_scope = "Conditional/exploratory: one pasture per TRT x SR cell")
}

bw_fit_area_model <- function(data, formula, model_name, scale_name) {
  vars <- all.vars(formula)
  model_data <- data[stats::complete.cases(data[, vars, drop = FALSE]) &
    is.finite(data$Active_ha), , drop = FALSE] %>% droplevels()
  for (name in intersect(c("TRT", "SR", "RGP"), names(model_data))) {
    if (nlevels(model_data[[name]]) > 1L) contrasts(model_data[[name]]) <- contr.sum(nlevels(model_data[[name]]))
  }
  model_id <- paste0("spatial_area__", model_name)
  audit <- tibble::tibble(Model = model_name, Scale = scale_name,
    N_input = nrow(data), N_model = nrow(model_data), N_excluded = nrow(data) - nrow(model_data),
    N_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$Pasture_ID),
    N_pasture_years = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(model_data$Year, model_data$Pasture_ID)),
    N_years = dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$Year),
    Formula = paste(deparse(formula), collapse = " "))
  design <- model_data %>% dplyr::count(TRT, SR, name = "N_model") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(pasture_design_replication, by = c("TRT", "SR")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Model = model_name)
  model <- tryCatch(afri_fit_lmm(formula, model_data, model_id, REML = FALSE),
    error = function(e) e)
  if (inherits(model, "error")) {
    note <- conditionMessage(model)
    warning(model_name, ": Gaussian LMM could not be fitted: ", note)
    return(list(model = NULL, data = model_data, audit = dplyr::mutate(audit,
      Status = "Fit failed", Note = note), design = design,
      inference = NULL, diagnostics = NULL))
  }
  inference <- tryCatch(afri_inference(model,
    emm_specs = if (scale_name == "RGP") ~ TRT * SR | RGP else ~ TRT * SR),
    error = function(e) list(anova = tibble::tibble(), emm = NULL,
      emmeans = tibble::tibble(), pairs = tibble::tibble(), cld = tibble::tibble(),
      df_method = NA_character_, error = conditionMessage(e)))
  diagnostics <- afri_diagnose_lmm(model, model_id)
  list(model = model, data = model_data,
    audit = dplyr::mutate(audit, Status = "Fitted", Note = if (is.null(inference$error)) NA_character_ else inference$error),
    design = design, inference = inference, diagnostics = diagnostics)
}

pasture_use_models <- list(
  ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING__RGP = bw_fit_area_model(
    dplyr::filter(pasture_use_RGP, Grid_Map == "ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING"),
    Active_ha ~ TRT * SR + RGP + (1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture_ID),
    "ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING__RGP", "RGP"),
  INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING__RGP = bw_fit_area_model(
    dplyr::filter(pasture_use_RGP, Grid_Map == "INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING"),
    Active_ha ~ TRT * SR + RGP + (1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture_ID),
    "INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING__RGP", "RGP"),
  WHOLE_SEASON_GRAZING__Season = bw_fit_area_model(pasture_use_season,
    Active_ha ~ TRT * SR + (1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture_ID),
    "WHOLE_SEASON_GRAZING__Season", "Season")
)
pasture_use_model_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(pasture_use_models, `[[`, "audit"))
pasture_use_model_design <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(pasture_use_models, `[[`, "design"))
pasture_use_model_classes <- tibble::tibble(Model = names(pasture_use_models),
  Class = vapply(pasture_use_models, function(x) paste(class(x$model), collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  Is_lmerMod = vapply(pasture_use_models, function(x) inherits(x$model, "merMod"), logical(1)))
pasture_use_descriptive <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::mutate(pasture_use_RGP, Scale = "RGP"),
  dplyr::mutate(pasture_use_season, Scale = "Season", RGP = NA)) %>%

    SD_active_ha = stats::sd(Active_ha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Retain marginal TRT/SR estimates and planned TRT contrasts from each retained
# combination grid; these are distinct summaries, not additional model fits.
pasture_use_marginal_grids <- lapply(names(pasture_use_models), function(model_name) {
  fit <- pasture_use_models[[model_name]]
  if (is.null(fit$inference$emm)) return(NULL)
  is_rgp <- grepl("__RGP$", model_name)
  tryCatch(list(
    TRT = emmeans::emmeans(fit$inference$emm, if (is_rgp) ~ TRT | RGP else ~ TRT),
    SR = emmeans::emmeans(fit$inference$emm, if (is_rgp) ~ SR | RGP else ~ SR)),
    error = function(e) {
      warning(model_name, ": marginal EMMs unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
})
names(pasture_use_marginal_grids) <- names(pasture_use_models)
pasture_use_anova <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(pasture_use_models), function(name) {
  fit <- pasture_use_models[[name]]
  if (is.null(fit$inference) || !nrow(fit$inference$anova)) return(tibble::tibble(
    Model = name, Inference_status = "Unavailable", Note = fit$audit$Note))
  dplyr::mutate(fit$inference$anova, Model = name,
    Inference_method = fit$inference$df_method, Inference_status = "Available")
}))
pasture_use_emmeans <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(pasture_use_marginal_grids), function(name) {
  grid <- pasture_use_marginal_grids[[name]]
  if (is.null(grid)) return(tibble::tibble(Model = name, Inference_status = "Unavailable"))
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(grid), function(effect) dplyr::mutate(
    as.data.frame(summary(grid[[effect]], infer = c(TRUE, FALSE))),
    Model = name, Marginal_effect = effect)))
}))
pasture_use_planned_contrasts <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(pasture_use_marginal_grids), function(name) {
  grid <- pasture_use_marginal_grids[[name]]
  if (is.null(grid)) return(tibble::tibble(Model = name, Inference_status = "Unavailable"))
  contrast <- emmeans::contrast(grid$TRT, method = "pairwise", adjust = "none")
  if (grepl("__RGP$", name)) contrast <- update(contrast, by = NULL)
  dplyr::mutate(as.data.frame(summary(contrast, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
    adjust = if (grepl("__RGP$", name)) "holm" else "none")), Model = name)
}))
pasture_use_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(pasture_use_models, function(x) {
  if (is.null(x$diagnostics)) return(tibble::tibble(model_id = x$audit$Model,
    Status = "Model fitting failed", Note = x$audit$Note))
  x$diagnostics$summary
}))
pasture_use_variance_review <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(pasture_use_models), function(name) {
  fit <- pasture_use_models[[name]]
  if (is.null(fit$diagnostics)) return(NULL)
  dplyr::mutate(fit$diagnostics$variance_review, Model = name)
}))
pasture_use_residuals <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(pasture_use_models), function(name) {
  fit <- pasture_use_models[[name]]
  if (is.null(fit$diagnostics)) return(NULL)
  dplyr::mutate(fit$diagnostics$residuals, Model = name)
}))
pasture_use_final_tables <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(pasture_use_models), function(name) {
  fit <- pasture_use_models[[name]]
  if (is.null(fit$model) || is.null(fit$inference)) return(tibble::tibble(
    Model = name, Response = "Active_ha", Status = "Model/inference unavailable"))
  bw_final_statistical_table(fit$model, fit$inference, "Active_ha", name)
}))
smooth_adg_final_table <- bw_final_statistical_table(smooth_adg_model,
  smooth_adg_inference, "Smooth_Period_ADG", "table2_adg__Smooth_Period_ADG")
pasture_use_model_summaries <- lapply(pasture_use_models, function(x) {
  if (is.null(x$model)) return(capture.output(x$audit))
  tryCatch(capture.output(summary(x$model)),
    error = function(e) paste("Model summary unavailable:", conditionMessage(e)))
})
for (name in names(pasture_use_model_summaries)) {
  cat("\nModel:", name, "\n", paste(pasture_use_model_summaries[[name]], collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}
for (fit in pasture_use_models) {
  if (!is.null(fit$diagnostics)) for (p in fit$diagnostics$plots) print(p)
}
pasture_use_model_audit
pasture_use_anova

pasture_use_diagnostics
```

### 5.10 Interpretation Framework and Analytical Limitations

Use the following hierarchy when interpreting the production and spatial results:

1. **Data completeness first.** Review `Complete_Assigned_Percent`. A low value means the estimated pasture total depends heavily on standardization from animals with complete period-boundary predictions.
2. **Separate animal performance from land productivity.** `Mean_Period_ADG` describes average steer performance. `Gain_per_Hectare` combines steer gain, animal numbers, and active grazing area.
3. **Distinguish active-area and whole-pasture denominators.** Period-specific
   `Gain_per_Hectare` uses HMM GPS-observed active hectares for every pasture.
   Metrics explicitly named `Gain_per_Pasture_Hectare` use the complete reported
   pasture area instead.
4. **Do not treat animal-days or periods as independent pasture replicates.** Periods are repeated observations on the same pasture-year, and the pasture is the treatment-level experimental unit.
5. **Interpret pasture-use contrasts conditionally.** The six pastures contain one pasture per treatment × stocking-rate combination; repeated RGPs and years do not create new treatment units.
6. **Verify GIS metadata.** The current analysis uses explicit CRS assumptions and a geometry-record mapping because the `.dbf`, `.shx`, and `.prj` files were unavailable. Recheck all spatial outputs when the complete shapefiles are available.
7. **Verify rotation boundaries.** Rotation polygons overlap across named
   subdivisions. They constrain the HMM grid and provide map context, but their
   total polygon hectares are not used as the active-area denominator.
8. **Recognize schedule gaps.** Dates outside the supplied rotation periods are listed in `uncovered_schedule_dates` and are excluded from RGP-specific active-area productivity.
9. **Use the requested models with their stated limits.** Period models include treatment × stocking rate × period and random Year/Pasture intercepts. Additional correlation within pasture-year or animal is not explicitly modeled under the requested specification; neither repeated measurements nor more animals can replace independent pasture replication.

### 5.11 Spatial-Analysis Outputs to Retain

The principal spatial-production objects are:

- `pasture_area_validation` and `rotation_area_validation`: geometry-versus-reference area checks;
- `period_pasture_schedule` and `schedule_coverage_summary`: active-area assignments and schedule coverage;
- `spline_period_animal_gain` and `period_boundary_audit`: animal-level gain and exact-boundary availability during each documented grazing period;
- `production_by_pasture_period`: pasture-period animal performance and land-productivity results;
- `production_system_summary` and `production_sr_summary`: descriptive system-level summaries;
- `seasonal_production_comparison`: documented-period and full-window seasonal productivity;
- `period_production_sf`: pasture-period results with active spatial geometry;
- `pasture_use_RGP`, `pasture_use_season`: comparable whole-pasture use responses; and
- `pasture_use_models`: three conditional mixed models, two RGP grid scopes and the directly pooled whole-season response.

## 6. Save Results, Figures, Maps, and Reproducibility Files

This final section exports the report's principal analytical products. Figures
are written automatically during rendering because the Part II setup chunk
directs knitr output to `03_Figures`; maps are written by knitr under `04_Maps`. The procedures below save tabular results, complex
R objects, spatial layers, session information, and a complete file manifest.

### 6.1 Define Export Helpers and Result Registries

```{r bw-define-export-helpers}
# Return a file-system-safe version of an R object name.
sanitize_output_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "_", x)
  tolower(gsub("_+", "_", x))
}

# Convert supported result objects to plain data frames for CSV export.
as_export_data_frame <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "sf")) {
    x <- sf::st_drop_geometry(x)
  }

  if (inherits(x, "htest")) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      method = x$method,
      statistic_name = names(x$statistic),
      statistic = unname(x$statistic),
      parameter_name = if (is.null(x$parameter)) NA_character_ else names(x$parameter),
      parameter = if (is.null(x$parameter)) NA_real_ else unname(x$parameter),
      p_value = x$p.value,
      alternative = x$alternative
    ))
  }

  if (inherits(x, c("emmGrid", "emm_list"))) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x)
  } else if (is.table(x)) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else if (is.matrix(x)) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else if (inherits(x, "anova")) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x)
  } else if (is.data.frame(x)) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Preserve informative row names such as ANOVA terms.
  informative_row_names <- !identical(
    rownames(x),
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(x)))
  )

  if (informative_row_names) {
    x <- tibble::rownames_to_column(x, var = "row_name")
  }

  # Convert uncommon list-columns to readable text instead of failing silently.
  list_columns <- vapply(x, is.list, logical(1))
  if (any(list_columns)) {
    x[list_columns] <- lapply(
      x[list_columns],
      function(column) {
        vapply(
          column,
          function(value) paste(capture.output(str(value, max.level = 1)), collapse = " "),
          character(1)
        )
      }
    )
  }

  tibble::as_tibble(x, .name_repair = "unique")
}
```

### 6.2 Export Result Tables and Complex Analysis Objects

```{r bw-export-result-tables-and-objects}
if (isTRUE(export_results)) {
export_one_table <- function(object_name, source_environment) {
  if (!exists(object_name, envir = source_environment, inherits = TRUE)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      object = object_name,
      status = "not available",
      output_file = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  object_value <- get(
    object_name,
    envir = source_environment,
    inherits = TRUE
  )
  export_value <- as_export_data_frame(object_value)

  if (is.null(export_value)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      object = object_name,
      status = "not tabular; inspect object-specific model export",
      output_file = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  output_file <- file.path(
    analysis_output_dirs$tables,
    paste0(sanitize_output_name(object_name), ".csv")
  )

  tryCatch(
    {
      bw_ensure_output_parent(output_file)
      readr::write_csv(export_value, output_file, na = "")
      tibble::tibble(
        object = object_name,
        status = "exported",
        output_file = output_file
      )
    },
    error = function(error_condition) {
      tibble::tibble(
        object = object_name,
        status = paste("export failed:", conditionMessage(error_condition)),
        output_file = output_file
      )
    }
  )
}
```

# 3. Grazing GreenFeed Analysis


## Introduction

This report prepares and explores GreenFeed measurements of methane (CH4) and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from yearling Angus steers during the 2023, 2024, and 2025 grazing seasons. The experimental structure contains two grazing treatments, three stocking rates, and six pastures. The exploratory analysis emphasizes data quality, sampling coverage, visit frequency, animal-level daily summaries, temporal patterns, and descriptive comparisons among treatment, stocking-rate, pasture, and year groups.

GreenFeed rows are treated as **visit-level emission-rate estimates (g/day)**. In the exploratory RGP1-RGP5 summaries, cleaned unique visits are first averaged within steer and RGP, then contributing steer means receive equal weight in the pasture-RGP mean. No RGP minimum visit count is applied until sampling adequacy is reviewed. Whole-system grazing-season estimates follow the Dressler method: an animal must have at least 40 unique visits with at least 2 minutes of good data and valid CH4 and CO2 estimates, after which the qualifying animal means are averaged with equal weight. Animal-day summaries remain available for descriptive exploration and repeated-measures modeling; days without a GreenFeed visit are missing observations, not zero emissions.

Only observations collected during documented rotation periods RGP1-RGP5 are retained in the analysis. Pre-rotation and post-rotation observations are excluded. The 40-visit threshold is applied only to the Dressler whole-system analysis and is not used to filter the Global rotation-period analysis. The 45-visit target remains a quality-control diagnostic. Separate repeated-measures mixed-model ANOVAs are fitted to the Global pasture-period means for CH4 and CO2; individual visits and animals are not treated as independent experimental replicates.

## 1. Data Loading

```{r gf-load-greenfeed-csvs}
  ignore.case = TRUE
)
```

```{r gf-unnamed-004}
# Correcting the column names and ensuring they match the number of columns

#Use this function to rename the columns, delete the unwanted columns, and apply it to all three greenfeed_ datasets.
clean_greenfeed_names <- function(df) {
  
  df %>%
    # Delete unwanted columns
    dplyr::select(
      -any_of(c(
        "Farm Name",
        "H2 Massflow (g/d)",
        "H2S Massflow (g/d)",
        "Airflow CF",
        "Was Interrupted",
        "Interrupting Tags",
        "Midpoint Since Last",
        "Midpoint Until Next"
      ))
    ) %>%
    
    # Rename columns to R-friendly names
    rename(
      SEID = `RFID`,
      FID = `FID`,
      StartTime = `Start Time`,
      EndTime = `End Time`,
      GoodDataDuration = `Good Data Duration`,
      HourOfDay = `Hour Of Day`,
      CO2Massflow_g_d = `CO2 Massflow (g/d)`,
      CH4Massflow_g_d = `CH4 Massflow (g/d)`,
      O2Massflow_g_d = `O2 Massflow (g/d)`,
      AverageAirflow_L_s = `Average Airflow (L/s)`,
      AverageWindSpeed_m_s = `Average Wind Speed (m/s)`,
      AverageWindDirection_deg = `Average Wind Direction (deg)`,
      WindCF = `Wind CF`,
      CH4BaselineSD = `Standard Deviation of CH4 Baseline`,
      PipeTemperature_C = `Pipe Temperature (deg C)`,
      GasTemperature_C = `Gas Temperature (deg C)`,
      RID = `RID`,
      Source = `Source`,
      Year = `Year`
    )
}
```

### 1.3 Keep GreenFeed Data Within Study Dates

```{r gf-filter-greenfeed-dates, echo=TRUE}
# Parse each timestamp and apply each study window once. These formats and
# endpoints are identical to both former copies of this operation.
study_windows <- tibble(
  Year = c(2023L, 2024L, 2025L),
  StudyStart = as.Date(c("2023-06-19", "2024-06-13", "2025-06-12")),
  StudyEnd = as.Date(c("2023-08-27", "2024-08-20", "2025-08-20"))
)
parse_greenfeed_datetime <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(lubridate::parse_date_time(
    as.character(x),
    orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd IMS p", "ymd IM p",
               "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "mdy IMS p", "mdy IM p", "ymd", "mdy"),
    tz = "America/Denver", quiet = TRUE))
}
filter_greenfeed_dates <- function(df, year) {
  window <- study_windows %>% filter(Year == year)
  stopifnot(nrow(window) == 1L)
  df %>% mutate(StartDateTime = parse_greenfeed_datetime(StartTime),
                Date = as.Date(StartDateTime, tz = "America/Denver")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Date), Date >= window$StudyStart, Date <= window$StudyEnd)
}
greenfeed_2023 <- filter_greenfeed_dates(greenfeed_2023, 2023L)
greenfeed_2024 <- filter_greenfeed_dates(greenfeed_2024, 2024L)
greenfeed_2025 <- filter_greenfeed_dates(greenfeed_2025, 2025L)

# Check date ranges after filtering
range(greenfeed_2023$Date)
range(greenfeed_2024$Date)
range(greenfeed_2025$Date)

# Check number of rows after filtering
nrow(greenfeed_2023)
nrow(greenfeed_2024)
nrow(greenfeed_2025)

```
The printed ranges and row counts are generated from the current input files;
hard-coded counts are intentionally avoided because they change after the
RGP1-RGP5 restriction and any source-data corrections.

## 2. Exploratory Data Analysis

The following section performs descriptive exploration only. It does not automatically delete extreme observations and does not perform treatment hypothesis tests. Because treatment and stocking-rate combinations are assigned at the pasture level, pasture and year must be respected in later inferential models; animal-days are repeated observations, not independent experimental replicates.

### 2.1 Prepare an Analysis-Ready EDA Dataset

```{r gf-eda-prepare-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Analysis windows are restricted to documented rotation periods RGP1-RGP5.
# Pre-rotation and post-rotation observations are excluded here so every
# downstream EDA, model, table, and map uses rotation-period data only.
# study_windows and the parsed StartDateTime/Date columns were created in
# Section 1.3. Reuse them without a second date parse or identical filter.

# Visit thresholds are calculated for quality-control reporting only.
# They do not exclude records or animals from the Global analysis.
minimum_visit_duration_sec <- 120
minimum_valid_visits <- 40L
preferred_valid_visits <- 45L

# Variables required for the core EDA
required_eda_columns <- c(
  "Year", "SEID", "FID", "StartTime", "EndTime", "GoodDataDuration",
  "CH4Massflow_g_d", "CO2Massflow_g_d", "Tag", "Pasture", "TRT", "SR"
)

missing_eda_columns <- setdiff(required_eda_columns, names(df.greenfeed))
if (length(missing_eda_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required columns are missing from df.greenfeed: ",
    paste(missing_eda_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Safe summary functions: return NA rather than NaN when all values are missing
safe_mean <- safe_mean_finite  # Same finite-value and all-missing behavior.

safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else median(x)
}

safe_sd <- safe_sd_finite  # Reuse the already defined finite-value helper.

safe_weighted_mean <- function(x, w) {
  keep <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(keep)) NA_real_ else weighted.mean(x[keep], w[keep])
}


# Flag very extreme values using a conservative 3 x IQR rule.
# The flags are diagnostic only; observations are not removed automatically.
iqr_extreme_flag <- function(x, multiplier = 3) {
  output <- rep(FALSE, length(x))
  finite_x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(finite_x) < 4) return(output)
  q <- quantile(finite_x, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  spread <- q[2] - q[1]
  if (!is.finite(spread) || spread == 0) return(output)
  output[is.finite(x)] <- x[is.finite(x)] < (q[1] - multiplier * spread) |
    x[is.finite(x)] > (q[2] + multiplier * spread)
  output
}

# Convert HH:MM:SS into seconds
parse_duration_seconds <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  parsed <- suppressWarnings(lubridate::hms(x))
  as.numeric(parsed)
}

numeric_eda_columns <- intersect(
  c(
    "CH4Massflow_g_d", "CO2Massflow_g_d", "O2Massflow_g_d",
    "AverageAirflow_L_s", "AverageWindSpeed_m_s",
    "AverageWindDirection_deg", "WindCF", "CH4BaselineSD",
    "PipeTemperature_C", "GasTemperature_C", "HourOfDay"
  ),
  names(df.greenfeed)
)



df.greenfeed_eda <- df.greenfeed %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    SEID = as.character(SEID),
    Tag = as.character(Tag),
    Pasture = as.character(Pasture),
    TRT = dplyr::case_when(
      str_squish(as.character(TRT)) %in% c("Continuous", "C_C", "CC", "CG", "Continuous grazing") ~ "Continuous",
      str_squish(as.character(TRT)) %in% c("Rotational", "R_G", "RG", "VF-RG", "VF_RG", "Rotational grazing") ~ "Rotational",
      TRUE ~ str_squish(as.character(TRT))
    ),
    SR = dplyr::case_when(
      str_squish(as.character(SR)) %in% c("Light", "L") ~ "Light",
      str_squish(as.character(SR)) %in% c("Moderate", "M") ~ "Moderate",
      str_squish(as.character(SR)) %in% c("Heavy", "H") ~ "Heavy",
      TRUE ~ str_squish(as.character(SR))
    ),
    GoodDataDuration_sec = if ("GoodDataDuration" %in% names(.)) {
      parse_duration_seconds(GoodDataDuration)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    across(all_of(numeric_eda_columns), readr::parse_number),
    AnimalID = paste(Year, SEID, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  left_join(study_windows, by = "Year") %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(Year, SEID, Tag, Pasture, TRT, SR)

# Use informative factor orders while retaining any unexpected labels
preferred_trt <- c("Continuous", "Rotational")
preferred_sr <- c("Light", "Moderate", "Heavy")

trt_levels <- c(
  intersect(preferred_trt, unique(df.greenfeed_eda$TRT)),
  setdiff(sort(unique(df.greenfeed_eda$TRT)), preferred_trt)
)
sr_levels <- c(
  intersect(preferred_sr, unique(df.greenfeed_eda$SR)),
  setdiff(sort(unique(df.greenfeed_eda$SR)), preferred_sr)
)

df.greenfeed_eda <- df.greenfeed_eda %>%
  mutate(
    TRT = factor(TRT, levels = trt_levels),
    SR = factor(SR, levels = sr_levels),
    Pasture = factor(Pasture, levels = sort(unique(Pasture))),
    DayOfStudy = as.integer(Date - StudyStart) + 1L,
    CH4_valid = if_else(
      is.finite(CH4Massflow_g_d) & CH4Massflow_g_d >= 0,
      CH4Massflow_g_d,
      NA_real_
    ),
    CO2_valid = if_else(
      is.finite(CO2Massflow_g_d) & CO2Massflow_g_d >= 0,
      CO2Massflow_g_d,
      NA_real_
    ),
    VisitDurationAtLeast2Min = is.finite(GoodDataDuration_sec) &
      GoodDataDuration_sec >= minimum_visit_duration_sec,
    ValidCH4Visit_2min = VisitDurationAtLeast2Min & is.finite(CH4_valid),
    ValidCO2Visit_2min = VisitDurationAtLeast2Min & is.finite(CO2_valid),
    ValidBothVisit_2min = ValidCH4Visit_2min & ValidCO2Visit_2min
  ) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  mutate(
    flag_CH4_extreme = iqr_extreme_flag(CH4_valid),
    flag_CO2_extreme = iqr_extreme_flag(CO2_valid)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Basic verification after conversion and filtering
stopifnot(all(df.greenfeed_eda$Date >= df.greenfeed_eda$StudyStart, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot(all(df.greenfeed_eda$Date <= df.greenfeed_eda$StudyEnd, na.rm = TRUE))


glimpse(df.greenfeed_eda)
```

### 2.6 Count Valid GreenFeed Visits per Animal

For quality-control reporting, a valid diagnostic visit must have at least 2
minutes of good-data duration and a finite, nonnegative emission estimate. Counts
are made separately for CH4, CO2, and visits where both gases are valid. The 40-
and 45-visit targets are displayed to show how much data would remain under a
restrictive individual-animal method. The 40-visit threshold is the eligibility
rule for the Dressler whole-system analysis below; neither threshold filters the
Global rotation-period analysis.

```{r gf-eda-animal-valid-visit-counts}
# Create a visit key so exact repeated exports do not inflate visit totals.
# Animal, GreenFeed unit, start time, and end time identify a visit. The source
# row is used only when the visit timestamp is unavailable.
visit_records_unique <- df.greenfeed_eda %>%
  mutate(
    SourceRow = row_number(),
    FID_character = as.character(FID),
    EndTime_character = as.character(EndTime),
    VisitKey = coalesce(
      if_else(
        !is.na(StartDateTime),
        paste(
          Year, AnimalID, FID_character,
          format(StartDateTime, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
          EndTime_character,
          sep = "|"
        ),
        NA_character_
      ),
      paste0("source_row_", SourceRow)
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(VisitKey, .keep_all = TRUE)

visit_count_by_animal <- visit_records_unique %>%
  group_by(Year, AnimalID, SEID, Tag, Pasture, TRT, SR) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalUniqueVisits = n(),
    VisitsAtLeast2Min = sum(VisitDurationAtLeast2Min, na.rm = TRUE),
    ValidCH4Visits_2min = sum(ValidCH4Visit_2min, na.rm = TRUE),
    ValidCO2Visits_2min = sum(ValidCO2Visit_2min, na.rm = TRUE),
    ValidBothVisits_2min = sum(ValidBothVisit_2min, na.rm = TRUE),
    CH4ValidVisitDays = n_distinct(Date[ValidCH4Visit_2min]),
    CO2ValidVisitDays = n_distinct(Date[ValidCO2Visit_2min]),
    BothValidVisitDays = n_distinct(Date[ValidBothVisit_2min]),
    FirstValidBothDate = if (any(ValidBothVisit_2min)) {
      min(Date[ValidBothVisit_2min], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    LastValidBothDate = if (any(ValidBothVisit_2min)) {
      max(Date[ValidBothVisit_2min], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CH4_Meets40 = ValidCH4Visits_2min >= minimum_valid_visits,
    CH4_Meets45 = ValidCH4Visits_2min >= preferred_valid_visits,
    CO2_Meets40 = ValidCO2Visits_2min >= minimum_valid_visits,
    CO2_Meets45 = ValidCO2Visits_2min >= preferred_valid_visits,
    Both_Meet40 = ValidBothVisits_2min >= minimum_valid_visits,
    Both_Meet45 = ValidBothVisits_2min >= preferred_valid_visits,
    CH4_VisitStatus = case_when(
      ValidCH4Visits_2min >= preferred_valid_visits ~ "Preferred target met (>=45)",
      ValidCH4Visits_2min >= minimum_valid_visits ~ "Minimum met (40-44)",
      TRUE ~ "Below minimum (<40)"
    ),
    CO2_VisitStatus = case_when(
      ValidCO2Visits_2min >= preferred_valid_visits ~ "Preferred target met (>=45)",
      ValidCO2Visits_2min >= minimum_valid_visits ~ "Minimum met (40-44)",
      TRUE ~ "Below minimum (<40)"
    )
  )

visit_count_by_animal_print <- visit_count_by_animal %>%
  arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture,
    desc(ValidBothVisits_2min)
  )

print(
  visit_count_by_animal_print
)

knitr::kable(
  visit_count_by_animal_print,
  caption = paste(
    "Valid GreenFeed visits per animal:",
    "visits must contain at least 2 minutes of good data"
  ),
  digits = 2
)
```

### 2.6.1 Dressler Whole-System Grazing-Season Estimates

The whole-system estimate uses the Dressler method over the complete retained
grazing season (RGP1-RGP5). An animal qualifies when it has at least 40 unique
visits containing at least 2 minutes of good data and valid estimates for both
CH4 and CO2. First, one grazing-season mean is calculated for each qualifying
animal. Those animal means are then averaged with equal weight within each
pasture/system-year. This prevents animals with more visits from receiving more
weight in the whole-system estimate.

```{r gf-dressler-whole-system-estimates}
dressler_eligible_animals <- visit_count_by_animal %>%
  filter(Both_Meet40) %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, AnimalID, SEID, Tag, Pasture, TRT, SR, ValidBothVisits_2min)

dressler_animal_system <- visit_records_unique %>%
  filter(ValidBothVisit_2min) %>%
  semi_join(
    dressler_eligible_animals,
    by = c("Year", "AnimalID", "Pasture", "TRT", "SR")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Year, AnimalID, SEID, Tag, Pasture, TRT, SR) %>%
  summarise(
    ValidBothVisits_2min = n(),
    ObservedDays = n_distinct(Date),
    CH4_Mean_g_d = mean(CH4_valid, na.rm = TRUE),
    CO2_Mean_g_d = mean(CO2_valid, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dressler_system_gas <- dressler_animal_system %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(CH4_Mean_g_d, CO2_Mean_g_d),
    names_to = "Gas",
    values_to = "Animal_Mean_g_d"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Gas = dplyr::recode(
      Gas,
      CH4_Mean_g_d = "CH4",
      CO2_Mean_g_d = "CO2"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR, Gas) %>%
  summarise(
    Eligible_Animals = n_distinct(AnimalID),
    Dressler_Mean_g_d = mean(Animal_Mean_g_d, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dressler_SD_g_d = sd(Animal_Mean_g_d, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dressler_SE_g_d = Dressler_SD_g_d / sqrt(Eligible_Animals),
    Total_Qualifying_Visits = sum(ValidBothVisits_2min),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(
  dressler_system_gas,
  digits = 2,
  caption = paste(
    "Dressler whole-system grazing-season means:",
    "animals have >=40 valid visits and animal means receive equal weight"
  )
)
```

```{r gf-dressler-whole-system-plot, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
gf_eda_figures[["dressler_whole_system_plot"]] <- ggplot(
  dressler_system_gas,
  aes(x = factor(Pasture), y = Dressler_Mean_g_d, color = TRT, shape = SR)
) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = Dressler_Mean_g_d - Dressler_SE_g_d,
      ymax = Dressler_Mean_g_d + Dressler_SE_g_d
    ),
    width = 0.15,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8) +
  facet_grid(Gas ~ Year, scales = "free_y") +

    title = "Dressler whole-system grazing-season emission estimates",
    subtitle = ">=40 valid visits per animal; equal-weighted animal means; RGP1-RGP5",
    x = "Pasture",
    y = "Whole-system mean emission rate (g/day)",
    color = "Treatment",
    shape = "Stocking rate"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
print(gf_eda_figures[["dressler_whole_system_plot"]])
```

### 2.6.2 Aggregate Global Records to Animal-Day Values

A GreenFeed row represents a visit-level estimate. Consistent with the Global
method, the EDA dataset below uses every cleaned, unique visit with a finite gas
estimate and calculates one mean per steer and calendar day. No minimum visit
duration or minimum visits per animal is imposed. Gas-specific visit counts,
within-day variability, medians, and duration-weighted diagnostic means are
retained so that sparse animal-days can still be identified.

```{r gf-eda-daily-aggregation}
# Build the EDA daily dataset from unique visits so repeated exports do not
# inflate visit counts or influence daily means.
daily_greenfeed <- visit_records_unique %>%
  group_by(
    Year, StudyStart, StudyEnd, DayOfStudy, Date,
    AnimalID, SEID, Tag, Pasture, TRT, SR
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    # Total number of unique GreenFeed visits observed that day.
    VisitsTotal = n(),

    # Global gas-specific visit counts use all finite, cleaned estimates.
    VisitsCH4 = sum(is.finite(CH4_valid)),
    VisitsCO2 = sum(is.finite(CO2_valid)),

    # Good-data minutes are descriptive and do not determine inclusion.
    TotalGoodDataMinutes = sum(
      if_else(
        is.finite(GoodDataDuration_sec) & GoodDataDuration_sec > 0,
        GoodDataDuration_sec,
        NA_real_
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) / 60,

    # One CH4 mean per steer per day from all cleaned Global records.
    CH4_g_d = safe_mean(CH4_valid),
    CH4_median_g_d = safe_median(CH4_valid),
    CH4_sd_within_day = safe_sd(CH4_valid),
    CH4_duration_weighted_g_d = safe_weighted_mean(
      CH4_valid,
      GoodDataDuration_sec
    ),

    # One CO2 mean per steer per day from all cleaned Global records.
    CO2_g_d = safe_mean(CO2_valid),
    CO2_median_g_d = safe_median(CO2_valid),
    CO2_sd_within_day = safe_sd(CO2_valid),
    CO2_duration_weighted_g_d = safe_weighted_mean(
      CO2_valid,
      GoodDataDuration_sec
    ),

    # Extreme flags remain diagnostic and do not remove observations.
    AnyCH4ExtremeVisit = any(
      flag_CH4_extreme & is.finite(CH4_valid),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    AnyCO2ExtremeVisit = any(
      flag_CO2_extreme & is.finite(CO2_valid),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    AnyValidEmission = is.finite(CH4_g_d) | is.finite(CO2_g_d)
  )

# Keep only steer-days containing at least one valid gas estimate.
animal_day_emissions <- daily_greenfeed %>%
  filter(AnyValidEmission)

glimpse(animal_day_emissions)
```

### 2.9 Animal-Level and Group-Level Descriptive Summaries

For group descriptions, the code first summarizes each animal across the grazing season and then summarizes animals within the pasture-treatment-stocking-rate group. This avoids allowing animals with more observed days to dominate the simple seasonal group means.

```{r gf-eda-animal-summary}

  group_by(Year, AnimalID, SEID, Tag, Pasture, TRT, SR) %>%
  summarise(

    CH4_median_g_d = safe_median(CH4_g_d),
    CH4_sd_g_d = safe_sd(CH4_g_d),
    CH4_CV_percent = if_else(
      is.finite(CH4_mean_g_d) & CH4_mean_g_d != 0,
      100 * CH4_sd_g_d / CH4_mean_g_d,
      NA_real_
    ),
    CO2_mean_g_d = safe_mean(CO2_g_d),
    CO2_median_g_d = safe_median(CO2_g_d),
    CO2_sd_g_d = safe_sd(CO2_g_d),
    CO2_CV_percent = if_else(
      is.finite(CO2_mean_g_d) & CO2_mean_g_d != 0,
      100 * CO2_sd_g_d / CO2_mean_g_d,

    Pasture,
    Tag
  ) %>%
```

#### Mean CH4 and CO2 per Pasture and Rotation Period

The same date-based rotation periods are assigned to all pastures. For
continuously grazed pastures, these periods provide contemporaneous date
intervals for comparison with rotationally grazed pastures. Pre-rotation and
post-rotation dates were removed in Section 2.1 and are not represented here.

```{r gf-eda-pasture-rotation-period-plot, fig.width=13, fig.height=8}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Assign each observation date to a rotation period
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("rotation_schedule", inherits = TRUE)) {
  stop("Run the body-weight rotation schedule chunk before GreenFeed summaries.")
}
rotation_period_levels <- paste0("RGP", 1:5)
greenfeed_rotation_schedule <- rotation_schedule %>%
  left_join(study_windows, by = "Year") %>%
  mutate(
    Period_Start = pmax(Scheduled_Start, StudyStart),
    Period_End = pmin(Scheduled_End, StudyEnd),
    Period_Days = as.integer(Period_End - Period_Start) + 1L,
    RotationPeriod = factor(paste0("RGP", Period_ID),
                            levels = rotation_period_levels),
    Period_Label = paste0("RGP", Period_ID)
  ) %>%
  filter(Period_Start <= Period_End) %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Period_ID, Period_Start, Period_End, Period_Days,
         RotationPeriod, Period_Label, P2_Rotation, P3_Rotation, P4_Rotation)

# Exact endpoint check against the GreenFeed estimand in the supplied code.
gf_expected_period_ends <- as.Date(c(
  "2023-07-03", "2023-07-17", "2023-07-31", "2023-08-14", "2023-08-27",
  "2024-06-27", "2024-07-11", "2024-07-26", "2024-08-10", "2024-08-20",
  "2025-06-25", "2025-07-09", "2025-07-23", "2025-08-06", "2025-08-20"
))
stopifnot(nrow(greenfeed_rotation_schedule) == 15L,
          identical(greenfeed_rotation_schedule$Period_End, gf_expected_period_ends))
rotation_period_from_date <- function(year, date) {
  if (length(year) != length(date)) stop("Year and Date lengths differ.")
  result <- rep(NA_character_, length(date))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(greenfeed_rotation_schedule))) {
    period <- greenfeed_rotation_schedule[i, ]
    keep <- !is.na(year) & !is.na(date) &
      as.integer(as.character(year)) == period$Year &
      date >= period$Period_Start & date <= period$Period_End
    if (any(!is.na(result[keep]))) stop("Overlapping GreenFeed rotation windows.")
    result[keep] <- period$Period_Label
  }
  result
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate Global visit-level means within pasture and rotation period
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pasture_rotation_steer <- visit_records_unique %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RotationPeriod = factor(
    rotation_period_from_date(Year, Date),
    levels = rotation_period_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(RotationPeriod)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, RotationPeriod, Pasture, TRT, SR, AnimalID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CH4 = safe_mean(CH4_valid),
    CO2 = safe_mean(CO2_valid),
    CH4_Visits = sum(is.finite(CH4_valid)),
    CO2_Visits = sum(is.finite(CO2_valid)),
    ObservedDays = dplyr::n_distinct(Date), .groups = "drop")
pasture_period_days <- visit_records_unique %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RotationPeriod = factor(
    rotation_period_from_date(Year, Date),
    levels = rotation_period_levels)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(RotationPeriod)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, RotationPeriod, Pasture) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(ObservedDays = dplyr::n_distinct(Date), .groups = "drop")

# Each contributing steer has one equal-weight mean in its pasture-RGP cell.
# These exploratory pasture means remain unfiltered until the sampling audit
# supports a specific minimum visit/day rule; qualified steer models are below.
pasture_rotation_gas <- pasture_rotation_steer %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, RotationPeriod, Pasture, TRT, SR) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(CH4 = safe_mean(CH4), CO2 = safe_mean(CO2),
    CH4_Animals = sum(is.finite(CH4)),
    CO2_Animals = sum(is.finite(CO2)),
    CH4_Visits = sum(CH4_Visits), CO2_Visits = sum(CO2_Visits),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(pasture_period_days,
    by = c("Year", "RotationPeriod", "Pasture"),
    relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(CH4, CO2), names_to = "Gas",
    values_to = "GasMean_g_d") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Animals = dplyr::if_else(Gas == "CH4",
    CH4_Animals, CO2_Animals),
    Visits = dplyr::if_else(Gas == "CH4", CH4_Visits, CO2_Visits)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-CH4_Animals, -CO2_Animals, -CH4_Visits, -CO2_Visits) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(GasMean_g_d))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot pasture means by rotation period
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gf_eda_figures[["eda_pasture_rotation_period_plot"]] <- ggplot(
  pasture_rotation_gas,
  aes(
    x = RotationPeriod,
    y = GasMean_g_d,
    color = Pasture,
    group = Pasture
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    Gas ~ Year,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean CH4 and CO2 emissions by pasture and RGP",
    subtitle = "Equal-weight means of contributing steers; RGP1-RGP5 only",
    x = "RGP",
    y = "Pasture mean emission rate (g/day)",
    color = "Pasture"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
print(gf_eda_figures[["eda_pasture_rotation_period_plot"]])
```

### Spatial Map of Gas Emissions per Active Hectare by Rotation

For each documented rotation period, the exploratory pasture mean GreenFeed
emission rate is calculated from equal-weight steer means and multiplied by
the number of contributing animals and calendar days in that period. The
resulting estimated pasture-period gas total is divided by the HMM-derived,
GPS-observed active grazing hectares for the same year, pasture, and rotation
period. Rotation-period identities and dates do not change. Scheduled polygons
remain only as boundary and quality-control layers.

The mapped quantities are therefore **estimated grams of gas per active hectare during the rotation period**. They are descriptive Global-method estimates based on available GreenFeed visits, not direct whole-pasture flux measurements. Pre-rotation and post-rotation observations are excluded.

#### Spatial settings and pasture geometry

```{r gf-spatial-production-settings, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
gf_required_shared_spatial <- c(
  "pasture_area_reference", "pasture_sf", "rotation_sf",
  "pasture_area_validation", "rotation_area_validation",
  "gps_active_area_lookup", "gps_active_area_geometry_sf"
)
gf_missing_shared_spatial <- gf_required_shared_spatial[
  !vapply(gf_required_shared_spatial, function(nm) exists(nm, inherits = TRUE), logical(1))
]
if (length(gf_missing_shared_spatial)) {
  stop("Run the preceding HMM and BW spatial preparation chunks first: ",
       paste(gf_missing_shared_spatial, collapse = ", "))
}
stopifnot(inherits(pasture_sf, "sf"), inherits(rotation_sf, "sf"),
          nrow(pasture_sf) == 6L,
          setequal(pasture_sf$Pasture_ID, 1:6),
          sf::st_crs(pasture_sf)$epsg == 32614,
          sf::st_crs(rotation_sf)$epsg == 32614,
          !anyDuplicated(rotation_sf$Rotation_Key))
gf_expected_features <- c(9L, 8L, 10L, 13L, 12L, 11L)
gf_expected_ha <- c(73.4, 127.4, 161.7, 78.1, 129.2, 179.3) * 0.40468564224
gf_geometry_reference <- sf::st_drop_geometry(pasture_sf) %>% arrange(Pasture_ID)
stopifnot(identical(as.integer(gf_geometry_reference$Ranch_Feature_ID), gf_expected_features),
          isTRUE(all.equal(gf_geometry_reference$Supplied_Pasture_Hectares,
                           gf_expected_ha, tolerance = 1e-10)))
# Boundary and area validation outputs belong to the section that created
# them. GreenFeed reuses those objects and exports only gas-specific geometry.
```

#### Rotation schedule, active hectares, and gas-per-hectare calculations

```{r gf-greenfeed-emission-active-area, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Reuse greenfeed_rotation_schedule, created before the period summaries.
# Its last periods retain the GreenFeed study endpoints rather than the longer
# BW schedule endpoints; no visit-window or period-day calculation is changed.
# Expand every period to all six pastures. Rotation identifiers stay unchanged;
# the area columns are joined exclusively from the HMM GPS active-area lookup.
greenfeed_period_pasture_schedule <- greenfeed_rotation_schedule %>%
  tidyr::crossing(Pasture_ID = 1:6) %>%
  left_join(pasture_area_reference, by = "Pasture_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    Rotation_Number = case_when(
      Pasture_ID == 2L ~ P2_Rotation,
      Pasture_ID == 3L ~ P3_Rotation,
      Pasture_ID == 4L ~ P4_Rotation,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    Rotation_Key = if_else(
      Grazing_System == "Rotational",
      paste0("P", Pasture_ID, "_R", Rotation_Number),
      NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    gps_active_area_lookup,
    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID",
      "Period_ID" = "Rotation_Period"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    HMM_Area_Window_Contains_GreenFeed =
      HMM_Area_Start <= Period_Start &
      HMM_Area_End >= Period_End
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, Period_ID, Pasture_ID)

if (any(!is.finite(greenfeed_period_pasture_schedule$Active_Hectares) |
        greenfeed_period_pasture_schedule$Active_Hectares <= 0)) {
  stop("At least one pasture-period does not have a valid active area in hectares.")
}

if (any(
  is.na(greenfeed_period_pasture_schedule$HMM_Area_Window_Contains_GreenFeed) |
    !greenfeed_period_pasture_schedule$HMM_Area_Window_Contains_GreenFeed
)) {
  stop(
    "At least one GreenFeed period is not contained within its matching HMM ",
    "active-area period. Review the rotation schedules before continuing."
  )
}

# Gas-specific pasture-period means and animal counts were created above as
# pasture_rotation_gas. Convert the pasture identifier to an integer for GIS joins.
greenfeed_gas_per_hectare <- pasture_rotation_gas %>%
  mutate(
    Pasture_ID = readr::parse_number(as.character(Pasture)) %>% as.integer(),
    Year = as.integer(as.character(Year))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    RotationPeriod %in% paste0("RGP", 1:5),
    !is.na(Pasture_ID),
    is.finite(GasMean_g_d),
    is.finite(Animals),
    Animals > 0
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    greenfeed_period_pasture_schedule %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Year, RotationPeriod, Period_ID, Period_Label,
        Period_Start, Period_End, Period_Days,
        Pasture_ID, Grazing_System, Rotation_Number,
        Rotation_Key, HMM_Area_Start, HMM_Area_End,
        Active_Hectares, Available_Hectares, Active_Area_Percent,
        Grid_Size_m, Minimum_Grazing_Fixes,
        Active_Grid_Cells, Grazing_GPS_Points,
        Active_Area_Source
      ),
    by = c("Year", "RotationPeriod", "Pasture_ID")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Estimated_Pasture_Gas_g = GasMean_g_d * Animals * Period_Days,
    Gas_g_per_Active_Hectare = Estimated_Pasture_Gas_g / Active_Hectares,
    Gas_kg_per_Active_Hectare = Gas_g_per_Active_Hectare / 1000
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(Gas_g_per_Active_Hectare),
    is.finite(Active_Hectares)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Gas, Year, Period_ID, Pasture_ID)

greenfeed_gas_per_hectare %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Gas, Year, Period_ID, Pasture_ID, Grazing_System,
    Rotation_Number, Animals, Period_Days, Active_Hectares,
    GasMean_g_d, Estimated_Pasture_Gas_g,
    Gas_g_per_Active_Hectare, Gas_kg_per_Active_Hectare
  )
```

#### Attach the HMM GPS-Observed Active-Area Geometry

```{r gf-attach-greenfeed-emission-geometry, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
attach_greenfeed_active_geometry <- function(
  emission_df,
  active_area_geometry_sf
) {
  active_geometry_keys <- active_area_geometry_sf %>%
    dplyr::rename(Period_ID = Rotation_Period) %>%
    dplyr::select(Year, Pasture_ID, Period_ID)

  unmatched_rows <- emission_df %>%
    dplyr::anti_join(
      sf::st_drop_geometry(active_geometry_keys),
      by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Period_ID")
    )

  if (nrow(unmatched_rows) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "At least one GreenFeed pasture-period could not be assigned its ",
      "HMM GPS-observed active-area geometry."
    )
  }

  result <- active_geometry_keys %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      emission_df,
      by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Period_ID")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Gas, Year, Period_ID, Pasture_ID)

  if (nrow(result) != nrow(emission_df)) {
    stop("The GreenFeed active-geometry join changed the expected row count.")
  }

  result
}

greenfeed_gas_per_hectare_sf <- attach_greenfeed_active_geometry(
  greenfeed_gas_per_hectare,
  gps_active_area_geometry_sf
)

greenfeed_gas_per_hectare_sf
```

```{r gf-greenfeed-emission-per-hectare-map-styled, fig.width=17, fig.height=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
      labels = scales::label_number(
        accuracy = 1,
        big.mark = ","
      ),
      na.value = "grey85",
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        direction = "horizontal",
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5,
        barwidth = unit(5.5, "cm"),
        barheight = unit(0.35, "cm"),

        "Values represent estimated pasture emissions normalized ",

      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey92",
        color = "grey70",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = 8.5,
        face = "bold",
        color = "grey15"
      ),

      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 11,
        face = "bold",
```

## 3. EDA Interpretation Guide

When reviewing the outputs, prioritize the following questions:

1. **Date and merge validity:** Do the observed ranges match the exact study windows, and are treatment, stocking-rate, pasture, and animal identifiers complete after the joins?
2. **Sampling intensity:** How many visits and observed days contribute to each animal and pasture under the Global method, and how many records would remain under the diagnostic 40/45-visit screens?
3. **Daily reliability:** How many steer-days are based on only one valid visit, and do unweighted and duration-weighted daily means differ materially?
4. **Equipment or biological extremes:** Do flagged values coincide with short good-data duration, unusual airflow, high CH4 baseline variability, a particular GreenFeed unit, or a known animal/tag event?
5. **Temporal structure:** Are there season-long trends, abrupt shifts, gaps, or unit-specific periods that should be modeled or explained?
6. **Experimental-unit structure:** Treatment and stocking-rate effects are evaluated with pasture as the experimental unit, year as a block, and rotation as a repeated measurement. Animals and visits contribute to each Global pasture-period mean but are not independent treatment replicates.

## 4. Global Rotation-Period Mixed-Model ANOVA for CH4 and CO2

The descriptive pasture-period models below use equal-weight means of contributing steer means. Sampling adequacy is audited in the final two-scale section of this report; the qualified steer-level repeated-measures models must await a supported period inclusion rule. Pasture is the experimental unit,
rotation period is repeated within pasture-year, and year is fitted as a random
intercept. At the user's request, each gas has one authoritative Gaussian model:
`gas ~ TRT * SR + RotationPeriod + (1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture)`.

The primary model includes treatment, stocking rate, their interaction, and an
additive rotation-period effect. It assumes the same period effect across
management combinations; treatment-by-period and stocking-rate-by-period
interactions are not fitted or tested. Only year and pasture random intercepts
are included. These model
correlation shared within years and within pastures; no additional pasture-year
intercept or residual temporal correlation is fitted. This specified covariance
structure may leave within-pasture-year dependence inadequately represented;
residual checks and the experimental-unit limitations must inform interpretation.
The pasture-period means are intentionally unweighted; visit totals are reported
as sampling diagnostics and do not create additional experimental replication.
The formerly separate fixed-year model is consolidated into the primary model,
because the newly requested specification for that role is identical.

Because the study has only six pastures, the code audits the number of pastures
assigned to each treatment × stocking-rate combination. If a combination has
fewer than two pastures, the corresponding treatment inference is exploratory
and is confounded with individual pasture effects.

### 4.1 Create Global Pasture-Period Model Datasets

```{r gf-model-prepare-animal-days}

# ============================================================
# CREATE THE GLOBAL ROTATION-PERIOD CH4 MODEL DATASET
# One equal-weight mean of contributing steer means per pasture-period
# (the descriptive response; visits are not treated as replicates)
# ============================================================

ch4_rotation_model_data <- pasture_rotation_gas %>%
  filter(Gas == "CH4", is.finite(GasMean_g_d)) %>%
  transmute(
    Year = factor(as.character(Year)),
    YearFactor = Year, # compatibility metadata alias; not a fitted group
    Pasture = factor(Pasture),
    PastureYear = interaction(Pasture, YearFactor, drop = TRUE),
    TRT = factor(TRT),
    SR = factor(SR),
    RotationPeriod = factor(RotationPeriod, levels = rotation_period_levels),
    CH4_g_d = GasMean_g_d,
    Animals,
    CH4Visits = Visits,
    ObservedDays
  ) %>%
  droplevels()


# ============================================================
# CREATE THE GLOBAL ROTATION-PERIOD CO2 MODEL DATASET
# One equal-weight mean of contributing steer means per pasture-period
# (the descriptive response; visits are not treated as replicates)
# ============================================================

co2_rotation_model_data <- pasture_rotation_gas %>%
  filter(Gas == "CO2", is.finite(GasMean_g_d)) %>%
  transmute(
    Year = factor(as.character(Year)),
    YearFactor = Year, # compatibility metadata alias; not a fitted group
    Pasture = factor(Pasture),
    PastureYear = interaction(Pasture, YearFactor, drop = TRUE),
    TRT = factor(TRT),
    SR = factor(SR),
    RotationPeriod = factor(RotationPeriod, levels = rotation_period_levels),
    CO2_g_d = GasMean_g_d,
    Animals,
    CO2Visits = Visits,
    ObservedDays
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

# Audit true pasture replication for the between-pasture treatment structure.
global_design_replication <- pasture_rotation_gas %>%
  distinct(Pasture, TRT, SR) %>%
  count(TRT, SR, name = "Independent_Pastures") %>%
  arrange(TRT, SR)

knitr::kable(
  global_design_replication,
  caption = "Independent pasture replication by treatment and stocking rate"
)

if (any(global_design_replication$Independent_Pastures < 2L)) {
  warning(
    "At least one TRT x SR combination has fewer than two independent pastures. ",
    "Treat TRT, SR, and TRT x SR tests as exploratory because treatment effects ",
    "cannot be separated fully from individual pasture effects."
  )
}

# ============================================================
# SUMMARIZE THE ROTATION-PERIOD MODEL DATASETS
# ============================================================

rotation_model_data_summary <- bind_rows(

  ch4_rotation_model_data %>%
    summarise(
      Gas = "CH4",
      PasturePeriods = n(),
      ContributingAnimalCounts = sum(Animals, na.rm = TRUE),
      ValidVisits = sum(CH4Visits, na.rm = TRUE),
      Years = n_distinct(YearFactor),
      Pastures = n_distinct(Pasture),
      RotationPeriods = n_distinct(RotationPeriod)
    ),

  co2_rotation_model_data %>%
    summarise(
      Gas = "CO2",
      PasturePeriods = n(),
      ContributingAnimalCounts = sum(Animals, na.rm = TRUE),
      ValidVisits = sum(CO2Visits, na.rm = TRUE),
      Years = n_distinct(YearFactor),
      Pastures = n_distinct(Pasture),
      RotationPeriods = n_distinct(RotationPeriod)
    )
)


# ============================================================
# DISPLAY THE DATASET SUMMARIES
# ============================================================

knitr::kable(
  rotation_model_data_summary,
  caption = "Descriptive rotation datasets: equal-weight steer means per pasture, year, and RGP"
)
```


### 4.2 Direct Mixed-Model Analyses

The models below are fitted separately for CH4 and CO2 using the direct Global
pasture-period means. No visit-level or animal-level row enters the ANOVA.

```{r gf-direct-mixed-models, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, dev='svg'}
# One authoritative primary model per gas. Retain all design grouping factors
# on a singular fit; diagnostics flag uncertainty rather than simplify design.
gf_rotation_models <- list(
  CH4_primary = afri_fit_lmm(
    CH4_g_d ~ TRT * SR + RotationPeriod + (1 | Year) +
      (1 | Pasture),
    ch4_rotation_model_data, "gf_global_period_CH4", REML = TRUE),
  CO2_primary = afri_fit_lmm(
    CO2_g_d ~ TRT * SR + RotationPeriod + (1 | Year) +
      (1 | Pasture),
    co2_rotation_model_data, "gf_global_period_CO2", REML = TRUE)
)
ch4_rotation_year_random_model <- gf_rotation_models$CH4_primary
co2_rotation_year_random_model <- gf_rotation_models$CO2_primary

gf_rotation_inference <- list(
  CH4 = afri_inference(ch4_rotation_year_random_model,
                       emm_specs = ~ TRT | SR * RotationPeriod),
  CO2 = afri_inference(co2_rotation_year_random_model,
                       emm_specs = ~ TRT | SR * RotationPeriod)
)
ch4_rotation_year_random_anova <- gf_rotation_inference$CH4$anova
co2_rotation_year_random_anova <- gf_rotation_inference$CO2$anova
ch4_rotation_emmeans <- gf_rotation_inference$CH4$emm
co2_rotation_emmeans <- gf_rotation_inference$CO2$emm

# Use the additive fitted model's reference grids for TRT comparisons and
# letters. Full cells are retained for reporting; the additive period effect
# implies the same treatment contrast across periods within a stocking rate.
# The second
# comparison below asks about temporal differences within TRT x SR and reuses
# the same fitted model; it is not a second statistical model.
rotation_emm_to_df <- function(emm_object) {
  out <- as.data.frame(summary(emm_object, infer = c(TRUE, FALSE)))
  if ("asymp.LCL" %in% names(out)) names(out)[names(out) == "asymp.LCL"] <- "lower.CL"
  if ("asymp.UCL" %in% names(out)) names(out)[names(out) == "asymp.UCL"] <- "upper.CL"
  tibble::as_tibble(out)
}
safe_rotation_emmeans <- function(model, specs, model_name = "Rotation EMMs") {
  emmeans::emmeans(model, specs = specs, lmer.df = "kenward-roger")
}
ch4_rotation_emmeans_df <- rotation_emm_to_df(ch4_rotation_emmeans)
co2_rotation_emmeans_df <- rotation_emm_to_df(co2_rotation_emmeans)
ch4_rotation_tukey_df <- gf_rotation_inference$CH4$pairs
co2_rotation_tukey_df <- gf_rotation_inference$CO2$pairs
ch4_period_emmeans <- emmeans::emmeans(
  ch4_rotation_year_random_model, ~ RotationPeriod | TRT * SR,
  lmer.df = gf_rotation_inference$CH4$df_method)
co2_period_emmeans <- emmeans::emmeans(
  co2_rotation_year_random_model, ~ RotationPeriod | TRT * SR,
  lmer.df = gf_rotation_inference$CO2$df_method)
ch4_period_tukey_df <- as.data.frame(summary(
  emmeans::contrast(ch4_period_emmeans, method = "pairwise", adjust = "tukey"), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
co2_period_tukey_df <- as.data.frame(summary(
  emmeans::contrast(co2_period_emmeans, method = "pairwise", adjust = "tukey"), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))

gf_rotation_cv <- function(data, response) {
  data %>% group_by(TRT, SR, RotationPeriod) %>% summarise(
    N = n(), Mean_g_d = mean(.data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_g_d = stats::sd(.data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE),
    CV_percent = if_else(is.finite(Mean_g_d) & Mean_g_d != 0,
                         100 * SD_g_d / Mean_g_d, NA_real_), .groups = "drop")
}
ch4_rotation_cv <- gf_rotation_cv(ch4_rotation_model_data, "CH4_g_d")
co2_rotation_cv <- gf_rotation_cv(co2_rotation_model_data, "CO2_g_d")

p_ch4_rotation_ggplot <- ggplot(ch4_rotation_emmeans_df,
  aes(x = RotationPeriod, y = emmean, fill = TRT)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ SR) + labs(title = "Estimated CH4 emissions by RGP",
    subtitle = "Global pasture-period means; additive period, Year/Pasture Gaussian LMM",
    x = "RGP", y = "CH4 emission (g/day)", fill = "Treatment") + theme_bw()
print(p_ch4_rotation_ggplot)
```

### 4.3 Combine Direct Model Results

```{r gf-combine-direct-model-results}
# Reuse fixed-effect tests, EMMs and pairwise results from the retained models.
type3_anova_results <- bind_rows(
  gf_rotation_inference$CH4$anova %>% mutate(Gas = "CH4", Specification = "Primary: year random; additive period"),
  gf_rotation_inference$CO2$anova %>% mutate(Gas = "CO2", Specification = "Primary: year random; additive period")
) %>% mutate(TimeEffect = "Rotation Period")

gf_rotation_reporting_table <- function(gas, model_data, inference) {
  ns <- model_data %>% group_by(TRT, SR, RotationPeriod) %>% summarise(
    n = n(), Independent_Pastures = n_distinct(Pasture),
    .groups = "drop")
  p_for <- function(term) {
    row <- inference$anova[inference$anova$term == term, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(row) == 1L) row$p.value else NA_real_
  }
  means <- rotation_emm_to_df(inference$emm)
  letters <- as.data.frame(inference$cld)
  if (all(c("TRT", "SR", "RotationPeriod", ".group") %in% names(letters))) {
    means <- left_join(means, dplyr::select(letters, TRT, SR, RotationPeriod, .group),
                       by = c("TRT", "SR", "RotationPeriod"))
  } else {
    means$.group <- NA_character_
  }
  means %>% left_join(ns, by = c("TRT", "SR", "RotationPeriod")) %>%
    mutate(Response = gas, EMM_plus_SE = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", emmean, SE),
      P_TRT = p_for("TRT"), P_SR = p_for("SR"), P_TRT_SR = p_for("TRT:SR"),
      Letters_Status = if_else(is.na(.group), "Unavailable; review inference diagnostic", "Available"),
      Letter_Comparison = "TRT within SR x RGP; Tukey; common additive period effect",
      n_Unit = "Pasture-period observations", .before = 1)
}
all_emmeans <- bind_rows(
  gf_rotation_reporting_table("CH4_g_d", ch4_rotation_model_data, gf_rotation_inference$CH4),
  gf_rotation_reporting_table("CO2_g_d", co2_rotation_model_data, gf_rotation_inference$CO2)
)
all_tukey <- bind_rows(
  ch4_rotation_tukey_df %>% mutate(Gas = "CH4", Comparison = "TRT within SR x RGP; common additive period effect"),
  co2_rotation_tukey_df %>% mutate(Gas = "CO2", Comparison = "TRT within SR x RGP; common additive period effect"),
  ch4_period_tukey_df %>% mutate(Gas = "CH4", Comparison = "RGP within TRT x SR; common additive period effect"),
  co2_period_tukey_df %>% mutate(Gas = "CO2", Comparison = "RGP within TRT x SR; common additive period effect")
)
all_cv_results <- bind_rows(ch4_rotation_cv %>% mutate(Gas = "CH4"),
                            co2_rotation_cv %>% mutate(Gas = "CO2"))

# Diagnostics are computed once for each of the two retained primary models.
# Shapiro-Wilk complements the residual, QQ and scale-location plots. A
# significant Shapiro test never automatically removes records or refits models.
gf_rotation_diagnostics <- purrr::imap(gf_rotation_models, afri_diagnose_lmm)
model_diagnostics <- purrr::map_dfr(gf_rotation_diagnostics, "summary")
random_effect_variances <- purrr::imap_dfr(gf_rotation_diagnostics,
  function(diagnostic, id) mutate(diagnostic$variances, Model = id))
rotation_random_structure_qc <- purrr::imap_dfr(gf_rotation_models,
  function(model, id) {
    groups <- names(lme4::getME(model, "flist"))
    tibble(Model = id, Formula = paste(deparse(formula(model)), collapse = " "),
      Pasture_random_intercept = "Pasture" %in% groups,
      Year_random_intercept = "Year" %in% groups,
      Only_Year_Pasture_random_intercepts = setequal(groups, c("Year", "Pasture")))
  })
stopifnot(all(rotation_random_structure_qc$Pasture_random_intercept),
          all(rotation_random_structure_qc$Year_random_intercept),
          all(rotation_random_structure_qc$Only_Year_Pasture_random_intercepts))
knitr::kable(all_emmeans, digits = 3,
  caption = "Global Gaussian LMM with additive period; management inference is exploratory with one pasture per TRT x SR")
knitr::kable(model_diagnostics, digits = 4,
             caption = "Global pasture-period Gaussian LMM diagnostics")
purrr::walk(gf_rotation_diagnostics, function(diagnostic) {
  purrr::walk(diagnostic$plots, print)
})
```


### 4.4 Consolidated Final GreenFeed Exports

Each final table is exported once as CSV, each retained model once as RDS,
and the unique gas-per-active-hectare spatial layer once as GeoPackage. Shared
boundaries and HMM active-area layers remain in their originating sections.
Global pasture-period, Dressler seasonal and descriptive animal-day estimates
remain distinct because their weighting and inclusion rules differ.
