## 4. Two-scale audit and conditional animal-level analyses

These analyses retain one row per steer × RGP or steer × season. The pasture is
the experimental unit for management and stocking rate, with one pasture per
combination. Animal-level model intervals therefore describe these six pastures
conditionally; they are not independent treatment-level replication.


```{r two-scale-animal-audit, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
analysis_out <- file.path(master_output_root, "05_Two_Scale_Analysis_maps")
two_scale_dirs <- list(
  tables = file.path(analysis_out, "01_Tables"),
  models = file.path(analysis_out, "02_Model_Results"),
  figures = file.path(analysis_out, "03_Figures"),
  maps = file.path(analysis_out, "04_Maps"),
  spatial = file.path(analysis_out, "05_Spatial_Data")
)
# Include the destination in errors even when the chunk suppresses warnings.
two_scale_write_file <- function(directory, filename, writer) {
  if (!isTRUE(export_results)) return(invisible(NULL))
  destination <- file.path(directory, filename)
  tryCatch({
    parent <- dirname(destination)
    dir.create(parent, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    if (!dir.exists(parent)) stop("Output directory could not be created: ", parent)
    destination <- file.path(normalizePath(parent, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE),
      basename(destination))
    if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows" && nchar(destination) >= 260L) {
      stop("Path reaches the usual Windows 260-character limit. Move the project to a shorter path or use a shorter params$output_dir.")
    }
    writer(destination)
    if (!file.exists(destination) || is.na(file.info(destination)$size) ||
        file.info(destination)$size <= 0) stop("Writer did not create a nonempty output file.")
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Two-scale export failed: ", destination, " (", nchar(destination),
      " characters). ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
  })
  invisible(destination)
}
two_scale_write_table <- function(x, filename) {
  if (!isTRUE(export_results)) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (!ncol(x)) {
    message("No tabular result available for ", filename, "; see the model status audit.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  two_scale_write_file(two_scale_dirs$tables, filename,
    function(destination) readr::write_csv(x, destination))
}
two_scale_save_figure <- function(filename, plot, ...) {
  two_scale_write_file(two_scale_dirs$figures, filename,
    function(destination) ggplot2::ggsave(destination, plot = plot, ...))
}
# Full model IDs stay in memory and in the audit; only disk basenames shorten.
two_scale_model_file_stem <- function(id) {
  substitutions <- c("two_scale__" = "", "ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING" = "all",
    "INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING" = "in", "WHOLE_SEASON_GRAZING" = "whole",
    "Percent_pasture_active" = "use", "Gain_kg_per_active_ha" = "gain",
    "synchronized_window_sensitivity" = "sync",
    "contiguous_endpoint_sensitivity" = "end", "RGP" = "rgp", "Season" = "season")
  stem <- id
  for (from in names(substitutions)) stem <- gsub(from, substitutions[[from]], stem, fixed = TRUE)
  stem <- gsub("__", "_", stem, fixed = TRUE)
  if (!grepl("^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$", stem) || nchar(stem) > 40L)
    stop("No compact export filename is defined for model: ", id)
  stem
}
two_scale_diagnostic_file_suffix <- function(plot_name) {
  suffixes <- c(residual_fitted = "resid", qq = "qq", scale_location = "scale")
  if (!plot_name %in% names(suffixes)) stop("Unknown diagnostic plot: ", plot_name)
  unname(suffixes[[plot_name]])
}
two_scale_productivity_file_manifest <- function(models, diagnostics) {
  ids <- as.character(names(models))
  stems <- vapply(ids, two_scale_model_file_stem, character(1))
  if (anyDuplicated(stems)) stop("Productivity export filenames are not unique.")
  data.frame(Model = ids, Export_stem = unname(stems),
    Summary_file = if (length(ids)) file.path("02_Model_Results", paste0(stems, "_summary.txt")) else character(),
    Diagnostic_files = vapply(ids, function(id) {
      plots <- names(diagnostics[[id]]$plots)
      files <- vapply(plots, function(plot_name) paste0(stems[[id]], "_",
        two_scale_diagnostic_file_suffix(plot_name), ".png"), character(1))
      paste(file.path("03_Figures", "Diagnostics", files), collapse = "; ")
    }, character(1)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# The documented period schedule defines the common date windows for both
# management systems. Values outside these windows are excluded here.
gf_schedule <- behavior_rotation_schedule %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Rotation_Period, Rotation_Start, Rotation_End)
gf_source <- visit_records_unique %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Year = as.integer(Year), Date = as.Date(Date),
    Steer_ID = paste(Year, as.character(SEID), sep = "_"))
if (anyDuplicated(gf_source$VisitKey)) stop("GreenFeed visit keys are duplicated")
gf_visits <- gf_source %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(gf_schedule, by = "Year", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Date >= Rotation_Start, Date <= Rotation_End) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(RotationPeriod = factor(paste0("RGP", Rotation_Period),
    levels = paste0("RGP", 1:5)),
    CH4_2min = dplyr::if_else(GoodDataDuration_sec >= 120 &
      is.finite(CH4_valid), CH4_valid, NA_real_),
    CO2_2min = dplyr::if_else(GoodDataDuration_sec >= 120 &
      is.finite(CO2_valid), CO2_valid, NA_real_))
gf_visit_audit <- gf_visits %>%
  dplyr::count(VisitKey, name = "Rows") %>% dplyr::filter(Rows != 1L)
if (nrow(gf_visit_audit)) stop("GreenFeed visit assigned to more than one RGP")

gf_period_audit <- gf_visits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR, SEID, Steer_ID,
    Rotation_Period, RotationPeriod, Rotation_Start, Rotation_End) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_visits_CH4 = sum(is.finite(CH4_2min)),
    n_visits_CO2 = sum(is.finite(CO2_2min)),
    n_days_CH4 = dplyr::n_distinct(Date[is.finite(CH4_2min)]),
    n_days_CO2 = dplyr::n_distinct(Date[is.finite(CO2_2min)]),
    CH4_g_d = safe_mean(CH4_2min), CH4_SD = safe_sd(CH4_2min),
    CO2_g_d = safe_mean(CO2_2min), CO2_SD = safe_sd(CO2_2min),
    first_sample = min(Date), last_sample = max(Date),
    calendar_span_days = as.integer(max(Date) - min(Date)) + 1L,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(period_days = as.integer(Rotation_End-Rotation_Start)+1L,
    visits_per_day_CH4 = ifelse(n_days_CH4 > 0,
      n_visits_CH4/n_days_CH4, NA_real_),
    visits_per_day_CO2 = ifelse(n_days_CO2 > 0,
      n_visits_CO2/n_days_CO2, NA_real_))
if (anyDuplicated(gf_period_audit[c("Steer_ID", "Rotation_Period")]))
  stop("More than one steer-period GreenFeed record")

gf_threshold_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(c(3L,5L,10L,15L,20L), function(k) {
  gf_period_audit %>% dplyr::group_by(Year, TRT, SR, RotationPeriod) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Min_visits = k, CH4_eligible = sum(n_visits_CH4 >= k),
      CO2_eligible = sum(n_visits_CO2 >= k),
      CH4_eligible_3_days = sum(n_visits_CH4 >= k & n_days_CH4 >= 3),
      CO2_eligible_3_days = sum(n_visits_CO2 >= k & n_days_CO2 >= 3),
      .groups = "drop")
}))
two_scale_write_table(gf_period_audit, "GreenFeed_steer_RGP_sampling_audit.csv")
two_scale_write_table(gf_threshold_audit, "GreenFeed_candidate_thresholds.csv")

plot_gf_coverage <- ggplot2::ggplot(gf_period_audit,
    ggplot2::aes(n_visits_CH4, CH4_g_d, color = factor(Year))) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = .5) + ggplot2::facet_grid(TRT ~ SR) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Valid CH4 visits (>=120 s)", y = "Steer-RGP CH4 mean (g/day)",
    color = "Year") + ggplot2::theme_bw()
two_scale_save_figure("CH4_mean_vs_visits.png",
  plot_gf_coverage, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
plot_gf_variability <- ggplot2::ggplot(gf_period_audit,
    ggplot2::aes(n_days_CH4, CH4_SD, color = factor(Year))) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = .5) + ggplot2::facet_grid(TRT ~ SR) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Unique CH4 sampling days", y = "Within-steer CH4 SD (g/day)",
    color = "Year") + ggplot2::theme_bw()
two_scale_save_figure("CH4_SD_vs_days.png",
  plot_gf_variability, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# A sampling rule is a scientific decision informed by the audit above. NA
# leaves qualifying-model analyses pending instead of imposing an arbitrary cut.
min_period_visits <- if (!is.null(params$gf_min_period_visits))
  as.integer(params$gf_min_period_visits) else NA_integer_
min_period_sampling_days <- if (!is.null(params$gf_min_period_sampling_days))
  as.integer(params$gf_min_period_sampling_days) else NA_integer_
if ((!is.na(min_period_visits) && min_period_visits < 1L) ||
    (!is.na(min_period_sampling_days) && min_period_sampling_days < 1L))
  stop("GreenFeed period sampling thresholds must be positive integers or NA.")
if (is.na(min_period_visits) || is.na(min_period_sampling_days)) {
  message("Review GreenFeed_candidate_thresholds.csv and coverage plots, then set both period thresholds before fitting GreenFeed models.")
  gf_period_qualified <- gf_period_audit[FALSE, ]
} else {
  gf_period_qualified <- gf_period_audit %>% dplyr::mutate(
    CH4_g_d = ifelse(n_visits_CH4 >= min_period_visits &
      n_days_CH4 >= min_period_sampling_days, CH4_g_d, NA_real_),
    CO2_g_d = ifelse(n_visits_CO2 >= min_period_visits &
      n_days_CO2 >= min_period_sampling_days, CO2_g_d, NA_real_))
}

# Whole-season values use qualifying source visits, never unweighted RGP means.
gf_season_audit <- gf_visits %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR, SEID, Steer_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(season_n_visits_CH4 = sum(is.finite(CH4_2min)),
    season_n_visits_CO2 = sum(is.finite(CO2_2min)),
    season_n_days_CH4 = dplyr::n_distinct(Date[is.finite(CH4_2min)]),
    season_n_days_CO2 = dplyr::n_distinct(Date[is.finite(CO2_2min)]),
    season_CH4_g_d = safe_mean(CH4_2min),
    season_CO2_g_d = safe_mean(CO2_2min), .groups = "drop")
gf_season_qualified <- gf_season_audit %>% dplyr::mutate(
  season_CH4_g_d = ifelse(season_n_visits_CH4 >= 40,
    season_CH4_g_d, NA_real_),
  season_CO2_g_d = ifelse(season_n_visits_CO2 >= 40,
    season_CO2_g_d, NA_real_))
two_scale_write_table(gf_season_audit, "GreenFeed_steer_season_audit.csv")
two_scale_write_table(gf_season_qualified, "GreenFeed_steer_season_40visit.csv")

# Chute weights define observed seasonal endpoints; flag missing endpoints
# instead of substituting daily spline predictions or averaging RGP gains.
# BW_combined contains the same Manual rows already converted to kg.
manual_bw <- BW_combined %>%
  dplyr::filter(BW_Source == "Manual") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Year = as.integer(Year), SEID = as.character(SEID),
    Date = as.Date(Date), BW = as.numeric(BW),
    Steer_ID = paste(Year, SEID, sep = "_")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(BW), !is.na(Date))
# Calculate both documented endpoint definitions in one pass. The available-day
# means reuse the contiguous-day means whenever the contributing dates match.
manual_endpoint_summary <- manual_bw %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, SEID, Steer_ID) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(function(.x, .y) {
    available_dates <- sort(unique(.x$Date))
    initial_days <- if (as.integer(.y$Year[[1]]) == 2024L) 1L else 2L
    contiguous_initial <- available_dates[available_dates <= min(available_dates) + 1L]
    contiguous_final <- available_dates[available_dates >= max(available_dates) - 1L]
    initial_dates <- utils::head(available_dates, min(initial_days, length(available_dates)))
    final_dates <- utils::tail(available_dates, min(2L, length(available_dates)))
    IBW <- mean(.x$BW[.x$Date %in% contiguous_initial])
    FBW <- mean(.x$BW[.x$Date %in% contiguous_final])
    initial_bw <- if (setequal(initial_dates, contiguous_initial)) IBW else
      mean(.x$BW[.x$Date %in% initial_dates])
    final_bw <- if (setequal(final_dates, contiguous_final)) FBW else
      mean(.x$BW[.x$Date %in% final_dates])
    tibble::tibble(IBW = IBW, FBW = FBW,
      Start_Date = min(available_dates), End_Date = max(available_dates),
      n_endpoint_records = nrow(.x),
      Initial_BW_kg = initial_bw, Final_BW_kg = final_bw,
      Initial_BW_days_used = length(initial_dates),
      Final_BW_days_used = length(final_dates),
      Initial_BW_dates = paste(initial_dates, collapse = ";"),
      Final_BW_dates = paste(final_dates, collapse = ";"),
      Initial_BW_expected_days = initial_days, Final_BW_expected_days = 2L,
      Endpoint_gain_equivalent = isTRUE(all.equal(FBW - IBW, final_bw - initial_bw,
        tolerance = 1e-10)))
  }) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
season_trial_dates <- season_grazing_dates
bw_season <- manual_endpoint_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, SEID, Steer_ID, IBW, FBW, Start_Date, End_Date,
    n_endpoint_records, Endpoint_gain_equivalent) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(season_trial_dates, by = "Year", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(grazing_days = as.integer(Trial_End-Trial_Start)+1L,
    total_gain = FBW-IBW,
    Seasonal_ADG = ifelse(grazing_days > 0 & n_endpoint_records >= 2,
      total_gain/grazing_days, NA_real_)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(production_animal_assignments %>%
    dplyr::select(Year, SEID, Pasture_ID, TRT, SR),
    by = c("Year", "SEID"), relationship = "one-to-one")
if (anyDuplicated(bw_season[c("Year", "SEID")]))
  stop("Duplicate seasonal steer BW records")
bw_period <- spline_period_animal_gain %>%
  dplyr::transmute(Year, SEID, Steer_ID = paste(Year, SEID, sep = "_"),
    Pasture_ID, TRT, SR, Rotation_Period = Period_ID,
    RotationPeriod = factor(paste0("RGP", Period_ID), levels = paste0("RGP", 1:5)),
    Period_ADG, Period_Gain, Boundary_Extrapolated)
two_scale_write_table(bw_season, "BW_steer_season.csv")
two_scale_write_table(bw_period, "BW_steer_RGP.csv")

# GPS state labels are movement proxies. Five-minute fixes yield observed
# state-hours; missing fixes are not silently imputed to a 24-hour day.
gps_state_records <- behavior_gps %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Year, Pasture, REAL_ID, Observation_DateTime,
    .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, REAL_ID) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Observation_DateTime, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gap_min = as.numeric(difftime(Observation_DateTime,
      dplyr::lag(Observation_DateTime), units = "mins")),
    New_Bout = as.character(Behavior) == "Grazing" &
      (dplyr::lag(as.character(Behavior), default = "") != "Grazing" |
       is.na(Gap_min) | Gap_min > 7.5 |
       Observation_Date != dplyr::lag(Observation_Date)),
    Bout_ID = cumsum(New_Bout),
    Grazing_velocity_m_min = ifelse(as.character(Behavior) == "Grazing" &
      is.finite(Gap_min) & Gap_min > 0 & Gap_min <= 7.5,
      as.numeric(Distance)/Gap_min, NA_real_)) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
gps_bouts <- gps_state_records %>%
  dplyr::filter(as.character(Behavior) == "Grazing") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, REAL_ID, Observation_Date, Bout_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Bout_min = 5*dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
gps_daily_bout <- gps_bouts %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, REAL_ID, Observation_Date) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Mean_grazing_like_bout_min = mean(Bout_min),
    .groups = "drop")
gps_daily_state <- gps_state_records %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR, REAL_ID,
    Observation_Date, Rotation_Period) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Valid_fixes = dplyr::n(),
    Grazing_like_h = sum(as.character(Behavior) == "Grazing")/12,
    Resting_like_h = sum(as.character(Behavior) == "Resting")/12,
    Traveling_like_h = sum(as.character(Behavior) == "Walking")/12,
    DDT_km = sum(as.numeric(Distance)[is.finite(as.numeric(Distance))])/1000,
    Grazing_velocity_m_min = safe_mean(Grazing_velocity_m_min),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(gps_daily_bout,
    by = c("Year", "REAL_ID", "Observation_Date"),
    relationship = "many-to-one")
gps_steer_RGP <- gps_daily_state %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR, REAL_ID,
    Rotation_Period) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(GPS_days = dplyr::n(), GPS_fixes = sum(Valid_fixes),
    dplyr::across(c(Grazing_like_h, Resting_like_h,
      Traveling_like_h, DDT_km, Grazing_velocity_m_min,
      Mean_grazing_like_bout_min), safe_mean), .groups = "drop")
gps_steer_season <- gps_daily_state %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR, REAL_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(GPS_days = dplyr::n(), GPS_fixes = sum(Valid_fixes),
    dplyr::across(c(Grazing_like_h, Resting_like_h,
      Traveling_like_h, DDT_km, Grazing_velocity_m_min,
      Mean_grazing_like_bout_min), safe_mean), .groups = "drop")
two_scale_write_table(gps_steer_RGP, "GPS_steer_RGP.csv")
two_scale_write_table(gps_steer_season, "GPS_steer_season.csv")

# A ratio is reported only when gain is safely positive. The threshold is
# exposed as a review parameter; the alternative is CH4 with ADG as a covariate.
gain_audit <- bw_period %>% dplyr::count(Year, RotationPeriod,
  Gain_class = dplyr::case_when(!is.finite(Period_ADG) ~ "missing",
```

```{r two-scale-conditional-models, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# These unique raw-endpoint and sampling-qualified questions retain the
# user-requested Year and physical pasture grouping. Repeated animals/years do not establish extra
# treatment replication where a TRT x SR combination has one pasture.
conditional_models <- list()
conditional_inference <- list()
conditional_diagnostic_objects <- list()
conditional_model_status <- list()
conditional_model_units <- list()
fit_conditional_question <- function(formula, data, id) {
  # Retain identifiers in the fitted source rows for sample-size reporting:
  # an identifier need not occur in the user-requested model formula.
  model_variables <- all.vars(formula)
  data <- data[stats::complete.cases(data[, model_variables, drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
  result <- tryCatch(afri_fit_lmm(formula, data, id, REML = FALSE),
    error = function(e) {
      conditional_model_status[[id]] <<- tibble::tibble(
        model_id = id, status = paste("Not fitted:", conditionMessage(e)))
      warning("Conditional question ", id, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    if (nrow(data) != stats::nobs(result))
      stop("Conditional model source rows do not match the fitted sample for ", id)
    conditional_model_units[[id]] <<- list(
      n_animals = if ("Steer_ID" %in% names(data))
        dplyr::n_distinct(data$Steer_ID, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_integer_)
    conditional_models[[id]] <<- result
    inference <- tryCatch(afri_inference(result), error = function(e) {
      warning("Inference unavailable for ", id, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(inference)) conditional_inference[[id]] <<- inference
    conditional_diagnostic_objects[[id]] <<- afri_diagnose_lmm(result, id)
    conditional_model_status[[id]] <<- tibble::tibble(
      model_id = id, status = if (is.null(inference)) "Fitted; EMM inference unavailable" else
        "Fitted; management inference conditional on site")
  }
  result
}
bw_season_model_data <- bw_season %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(Seasonal_ADG), is.finite(FBW), is.finite(IBW)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Year = factor(Year), Pasture_ID = factor(Pasture_ID),
    TRT = factor(TRT), SR = factor(SR))
# The within-one-calendar-day endpoints differ from the later first/last
# available chute-day summaries. Keep this unique observed-endpoint question.
bw_season_adg_model <- fit_conditional_question(
  Seasonal_ADG ~ TRT * SR + (1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture_ID),
  bw_season_model_data, "observed_contiguous_endpoint_season_ADG")
bw_season_ancova <- fit_conditional_question(
  FBW ~ IBW + TRT * SR + (1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture_ID),
  bw_season_model_data, "observed_contiguous_endpoint_FBW_ANCOVA")
# Period_ADG is reused unchanged as RGP_Smooth_ADG_kg_day in Section 9.10.
# Its single authoritative animal-period LMM is fitted there, with all
# period inference and final table exports derived from that retained fit.
if (nrow(gf_period_qualified)) {
  gf_model_data <- gf_period_qualified %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Year = factor(Year), Pasture = factor(Pasture),
      Steer_ID = factor(Steer_ID), TRT = factor(TRT), SR = factor(SR),
      Period = factor(RotationPeriod, levels = paste0("RGP", 1:5)))
  fit_gas <- function(response) {
    d <- gf_model_data[is.finite(gf_model_data[[response]]), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(d) < 30L || dplyr::n_distinct(d$Steer_ID) < 10L) {
      conditional_model_status[[paste0("qualified_RGP_", response)]] <<-
        tibble::tibble(model_id = paste0("qualified_RGP_", response),
                      status = "Not fitted: insufficient qualifying animal-period observations")
      return(NULL)
    }
    f <- stats::as.formula(paste(response,
      "~ TRT * SR + Period + (1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture)"))
    fit_conditional_question(f, d, paste0("qualified_RGP_", response))
  }
  ch4_period_model <- fit_gas("CH4_g_d")
  co2_period_model <- fit_gas("CO2_g_d")
} else {
  conditional_model_status[["qualified_RGP_gases"]] <- tibble::tibble(
    model_id = "qualified_RGP_gases", status = "Pending: period sampling thresholds unset")
}
conditional_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  conditional_diagnostic_objects, function(x) x$summary))
conditional_model_status <- dplyr::bind_rows(conditional_model_status)
conditional_emm_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(conditional_inference), function(id) {
  model <- conditional_models[[id]]
  inference <- conditional_inference[[id]]
  counts <- stats::model.frame(model) %>% dplyr::count(TRT, SR, name = "n")
  emm_rows <- if (nrow(inference$cld)) inference$cld else
    dplyr::mutate(inference$emmeans, .group = NA_character_,
      Letter_status = inference$cld_status)
  emm_rows %>% dplyr::left_join(counts, by = c("TRT", "SR")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Response = all.vars(stats::formula(model))[1], model_id = id,
      N_model = stats::nobs(model),
      N_animals = conditional_model_units[[id]]$n_animals,
      N_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(if ("Pasture_ID" %in% names(stats::model.frame(model)))
        stats::model.frame(model)$Pasture_ID else stats::model.frame(model)$Pasture),
      EMM_SE = sprintf("%.3f +/- %.3f", emmean, SE),
      P_TRT = {a <- inference$anova; a$p.value[match("TRT", a$term)]},
      P_SR = {a <- inference$anova; a$p.value[match("SR", a$term)]},
      P_TRT_SR = {a <- inference$anova; a$p.value[match("TRT:SR", a$term)]},
      Inference_note = "Management contrasts conditional on pasture; one pasture per TRT x SR")
}))
conditional_variance_review <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(conditional_diagnostic_objects), function(id) {
  x <- conditional_diagnostic_objects[[id]]$variance_review
  if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
  dplyr::mutate(x, model_id = id)
}))
two_scale_write_table(conditional_diagnostics, "Conditional_model_diagnostics.csv")
two_scale_write_table(conditional_variance_review, "Conditional_residual_variance_by_group.csv")
two_scale_write_table(conditional_model_status, "Conditional_model_status.csv")
two_scale_write_table(conditional_emm_table, "Conditional_model_EMM_and_tests.csv")
if (isTRUE(export_results) && length(conditional_models)) {
  dir.create(two_scale_dirs$models, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(file.path(two_scale_dirs$figures, "Diagnostics"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(conditional_models, file.path(two_scale_dirs$models, "Unique_conditional_LMMs.rds"))
  for (id in names(conditional_diagnostic_objects)) {
    diagnostic <- conditional_diagnostic_objects[[id]]
    for (plot_name in names(diagnostic$plots))
      ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(two_scale_dirs$figures, "Diagnostics", paste0(id, "_", plot_name, ".png")),
        diagnostic$plots[[plot_name]], width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
  }
}

# Pasture-level emission per observed active ha. Equal-weight steer means
# are used; duplicated animal rows are never treated as area replicates.
if (nrow(gf_period_qualified)) {
  assigned_herd <- production_animal_assignments %>%
    dplyr::count(Year, Pasture_ID, name = "Animals_assigned")
  gf_pasture_period <- gf_period_qualified %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR, Rotation_Period) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Animals_CH4 = sum(is.finite(CH4_g_d)),
      CH4_g_animal_d = safe_mean(CH4_g_d), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Pasture_ID = as.integer(
      readr::parse_number(as.character(Pasture)))) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(assigned_herd, by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID"),
      relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(active_area_summary %>%
      dplyr::select(Year, Pasture_ID, Rotation_Period,
        Active_ha_inside_rotation,
        Total_active_ha_period),
      by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period"),
      relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(CH4_g_per_active_ha_d =
      CH4_g_animal_d * Animals_assigned / Total_active_ha_period,
      Sampled_animal_fraction = Animals_CH4/Animals_assigned)
  two_scale_write_table(gf_pasture_period, "CH4_per_active_ha_descriptive.csv")
}

# active_area_summary and season_active_summary are already exported in Section 5.2.
two_scale_write_table(spatial_point_audit, "Spatial_point_classification_audit.csv")
```

## 5. Two independent active-area grids and animal outcomes

For each pasture-year, both 10 × 10 m grid maps have five RGP panels.
**Map 1, ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING**, marks every occupied pasture cell, including
grazing GPS fixes outside the assigned RGP but still inside the pasture fence.
**Map 2, INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING**, marks only cells occupied by grazing-like fixes
inside the assigned RGP and measures their actual area clipped to that RGP.
The same cell is counted once in Map 1 even if fixes occur on both sides of
an RGP boundary. Fixes beyond the pasture fence are excluded from both maps.
CG pastures receive both maps; their two areas should match exactly because
the whole pasture is the assigned area.

The paired tables use *each map's own active hectares* to normalize the
same pasture-RGP animal gain and estimated herd CH4/CO2. BW and ADG are animal
measurements and have the same value on both rows. Ratios for the inside-RGP
map express whole-herd outcomes per inside-RGP active hectare; they do not
claim that gain or gas was measured at particular GPS cells. Gas estimates
are descriptive GreenFeed means and are reported only for a matching RGP
date window. No allocation by GPS-fix share is made.

```{r rgp-map-outcome-components, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rgp_bw_context <- spline_period_animal_gain %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture_ID, Period_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Mean_start_BW_kg = safe_mean_finite(Start_Fitted_BW),
    Mean_end_BW_kg = safe_mean_finite(End_Fitted_BW),
    Complete_BW_steers = sum(Complete_Period_Boundaries),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Rotation_Period = Period_ID)
rgp_bw_context <- rgp_bw_context %>%
  dplyr::left_join(production_by_pasture_period %>%
    dplyr::transmute(Year, Pasture_ID,
      Rotation_Period = Period_ID, BW_start = Analysis_Start,
      BW_end = Analysis_End, Mean_ADG_kg_day = Mean_Period_ADG,
      Estimated_pasture_gain_kg = Estimated_Total_Pasture_Gain,
      Animals_assigned = Animals_Assigned),
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period"),
    relationship = "one-to-one")
if (anyDuplicated(rgp_bw_context[c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period")]))
  stop("Duplicated BW pasture-RGP outcomes")

rgp_gas_context <- pasture_rotation_gas %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Year = as.integer(Year),
    Pasture_ID = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(Pasture))),
    Rotation_Period = as.integer(readr::parse_number(as.character(RotationPeriod)))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Pasture_ID, Rotation_Period, Gas,
    GasMean_g_d, Animals, Visits) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Gas,
    values_from = c(GasMean_g_d, Animals, Visits)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(CH4_g_animal_day = GasMean_g_d_CH4,
    CO2_g_animal_day = GasMean_g_d_CO2,
    CH4_steers_sampled = Animals_CH4,
    CO2_steers_sampled = Animals_CO2,
    CH4_visits = Visits_CH4, CO2_visits = Visits_CO2)
if (anyDuplicated(rgp_gas_context[c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period")]))
  stop("Duplicated gas pasture-RGP outcomes")

rgp_gas_windows <- greenfeed_period_pasture_schedule %>%
  dplyr::transmute(Year, Pasture_ID,
    Rotation_Period = Period_ID,
    GF_start = Period_Start, GF_end = Period_End)
if (anyDuplicated(rgp_gas_windows[c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period")]))
  stop("Duplicated GreenFeed RGP schedule")

# Two independently computed grid denominators, one row per map/RGP.
rgp_map_scopes <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  active_area_summary %>% dplyr::transmute(
    Year, Pasture_ID, TRT, SR, Rotation_Period,
    RGP = paste0("RGP", Rotation_Period),
    RGP_start = Period_start, RGP_end = Period_end,
    RGP_days = Period_days, Pasture_area_ha,
    Available_ha_rotation, Grid_Size_m,
    Grid_Map = "ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING",
    Active_ha = Total_active_ha_period,
    Grazing_fixes = N_grazing_fixes_inside +
      N_grazing_fixes_outside_rotation),
  active_area_summary %>% dplyr::transmute(
    Year, Pasture_ID, TRT, SR, Rotation_Period,
    RGP = paste0("RGP", Rotation_Period),
    RGP_start = Period_start, RGP_end = Period_end,
    RGP_days = Period_days, Pasture_area_ha,
    Available_ha_rotation, Grid_Size_m,
    Grid_Map = "INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING",
    Active_ha = Active_ha_inside_rotation,
    Grazing_fixes = N_grazing_fixes_inside)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(rgp_bw_context,
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period"),
    relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(rgp_gas_context,
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period"),
    relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(rgp_gas_windows,
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period"),
    relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    BW_window_matches_RGP = !is.na(BW_start) & !is.na(BW_end) &
      BW_start == RGP_start & BW_end == RGP_end,
    GF_window_matches_RGP = !is.na(GF_start) & !is.na(GF_end) &
      GF_start == RGP_start & GF_end == RGP_end,
    Percent_pasture_active = 100 * Active_ha / Pasture_area_ha,
    Percent_assigned_RGP_active = ifelse(
      Grid_Map == "INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING",
      100 * Active_ha / Available_ha_rotation, NA_real_),
    Gain_kg = ifelse(BW_window_matches_RGP,
      Estimated_pasture_gain_kg, NA_real_),
    Gain_kg_per_active_ha = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      Gain_kg / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    Gain_kg_per_active_ha_day = ifelse(Active_ha > 0 & RGP_days > 0,
      Gain_kg / Active_ha / RGP_days, NA_real_),
    Animals_per_active_ha = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      Animals_assigned / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    Animal_days_per_active_ha = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      Animals_assigned * RGP_days / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    CH4_g_herd_day = ifelse(GF_window_matches_RGP,
      CH4_g_animal_day * Animals_assigned, NA_real_),
    CO2_g_herd_day = ifelse(GF_window_matches_RGP,
      CO2_g_animal_day * Animals_assigned, NA_real_),
    CH4_g_herd_RGP = CH4_g_herd_day * RGP_days,
    CO2_g_herd_RGP = CO2_g_herd_day * RGP_days,
    CH4_g_per_active_ha_day = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      CH4_g_herd_day / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    CO2_g_per_active_ha_day = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      CO2_g_herd_day / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    CH4_g_per_active_ha_RGP = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      CH4_g_herd_RGP / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    CO2_g_per_active_ha_RGP = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      CO2_g_herd_RGP / Active_ha, NA_real_)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Year, Pasture_ID, Rotation_Period, Grid_Map)

map_keys <- c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period", "Grid_Map")
if (anyDuplicated(rgp_map_scopes[map_keys]))
  stop("Duplicate two-grid pasture-RGP keys")
map_scope_audit <- rgp_map_scopes %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(map_keys), Active_ha, Grazing_fixes) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Grid_Map,
    values_from = c(Active_ha, Grazing_fixes))
if (nrow(map_scope_audit) != nrow(active_area_summary) ||
    any(!is.finite(rgp_map_scopes$Active_ha)) ||
    any(map_scope_audit$Active_ha_INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING >
        map_scope_audit$Active_ha_ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING + 1e-5) ||
    any(map_scope_audit$Grazing_fixes_INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING >
        map_scope_audit$Grazing_fixes_ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING))
  stop("Independent RGP grid areas/fix counts did not reconcile")
cg_rows <- rgp_map_scopes %>% dplyr::filter(Pasture_ID %in% c(1L,5L,6L))
cg_check <- cg_rows %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(map_keys), Active_ha) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Grid_Map, values_from = Active_ha)
if (any(abs(cg_check$ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING -
            cg_check$INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING) > 1e-5))
  stop("CG inside-RGP and all-pasture areas should be identical")

rgp_map_summary <- rgp_map_scopes %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, TRT, SR, RGP, Grid_Map) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    N_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(Pasture_ID),
    Active_ha = mean(Active_ha),
    Percent_pasture_active = mean(Percent_pasture_active),
    Mean_ADG_kg_day = safe_mean_finite(Mean_ADG_kg_day),
    Gain_kg_per_active_ha = safe_mean_finite(Gain_kg_per_active_ha),
    CH4_g_per_active_ha_day = safe_mean_finite(CH4_g_per_active_ha_day),
    CO2_g_per_active_ha_day = safe_mean_finite(CO2_g_per_active_ha_day),
    .groups = "drop")
if (export_results) {
  two_scale_write_table(rgp_map_scopes, "RGP_two_grid_BW_ADG_GHG_per_active_ha.csv")
  two_scale_write_table(map_scope_audit, "RGP_two_grid_area_audit.csv")
  two_scale_write_table(rgp_map_summary, "RGP_two_grid_TRT_summary.csv")
}
knitr::kable(rgp_map_scopes %>% dplyr::select(
  Year, Pasture_ID, RGP, Grid_Map, Active_ha, Grazing_fixes,
  Percent_pasture_active, Mean_start_BW_kg, Mean_end_BW_kg,
  Mean_ADG_kg_day, Gain_kg_per_active_ha,
  CH4_g_animal_day, CO2_g_animal_day,
  CH4_g_per_active_ha_day, CO2_g_per_active_ha_day,
  BW_window_matches_RGP, GF_window_matches_RGP))
```

```{r rgp-two-independent-grid-maps, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
clean_sf_for_plot <- function(
    x,
    object_name
) {

  if (!inherits(x, "sf")) {
    stop(
      object_name,
      " is not an sf object."
    )
  }


  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    return(x)
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Remove missing geometries
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  geom_missing <- vapply(
    sf::st_geometry(x),
    is.null,
    logical(1)
  )

  if (any(geom_missing)) {

    warning(
      object_name,
      ": removing ",
      sum(geom_missing),
      " NULL geometry row(s)."
    )

    x <- x[
      !geom_missing,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    return(x)
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Remove empty geometries
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  empty_geom <- sf::st_is_empty(x)

  empty_geom[
    is.na(empty_geom)
  ] <- TRUE


  if (any(empty_geom)) {

    warning(
      object_name,
      ": removing ",
      sum(empty_geom),
      " empty geometry row(s)."
    )

    x <- x[
      !empty_geom,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    return(x)
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Make geometry valid
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  x <- suppressWarnings(
    sf::st_make_valid(x)
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Final empty check after st_make_valid()
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  empty_after <- sf::st_is_empty(x)

  empty_after[
    is.na(empty_after)
  ] <- TRUE


  if (any(empty_after)) {

    x <- x[
      !empty_after,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }


  x
}


# ============================================================
# 2. STANDARDIZE RGP LABELS
# ============================================================

rgp_levels <- paste0(
  "RGP",
  1:5
)


all_pasture_active_grid_sf <-
  all_pasture_active_grid_sf %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Year =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Year)
      ),

    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      ),

    Rotation_Period =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Rotation_Period)
      ),

    Rotation_Label =
      factor(
        paste0(
          "RGP",
          Rotation_Period
        ),
        levels = rgp_levels
      )
  )


active_grazing_grid_sf <-
  active_grazing_grid_sf %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Year =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Year)
      ),

    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      ),

    Rotation_Period =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Rotation_Period)
      ),

    Rotation_Label =
      factor(
        paste0(
          "RGP",
          Rotation_Period
        ),
        levels = rgp_levels
      )
  )


active_period_sf <-
  active_period_sf %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Year =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Year)
      ),

    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      ),

    Rotation_Period =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Rotation_Period)
      ),

    Rotation_Label =
      factor(
        paste0(
          "RGP",
          Rotation_Period
        ),
        levels = rgp_levels
      )
  )


pasture_sf <-
  pasture_sf %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      )
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. PLOT INDEX
# ============================================================

rgp_plot_index <-
  rgp_map_scopes %>%
  dplyr::transmute(

    Year =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Year)
      ),

    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID
  )


if (nrow(rgp_plot_index) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "rgp_plot_index contains zero Year x Pasture combinations."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 4. INVENTORY
# ============================================================

rgp_map_inventory <- list()


# ============================================================
# 5. LOOP THROUGH YEAR × PASTURE
# ============================================================

for (
  i in seq_len(
    nrow(rgp_plot_index)
  )
) {

  this_year <-
    as.integer(
      rgp_plot_index$Year[i]
    )


  this_pasture <-
    as.integer(
      rgp_plot_index$Pasture_ID[i]
    )


  message(
    "\n========================================\n",
    "RGP MAP: Year ",
    this_year,
    " | Pasture ",
    this_pasture,
    "\n========================================"
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # 5.1 PARENT PASTURE
  # ==========================================================

  parent <-
    pasture_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Pasture_ID ==
        .env$this_pasture
    )


  if (nrow(parent) == 0L) {

    stop(
      "No parent pasture polygon for P",
      this_pasture,
      "."
    )
  }


  parent <-
    clean_sf_for_plot(
      parent,
      paste0(
        "parent pasture P",
        this_pasture
      )
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # 5.2 ASSIGNED RGP POLYGONS
  # ==========================================================

  assigned <-
    active_period_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Year ==
        .env$this_year,
      Pasture_ID ==
        .env$this_pasture
    )


  assigned <-
    clean_sf_for_plot(
      assigned,
      paste0(
        "assigned RGP ",
        this_year,
        " P",
        this_pasture
      )
    )


  if (
    nrow(assigned) != 5L ||
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        assigned$Rotation_Period
      ) != 5L
  ) {

    print(
      assigned %>%
        sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
        dplyr::select(
          Year,
          Pasture_ID,
          Rotation_Period,
          Rotation_Label
        )
    )


    stop(
      "Expected exactly five assigned RGP polygons for ",
      this_year,
      " P",
      this_pasture,
      ". Found ",
      nrow(assigned),
      "."
    )
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # 5.3 FULL PASTURE GRID
  # ==========================================================

  pasture_cells <-
    all_pasture_active_grid_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Year ==
        .env$this_year,
      Pasture_ID ==
        .env$this_pasture
    )


  pasture_cells <-
    clean_sf_for_plot(
      pasture_cells,
      paste0(
        "all-pasture grid ",
        this_year,
        " P",
        this_pasture
      )
    )


  if (
    nrow(pasture_cells) == 0L
  ) {

    stop(
      "No all-pasture grid cells for ",
      this_year,
      " P",
      this_pasture,
      "."
    )
  }


  if (
    dplyr::n_distinct(
      pasture_cells$Rotation_Period
    ) != 5L
  ) {

    stop(
      "Expected five RGP periods in pasture grid for ",
      this_year,
      " P",
      this_pasture,
      "."
    )
  }


  # ==========================================================
  # 5.4 INSIDE-RGP ACTIVE CELLS
  # ==========================================================

  inside_cells <-
    active_grazing_grid_sf %>%
    dplyr::filter(

      Year ==
        .env$this_year,

      Pasture_ID ==
        .env$this_pasture,

      Spatial_Status ==
        "INSIDE_CURRENT_ROTATION",

      as.character(
        Active_Cell
      ) ==
        "GPS-observed grazed"
    )


  inside_cells <-
    clean_sf_for_plot(
      inside_cells,
      paste0(
        "inside-RGP cells ",
        this_year,
        " P",
        this_pasture
      )
    )


  # ==========================================================
  # 6. TWO MAP SCOPES
  # ==========================================================

  for (
    scope in c(
      "ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING",
      "INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING"
    )
  ) {

    map_all <-
      identical(
        scope,
        "ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING"
      )


    message(
      "Building: ",
      scope
    )


    # ========================================================
    # 6.1 ACTIVE CELLS FOR THIS MAP
    # ========================================================

    if (map_all) {

      active_cells <-
        pasture_cells %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          Active_Cell_all
        )

    } else {

      active_cells <-
        inside_cells
    }


    active_cells <-
      clean_sf_for_plot(
        active_cells,
        paste0(
          scope,
          " ",
          this_year,
          " P",
          this_pasture
        )
      )


    # ========================================================
    # 6.2 PANEL AUDIT
    # ========================================================

    if (
      nrow(active_cells) > 0L
    ) {

      panel_geometry <-
        active_cells %>%
        sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
        dplyr::group_by(
          Rotation_Period
        ) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(

          Geometry_active_ha =
            if (map_all) {

              sum(
                Pasture_Cell_ha,
                na.rm = TRUE
              )

            } else {

              sum(
                Cell_Area_ha,
                na.rm = TRUE
              )
            },

          .groups = "drop"
        )

    } else {

      panel_geometry <-
        tibble::tibble(

          Rotation_Period =
            integer(0),

          Geometry_active_ha =
            numeric(0)
        )
    }


    panel_table <-
      rgp_map_scopes %>%
      dplyr::mutate(

        Year =
          as.integer(
            as.character(Year)
          ),

        Pasture_ID =
          as.integer(
            as.character(Pasture_ID)
          ),

        Rotation_Period =
          as.integer(
            as.character(Rotation_Period)
          )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(

        Year ==
          .env$this_year,

        Pasture_ID ==
          .env$this_pasture,

        Grid_Map ==
          .env$scope
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(

        Rotation_Period,

        Table_active_ha =
          Active_ha
      )


    panel_audit <-
      panel_geometry %>%
      dplyr::right_join(

        panel_table,

        by =
          "Rotation_Period",

        relationship =
          "one-to-one"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(

        Geometry_active_ha =
          tidyr::replace_na(
            Geometry_active_ha,
            0
          )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        Rotation_Period
      )


    if (
      nrow(panel_audit) != 5L
    ) {

      print(
        panel_audit
      )

      stop(
        "Expected five RGP rows in panel audit: ",
        this_year,
        " P",
        this_pasture,
        " ",
        scope
      )
    }


    area_difference <-
      abs(
        panel_audit$Geometry_active_ha -
          panel_audit$Table_active_ha
      )


    if (
      any(
        !is.finite(area_difference)
      ) ||
      any(
        area_difference > 1e-5
      )
    ) {

      print(
        panel_audit
      )

      stop(
        "Grid map differs from active-hectare table: ",
        this_year,
        " P",
        this_pasture,
        " ",
        scope
      )
    }


    # ========================================================
    # 6.3 FACET BACKGROUND
    #
    # pasture_cells already contains all five RGP periods.
    # This guarantees all five facets even when one RGP has
    # zero active cells.
    # ========================================================

    facet_background <-
      pasture_cells %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Rotation_Label =
          factor(
            Rotation_Label,
            levels =
              rgp_levels
          )
      )


    assigned_plot <-
      assigned %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Rotation_Label =
          factor(
            Rotation_Label,
            levels =
              rgp_levels
          )
      )


    if (
      nrow(active_cells) > 0L
    ) {

      active_cells <-
        active_cells %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          Rotation_Label =
            factor(
              Rotation_Label,
              levels =
                rgp_levels
            )
        )
    }


    # ========================================================
    # 6.4 BUILD MAP
    # ========================================================

    map_plot <-
      ggplot2::ggplot() +


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Full pasture grid background
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      ggplot2::geom_sf(

        data =
          facet_background,

        fill =
          "grey88",

        color =
          NA
      ) +


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Active cells
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      {
        if (
          nrow(active_cells) > 0L
        ) {

          ggplot2::geom_sf(

            data =
              active_cells,

            fill =
              "#2E8B57",

            color =
              NA
          )

        } else {

          NULL
        }
      } +


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Pasture boundary
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      ggplot2::geom_sf(

        data =
          parent,

        fill =
          NA,

        color =
          "grey50",

        linewidth =
          0.55
      ) +


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Assigned RGP boundary
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      ggplot2::geom_sf(

        data =
          assigned_plot,

        fill =
          NA,

        color =
          "black",

        linewidth =
          0.9
      ) +


      # ------------------------------------------------------
      # Five RGP panels
      # ------------------------------------------------------

      ggplot2::facet_wrap(

        ~ Rotation_Label,

        ncol =
          3,

        drop =
          FALSE
      ) +


      ggplot2::coord_sf(

        datum =
          NA,

        expand =
          FALSE
      ) +


      ggplot2::labs(

        title =
          paste0(
            this_year,
            " — Pasture_",
            this_pasture,
            " — ",
            if (map_all) {
              "all-pasture active grazing"
            } else {
              "active grazing inside assigned RGP"
            }
          ),

        subtitle =
          paste0(
            "10 × 10 m grid; active cell ≥ ",
            active_cell_min_grazing_fixes,
            " grazing GPS fix(es)"
          ),

        caption =
          if (map_all) {

            paste0(
              "Green: grazing GPS-observed active cell inside ",
              "the pasture, including cells beyond the assigned RGP. ",
              "Black: assigned RGP boundary."
            )

          } else {

            paste0(
              "Green: grazing GPS-observed active cell inside ",
              "the assigned RGP only. Boundary cells are clipped ",
              "to the RGP polygon."
            )
          },

        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
      ) +


      ggplot2::theme_bw() +


      ggplot2::theme(

        axis.text =
          ggplot2::element_blank(),

        axis.ticks =
          ggplot2::element_blank(),

        panel.grid =
          ggplot2::element_blank(),

        strip.text =
          ggplot2::element_text(
            size = 9
          ),

        plot.title =
          ggplot2::element_text(
            face = "bold"
          ),

        plot.caption =
          ggplot2::element_text(
            size = 8
          )
      )


    # ========================================================
    # 6.5 VERIFY PLOT CAN ACTUALLY RENDER
    # ========================================================

    render_test <-
      tryCatch(

        {

          ggplot2::ggplotGrob(
            map_plot
          )

        },

        error =
          function(e) {

            stop(
              "\nRGP MAP RENDER FAILURE\n",
              "Year: ",
              this_year,
              "\nPasture: ",
              this_pasture,
              "\nScope: ",
              scope,
              "\nActive cells: ",
              nrow(active_cells),
              "\nError: ",
              conditionMessage(e)
            )
          }
      )


    rm(
      render_test
    )


    # ========================================================
    # 6.6 OUTPUT FILE
    # ========================================================

    map_file <-
      file.path(

        rgp_map_dir,

        paste0(
          this_year,
          "_pasture_",
          this_pasture,
          "_",
          scope,
          ".png"
        )
      )


    # ========================================================
    # 6.7 SAVE
    # ========================================================

    if (export_results) {
      save_verified_png(plot = map_plot, filename = map_file,
                        width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)
    }

    # ========================================================
    # 6.8 INVENTORY
    # ========================================================

    rgp_map_inventory[[
      length(
        rgp_map_inventory
      ) +
        1L
    ]] <-
      tibble::tibble(

        Year =
          this_year,

        Pasture_ID =
          this_pasture,

        Grid_Map =
          scope,

        RGP_panels =
          nrow(
            panel_audit
          ),

        Active_cells =
          nrow(
            active_cells
          ),

        Active_ha =
          sum(
            panel_audit$Geometry_active_ha,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),

        Map_file =
          if (
            export_results
          ) {
            map_file
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },

        File_exists =
          if (
            export_results
          ) {
            file.exists(
              map_file
            )
          } else {
            NA
          }
      )
  }
}


# ============================================================
# 7. COMBINE MAP INVENTORY
# ============================================================

rgp_map_inventory <-
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    rgp_map_inventory
  )


print(
  rgp_map_inventory
)


# ============================================================
# 8. VERIFY MAP INVENTORY
# ============================================================

expected_map_count <-
  nrow(
    rgp_plot_index
  ) *
  2L


if (
  nrow(
    rgp_map_inventory
  ) !=
    expected_map_count
) {

  stop(
    "Expected ",
    expected_map_count,
    " RGP maps but inventory contains ",
    nrow(
      rgp_map_inventory
    ),
    "."
  )
}


if (
  export_results &&
    any(
      !rgp_map_inventory$File_exists
    )
) {

  print(
    rgp_map_inventory %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        !File_exists
      )
  )


  stop(
    "At least one RGP active-area map was not created."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 9. SAVE MAP INVENTORY
# ============================================================

if (export_results) {

  two_scale_write_table(rgp_map_inventory, "RGP_two_grid_map_inventory.csv")
}


# ============================================================
# 10. RESULTS MANIFEST
# ============================================================

if (export_results) {

  rgp_files <-
    list.files(

      analysis_out,

      recursive =
        TRUE,

      full.names =
        TRUE
    )


  rgp_manifest <-
    tibble::tibble(

      File =
        substring(
          rgp_files,
          nchar(
            analysis_out
          ) +
            2L
        ),

      Size_bytes =

        )$size

  two_scale_write_table(rgp_manifest, "RGP_results_manifest.csv")

# ============================================================
# 11. DISPLAY INVENTORY
# ============================================================

knitr::kable(
  rgp_map_inventory,
  caption =
    "RGP all-pasture and inside-RGP active-area grid map inventory"
)
```

## 6. Whole-season BW, ADG, and GHG for the independent seasonal grid

Whole-season areas count each spatial location once in the independently pooled
seasonal grid. A single row per pasture-year uses this unique spatial denominator;
period occupied hectares are never summed to construct the seasonal area. Season CH4 and CO2 totals extrapolate sampled daily rates over
the grazing-season days and are estimates, not mapped methane fluxes.

```{r season-two-grid-outcomes, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
season_bw_context <- bw_season %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Animals_assigned = dplyr::n_distinct(SEID),
    Animals_with_endpoints = sum(is.finite(total_gain)),
    Mean_IBW_kg = safe_mean_finite(IBW),
    Mean_FBW_kg = safe_mean_finite(FBW),
    Mean_seasonal_ADG_kg_day = safe_mean_finite(Seasonal_ADG),
    Estimated_pasture_gain_kg =
      safe_mean_finite(total_gain) * Animals_assigned,
    .groups = "drop")
season_gas_context <- gf_season_qualified %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Year = as.integer(as.character(Year)),
    Pasture_ID = as.integer(
    readr::parse_number(as.character(Pasture)))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    CH4_steers_qualified = sum(is.finite(season_CH4_g_d)),
    CO2_steers_qualified = sum(is.finite(season_CO2_g_d)),
    CH4_g_animal_day = safe_mean_finite(season_CH4_g_d),
    CO2_g_animal_day = safe_mean_finite(season_CO2_g_d),
    .groups = "drop")
if (anyDuplicated(season_bw_context[c("Year", "Pasture_ID")]) ||
    anyDuplicated(season_gas_context[c("Year", "Pasture_ID")]))
  stop("Duplicate pasture-year BW or GreenFeed season context")
season_two_grid_outcomes <- pasture_use_season %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Year = as.integer(as.character(Year)),
    Pasture_ID = as.integer(as.character(Pasture_ID))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(season_bw_context,
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(season_gas_context,
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID"), relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(season_trial_dates %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Season_days =
      as.integer(Trial_End - Trial_Start) + 1L),
    by = "Year", relationship = "many-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gain_kg_per_active_ha = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      Estimated_pasture_gain_kg / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    Gain_kg_per_active_ha_day = ifelse(Active_ha > 0 &
        Season_days > 0, Estimated_pasture_gain_kg /
        Active_ha / Season_days, NA_real_),
    CH4_g_herd_day = CH4_g_animal_day * Animals_assigned,
    CO2_g_herd_day = CO2_g_animal_day * Animals_assigned,
    CH4_g_herd_season_est = CH4_g_herd_day * Season_days,
    CO2_g_herd_season_est = CO2_g_herd_day * Season_days,
    CH4_g_per_active_ha_day = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      CH4_g_herd_day / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    CO2_g_per_active_ha_day = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      CO2_g_herd_day / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    CH4_g_per_active_ha_season_est = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      CH4_g_herd_season_est / Active_ha, NA_real_),
    CO2_g_per_active_ha_season_est = ifelse(Active_ha > 0,
      CO2_g_herd_season_est / Active_ha, NA_real_))
if (anyDuplicated(season_two_grid_outcomes[
  c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Grid_Map")]))
  stop("Duplicate whole-season grid outcome")
if (export_results)
  two_scale_write_table(season_two_grid_outcomes, "Season_two_grid_BW_ADG_GHG_per_unique_active_ha.csv")
knitr::kable(season_two_grid_outcomes %>% dplyr::select(
  Year, Pasture_ID, Grid_Map, Active_ha,
  Mean_IBW_kg, Mean_FBW_kg, Mean_seasonal_ADG_kg_day,
  Gain_kg_per_active_ha, CH4_steers_qualified,
  CO2_steers_qualified, CH4_g_per_active_ha_day,
  CO2_g_per_active_ha_day))
```

## 7. Full grazing-season 10 × 10 m grid

The extra seasonal grid uses all valid grazing-like fixes inside each
pasture from the trial start through end dates. Every occupied pasture cell
contributes its pasture-clipped area once, regardless of how many RGPs or
days contained a fix. The coverage table reports dates for which GPS data
are actually present; missing days are not imputed as either used or unused.

```{r full-season-unique-grid-audit, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
season_grid_inventory <- season_active_grid_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, Pasture_ID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Geometry_unique_active_ha =
    sum(Pasture_Cell_ha[Active_Cell]), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(season_active_summary %>%
    dplyr::select(Year, Pasture_ID, Season_unique_active_ha,
      Percent_pasture_active_season, GPS_recorded_days_all_states,
      Season_calendar_days),
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID"), relationship = "one-to-one") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Area_difference_ha =
    Geometry_unique_active_ha - Season_unique_active_ha,
    Map_file = if (isTRUE(export_results)) file.path(output_dirs$maps_active_area,
      sprintf("03_whole_season_%d_pasture_%d.png", Year, Pasture_ID))
      else NA_character_)
if (any(!is.finite(season_grid_inventory$Area_difference_ha)) ||
    any(abs(season_grid_inventory$Area_difference_ha) > 1e-5))
  stop("Pooled seasonal map hectares differ from the authoritative area summary.")
# Whole-season area tables and maps are exported once in Section 5.2/5.5.

# complete the spatial record without recreating the same maps.
two_scale_write_table(season_gps_coverage, "Whole_season_GPS_coverage_audit.csv")
two_scale_write_table(season_grid_inventory, "Whole_season_geometry_and_map_audit.csv")

}
```

## 8. Productivity and normalized pasture-use models

Land productivity is the estimated pasture liveweight gain divided by the
active hectares of the corresponding grid. The primary period gain models are fitted once in Section 9.10. An additional
synchronized-window sensitivity is fitted only when the matching-window rule
excludes otherwise available gain observations. Unique percent-use
models use treatment × stocking rate plus additive RGP at the period scale and
treatment × stocking rate for the pooled seasonal grid. Period models use the requested
Year and Pasture random intercepts. The percentage of each
pasture observed grazed is modeled separately to compare pastures of
different sizes. The seasonal endpoint sensitivity uses the independently pooled whole-season grid. A model with six unique pastures cannot establish treatment
replication, regardless of the number of repeated years or periods.

```{r unique-percent-use-and-endpoint-sensitivity-models, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# A period gain ratio duplicates the final Section 9.3 ratio only when its
# BW window matches the RGP. Retain synchronized-window sensitivity inference
# only if that restriction actually excludes an otherwise available outcome;
# otherwise Section 9.10 fits the identical primary ratio once.
# Percent-use inference is unique, as is the contiguous-day endpoint seasonal
# gain sensitivity when it differs from the available-chute-day summary.
productivity_models <- list()
productivity_inference <- list()
productivity_diagnostics <- list()
productivity_model_audit <- list()
productivity_effects <- list()
productivity_emmeans <- list()
model_outcomes <- list(RGP = rgp_map_scopes, Season = season_two_grid_outcomes)
for (scale_name in names(model_outcomes)) {
  grid_names <- if (scale_name == "RGP")
    c("ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING", "INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING") else "WHOLE_SEASON_GRAZING"
  responses <- c("Percent_pasture_active", "Gain_kg_per_active_ha")
  for (grid_name in grid_names) {
    for (response in responses) {
      id <- paste("two_scale", scale_name, grid_name, response, sep = "__")
      if (scale_name == "RGP" && response == "Gain_kg_per_active_ha") {
        available <- model_outcomes[[scale_name]] %>% dplyr::filter(
          Grid_Map == grid_name, is.finite(Estimated_pasture_gain_kg),
          is.finite(Active_ha), Active_ha > 0)
        excludes_rows <- any(is.na(available$BW_window_matches_RGP) |
          !available$BW_window_matches_RGP)
        if (!excludes_rows) {
          productivity_model_audit[[id]] <- tibble::tibble(
            Model = id, Response = response, Grid_Map = grid_name,
            Time_scale = scale_name, N_rows = nrow(available),
            N_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(available$Pasture_ID),
            N_years = dplyr::n_distinct(available$Year),
            Status = "Consolidated: same rows, numerator and denominator as final period LWG ratio", 
            Singular = NA,
            Inference_note = "Reuse the authoritative Section 9.10 period land-ratio LMM")
          next
        }
        id <- paste0(id, "__synchronized_window_sensitivity")
      }
      if (scale_name == "Season" && response == "Gain_kg_per_active_ha" &&
          all(bw_season$Endpoint_gain_equivalent)) {
        productivity_model_audit[[id]] <- tibble::tibble(
          Model = id, Response = response, Grid_Map = grid_name,
          Time_scale = scale_name, N_rows = nrow(model_outcomes[[scale_name]]),
          N_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(model_outcomes[[scale_name]]$Pasture_ID),
          N_years = dplyr::n_distinct(model_outcomes[[scale_name]]$Year),
          Status = "Consolidated: both endpoint gain rules agree; final whole-season LWG ratio owns inference",
          Singular = NA, Inference_note = "Reuse the authoritative Section 9.10 seasonal land-ratio LMM")
        next
      }
      if (scale_name == "Season" && response == "Gain_kg_per_active_ha")
        id <- paste0(id, "__contiguous_endpoint_sensitivity")
      d <- model_outcomes[[scale_name]] %>%
        dplyr::filter(Grid_Map == grid_name, is.finite(.data[[response]]),
          is.finite(Active_ha), Active_ha > 0) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Year = factor(Year), Pasture_ID = factor(Pasture_ID),
          TRT = factor(TRT, levels = c("Continuous", "Rotational")),
          SR = factor(SR, levels = c("Light", "Moderate", "Heavy")))
      if (scale_name == "RGP") d <- d %>% dplyr::mutate(
        RGP = factor(RGP, levels = paste0("RGP", 1:5)))
      rhs <- if (scale_name == "RGP")
        "TRT * SR + RGP + (1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture_ID)"
        else "TRT * SR + (1 | Pasture_ID) + (1 | Year)"
      fitted_model <- NULL
      status <- "Ready"
      if (nrow(d) < 1L || dplyr::n_distinct(d$Year) < 2L ||
          dplyr::n_distinct(d$Pasture_ID) < 2L) {
        status <- "Not fitted: insufficient years, pastures, or complete observations"
      } else {
        fitted_model <- tryCatch(afri_fit_lmm(
          stats::as.formula(paste(response, "~", rhs)), d, id, REML = FALSE),
          error = function(e) {status <<- paste("Fit error:", conditionMessage(e)); NULL})
      }
      productivity_model_audit[[id]] <- tibble::tibble(
        Model = id, Response = response, Formula = paste(response, "~", rhs),
        Grid_Map = grid_name, Time_scale = scale_name, N_rows = nrow(d),
        N_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(d$Pasture_ID),
        N_years = dplyr::n_distinct(d$Year), Status = status,
        Singular = if (is.null(fitted_model)) NA else lme4::isSingular(fitted_model),
        Inference_note = "Conditional site comparison; repeated periods do not replicate TRT x SR")
      if (!is.null(fitted_model)) {
        productivity_models[[id]] <- fitted_model
        specs <- if (scale_name == "RGP") ~ TRT * SR | RGP else ~ TRT * SR
        productivity_diagnostics[[id]] <- afri_diagnose_lmm(fitted_model, id)
        inference <- tryCatch(afri_inference(fitted_model, specs), error = function(e) {
          warning("Inference unavailable for ", id, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
        })
        if (is.null(inference)) {
          productivity_model_audit[[id]]$Status <- "Fitted; EMM inference unavailable"
          next
        }
        productivity_inference[[id]] <- inference
        productivity_effects[[id]] <- dplyr::mutate(inference$pairs, Model = id)
        count_groups <- if (scale_name == "RGP") c("TRT", "SR", "RGP") else c("TRT", "SR")
        counts <- stats::model.frame(fitted_model) %>%
          dplyr::count(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(count_groups)), name = "n")
        emm_rows <- if (nrow(inference$cld)) inference$cld else
          dplyr::mutate(inference$emmeans, .group = NA_character_,
            Letter_status = inference$cld_status)
        productivity_emmeans[[id]] <- emm_rows %>%
          dplyr::left_join(counts, by = count_groups) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(Model = id, Response = response,
            N_model = stats::nobs(fitted_model),
            N_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(stats::model.frame(fitted_model)$Pasture_ID),
            N_years = dplyr::n_distinct(stats::model.frame(fitted_model)$Year),
            EMM_SE = sprintf("%.3f +/- %.3f", emmean, SE),
            P_TRT = inference$anova$p.value[match("TRT", inference$anova$term)],
            P_SR = inference$anova$p.value[match("SR", inference$anova$term)],
            P_TRT_SR = inference$anova$p.value[match("TRT:SR", inference$anova$term)])
      }
    }
  }
}
productivity_model_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(productivity_model_audit)
productivity_effects <- dplyr::bind_rows(productivity_effects)
productivity_emmeans <- dplyr::bind_rows(productivity_emmeans)
productivity_diagnostic_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  productivity_diagnostics, function(x) x$summary))
# The model audit owns the full-ID-to-filename index; it is exported only once.
productivity_export_manifest <- two_scale_productivity_file_manifest(
  productivity_models, productivity_diagnostics)
productivity_model_audit <- productivity_model_audit %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(setdiff(names(productivity_export_manifest), "Model"))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(productivity_export_manifest, by = "Model")
two_scale_write_table(productivity_model_audit, "Unique_percent_use_and_endpoint_model_audit.csv")
two_scale_write_table(productivity_effects, "Unique_percent_use_and_endpoint_contrasts.csv")
two_scale_write_table(productivity_emmeans, "Unique_percent_use_and_endpoint_EMM_tests.csv")
two_scale_write_table(productivity_diagnostic_table, "Unique_percent_use_and_endpoint_diagnostics.csv")
productivity_variance_review <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(productivity_diagnostics), function(id) {
  x <- productivity_diagnostics[[id]]$variance_review
  if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
  dplyr::mutate(x, model_id = id)
}))
two_scale_write_table(productivity_variance_review, "Unique_percent_use_and_endpoint_residual_variance.csv")
if (isTRUE(export_results) && length(productivity_models)) {
  two_scale_write_file(two_scale_dirs$models, "Unique_percent_use_and_endpoint_LMMs.rds",
    function(destination) saveRDS(productivity_models, destination))
  for (id in names(productivity_models)) {
    stem <- productivity_export_manifest$Export_stem[match(id, productivity_export_manifest$Model)]
    two_scale_write_file(two_scale_dirs$models, paste0(stem, "_summary.txt"),
      function(destination) writeLines(capture.output(summary(productivity_models[[id]])), destination))
    for (plot_name in names(productivity_diagnostics[[id]]$plots)) {
      filename <- paste0(stem, "_", two_scale_diagnostic_file_suffix(plot_name), ".png")
      two_scale_write_file(file.path(two_scale_dirs$figures, "Diagnostics"), filename,
        function(destination) ggplot2::ggsave(destination,
          productivity_diagnostics[[id]]$plots[[plot_name]], width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300))
    }
  }
}
knitr::kable(productivity_model_audit)
```


# 9. Integrated Spatial, Productivity, BW, Model, QC, and Table Outputs

This section integrates the retained upstream datasets and spatial denominators. It keeps the existing cleaning, HMM state
classification, GIS layers, treatment/stocking assignments, spline analysis,
and GreenFeed preparation, but standardizes the requested outputs and model
formulas.

The period-level analysis keeps two distinct active-hectare denominators:
`active_ha_all_pasture` and `active_ha_inside_rgp`. The whole-season analysis
uses only `active_ha_whole_season`, calculated directly from pooled seasonal
grazing fixes and unique occupied pasture cells. Ratios return `NA` when their
denominator is zero, missing, or non-finite.

## 9.1 Shared integrated-output helpers

```{r requested-revision-helpers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Shared final paths; directories are created by the output that needs them.
requested_output_dir <- file.path(master_output_root,
  "01_Grazing_Behavior_Spatial_Aera", "Integrated_Analysis")
requested_output_dirs <- list(
  root = requested_output_dir,
  tables = file.path(requested_output_dir, "01_Tables"),
  models = file.path(requested_output_dir, "02_Model_Results"),
  qc = file.path(requested_output_dir, "01_Tables", "QC"),
  spatial = file.path(requested_output_dir, "05_Spatial_Data"),
  maps = file.path(requested_output_dir, "04_Maps")
)

# These helpers have the same finite-value and all-missing rules as the
# existing production helpers; reuse their definitions instead of duplicating.
rev_safe_mean <- safe_mean_finite
rev_safe_sum <- safe_sum_finite

rev_safe_ratio <- function(numerator, denominator) {
  numerator <- as.numeric(numerator)
  denominator <- as.numeric(denominator)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, max(length(numerator), length(denominator)))
  numerator <- rep(numerator, length.out = length(out))
  denominator <- rep(denominator, length.out = length(out))
  ok <- is.finite(numerator) & is.finite(denominator) & denominator > 0
  out[ok] <- numerator[ok] / denominator[ok]
  out
}

rev_count_inf <- function(x) {
  sum(vapply(
    x,
    function(z) {
      if (is.numeric(z)) sum(is.infinite(z), na.rm = TRUE) else 0L
    },
    integer(1)
  ))
}

rev_clean_filename <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("_+", "_", x)
  substr(x, 1L, 120L)
}

rev_season_dates <- season_grazing_dates_by_pasture %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    Pasture = as.character(Pasture),
    Pasture_ID = as.integer(Pasture_ID),
    season_start_date = as.Date(Trial_Start),
    season_end_date = as.Date(Trial_End),
    season_days = as.integer(Trial_End - Trial_Start) + 1L,
    grazing_GPS_days = Grazing_GPS_Days
  )

if (anyDuplicated(rev_season_dates[c("Year", "Pasture_ID")])) {
  stop("Duplicate pasture-year season dates in requested revision.")
}
```

## 9.2 Separate shrunk-BW analysis datasets

Initial and final chute body weights are averaged over the requested endpoint
days and multiplied by 0.96. For 2024, the initial BW uses the single available
initial chute-weight day. Final BW uses the final two available chute-weight
days when both are present.

The season-level dataset contains one row per steer-year and includes
whole-season animal-average CH4, CO2, and smooth-spline ADG. The period-level
dataset contains one row per steer-RGP and adds RGP animal-average CH4, CO2,
and spline ADG.

```{r requested-revision-shrunk-bw, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rev_assignment_audit <- production_animal_assignments %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, SEID) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(Pasture_ID),
    n_trt_levels = dplyr::n_distinct(TRT),
    n_sr_levels = dplyr::n_distinct(SR),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(
  rev_assignment_audit$n_pastures > 1L |
    rev_assignment_audit$n_trt_levels > 1L |
    rev_assignment_audit$n_sr_levels > 1L
)) {
  stop("An animal has inconsistent pasture/treatment/stocking assignments.")
}

rev_animal_assignments <- production_animal_assignments %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    SEID = as.character(SEID),
    Pasture_ID = as.integer(Pasture_ID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Year, SEID) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Year, SEID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Reuse the first/last available-day endpoints computed in the sampling audit.
# These preserve the one-initial-day rule for 2024 and two-final-day rule.
rev_chute_endpoints <- manual_endpoint_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, SEID, Initial_BW_kg, Final_BW_kg,
    Initial_BW_days_used, Final_BW_days_used, Initial_BW_dates, Final_BW_dates,
    Initial_BW_expected_days, Final_BW_expected_days) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Shrunk_Initial_BW_kg = Initial_BW_kg * 0.96,
    Shrunk_Final_BW_kg = Final_BW_kg * 0.96,
    Chute_LWG_kg = Final_BW_kg - Initial_BW_kg,
    Shrunk_LWG_kg = Shrunk_Final_BW_kg - Shrunk_Initial_BW_kg
  )

rev_spline_season_boundaries <- rev_animal_assignments %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    rev_season_dates %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Year, Pasture_ID,
        season_start_date, season_end_date, season_days
      ),
    by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    spline_predictions_production %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        Year = as.integer(Year),
        SEID = as.character(SEID),
        season_start_date = as.Date(Date),
        Season_Start_Fitted_BW_kg = Fitted_BW,
        Season_Start_Extrapolated = Prediction_Extrapolated
      ),
    by = c("Year", "SEID", "season_start_date"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    spline_predictions_production %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        Year = as.integer(Year),
        SEID = as.character(SEID),
        season_end_date = as.Date(Date),
        Season_End_Fitted_BW_kg = Fitted_BW,
        Season_End_Extrapolated = Prediction_Extrapolated
      ),
    by = c("Year", "SEID", "season_end_date"),
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Season_gain_interval_days = as.integer(
      season_end_date - season_start_date
    ),
    Whole_Season_Smooth_LWG_kg = ifelse(
      is.finite(Season_Start_Fitted_BW_kg) &
        is.finite(Season_End_Fitted_BW_kg),
      Season_End_Fitted_BW_kg - Season_Start_Fitted_BW_kg,
      NA_real_
    ),
    Whole_Season_Smooth_ADG_kg_day = rev_safe_ratio(
      Whole_Season_Smooth_LWG_kg,
      Season_gain_interval_days
    ),
    Season_Boundary_Extrapolated =
      dplyr::coalesce(Season_Start_Extrapolated, FALSE) |
      dplyr::coalesce(Season_End_Extrapolated, FALSE)
  )

rev_gf_season_animal <- dressler_animal_system %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
```
