## 9.3 Final period-level grazing area and productivity dataset

This dataset has one row per pasture × year × period. The all-pasture and
inside-RGP areas are retained in separate columns, and every land-productivity
ratio is calculated separately for the two denominators.

```{r requested-revision-period-dataset, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# FIXED REPLACEMENT CHUNK
# PERIOD/RGP + WHOLE-SEASON PRODUCTIVITY
#
# Uses native R pipe |> rather than %>% so the chunk does not
# require magrittr/dplyr to be attached with library().
# ============================================================

if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'dplyr' is required. Install it with install.packages('dplyr').")
}

# ============================================================
# 9.3 PERIOD / RGP GRAZING PRODUCTIVITY DATASET
# ============================================================

period_level_grazing_productivity <- active_area_summary |>
  dplyr::transmute(

    Year = as.integer(Year),

    Pasture_ID = as.integer(Pasture_ID),

    Pasture = paste0(
      "Pasture_",
      Pasture_ID
    ),

    # Standardize legacy treatment labels to standard TRT values.

    TRT = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_squish(as.character(TRT)) %in%
        c("Continuous", "C_C", "CC", "CG", "Continuous grazing") ~ "Continuous",
      stringr::str_squish(as.character(TRT)) %in%
        c("Rotational", "R_G", "RG", "VF-RG", "VF_RG", "Rotational grazing") ~ "Rotational",
      TRUE ~ stringr::str_squish(as.character(TRT))
    ),

    SR = as.character(SR),

    Rotation_Period = as.integer(Rotation_Period),

    Period = factor(
      paste0(
        "RGP",
        Rotation_Period
      ),
      levels = paste0(
        "RGP",
        1:5
      )
    ),

    period_start_date = as.Date(Period_start),

    period_end_date = as.Date(Period_end),

    period_days = as.integer(Period_days),

    pasture_area_ha = Pasture_area_ha,

    total_rgp_area_ha = total_rgp_area_ha,

    active_ha_all_pasture = active_ha_all_pasture,

    active_m2_all_pasture = active_m2_all_pasture,

    active_ha_inside_rgp = active_ha_inside_rgp,

    active_m2_inside_rgp = active_m2_inside_rgp,

    percent_rgp_actively_grazed =
      percent_rgp_actively_grazed,

    grazing_fixes_all_pasture =
      N_grazing_fixes_inside +
      N_grazing_fixes_outside_rotation,

    grazing_fixes_inside_rgp =
      N_grazing_fixes_inside,

    grazing_fixes_outside_rgp =
      N_grazing_fixes_outside_rotation,

    grazing_fixes_outside_pasture =
      N_grazing_fixes_outside_pasture,

    Grid_Size_m,

    Minimum_Grazing_Fixes
  ) |>


  # ==========================================================
  # JOIN SEASON DATES
  # ==========================================================

  dplyr::left_join(

    rev_season_dates |>
      dplyr::select(
        Year,
        Pasture_ID,
        season_start_date,
        season_end_date
      ),

    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID"
    ),

    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) |>


  # ==========================================================
  # JOIN BW / LWG CONTEXT
  # ==========================================================

  dplyr::left_join(

    rgp_bw_context,

    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID",
      "Rotation_Period"
    ),

    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>


  # ==========================================================
  # JOIN GREENFEED GAS CONTEXT
  # ==========================================================

  dplyr::left_join(

    rgp_gas_context,

    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID",
      "Rotation_Period"
    ),

    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>


  # ==========================================================
  # JOIN GREENFEED WINDOWS
  # ==========================================================

  dplyr::left_join(

    rgp_gas_windows,

    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID",
      "Rotation_Period"
    ),

    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>


  # ==========================================================
  # CALCULATE PERIOD-LEVEL PRODUCTIVITY
  # ==========================================================

  dplyr::mutate(

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DATE-WINDOW QC
    #
    # These variables are QC flags only.
    #
    # They do NOT determine whether an RGP value is retained,
    # because BW and GreenFeed values have already been joined
    # by Year + Pasture_ID + Rotation_Period.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    BW_window_matches_period =
      !is.na(BW_start) &
      !is.na(BW_end) &
      BW_start == period_start_date &
      BW_end == period_end_date,


    GF_window_matches_period =
      !is.na(GF_start) &
      !is.na(GF_end) &
      GF_start == period_start_date &
      GF_end == period_end_date,


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Window overlap QC
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    BW_window_overlaps_period =
      !is.na(BW_start) &
      !is.na(BW_end) &
      BW_start <= period_end_date &
      BW_end >= period_start_date,


    GF_window_overlaps_period =
      !is.na(GF_start) &
      !is.na(GF_end) &
      GF_start <= period_end_date &
      GF_end >= period_start_date,


    # ========================================================
    # ANIMAL COUNT
    # ========================================================

    animal_count =
      as.numeric(
        Animals_assigned
      ),


    # ========================================================
    # LWG
    #
    # IMPORTANT:
    # Do not replace with NA because of date mismatch.
    # It is already assigned to the correct RGP.
    # ========================================================

    total_LWG_kg =
      as.numeric(
        Estimated_pasture_gain_kg
      ),


    mean_RGP_ADG_kg_day =
      as.numeric(
        Mean_ADG_kg_day
      ),


    # ========================================================
    # CH4
    # ========================================================

    CH4_g_animal_day =
      as.numeric(
        CH4_g_animal_day
      ),


    # ========================================================
    # CO2
    # ========================================================

    CO2_g_animal_day =
      as.numeric(
        CO2_g_animal_day
      ),


    # ========================================================
    # TOTAL CH4 DURING RGP
    # ========================================================

    CH4_g_total_period_est =
      dplyr::if_else(

        is.finite(CH4_g_animal_day) &
          is.finite(animal_count) &
          is.finite(period_days) &
          animal_count > 0 &
          period_days > 0,

        CH4_g_animal_day *
          animal_count *
          period_days,

        NA_real_
      ),


    # ========================================================
    # TOTAL CO2 DURING RGP
    # ========================================================

    CO2_g_total_period_est =
      dplyr::if_else(

        is.finite(CO2_g_animal_day) &
          is.finite(animal_count) &
          is.finite(period_days) &
          animal_count > 0 &
          period_days > 0,

        CO2_g_animal_day *
          animal_count *
          period_days,

        NA_real_
      ),


    # ========================================================
    # LWG PER ACTIVE HECTARE
    # ========================================================

    LWG_kg_per_active_ha_all_pasture =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        total_LWG_kg,
        active_ha_all_pasture
      ),


    LWG_kg_per_active_ha_inside_rgp =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        total_LWG_kg,
        active_ha_inside_rgp
      ),


    # ========================================================
    # CH4 PER ACTIVE HECTARE
    # ========================================================

    CH4_g_per_active_ha_all_pasture =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CH4_g_total_period_est,
        active_ha_all_pasture
      ),


    CH4_g_per_active_ha_inside_rgp =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CH4_g_total_period_est,
        active_ha_inside_rgp
      ),


    # ========================================================
    # CO2 PER ACTIVE HECTARE
    # ========================================================

    CO2_g_per_active_ha_all_pasture =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CO2_g_total_period_est,
        active_ha_all_pasture
      ),


    CO2_g_per_active_ha_inside_rgp =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CO2_g_total_period_est,
        active_ha_inside_rgp
      ),


    # ========================================================
    # GAS PER KG LWG
    # ========================================================

    CH4_g_per_kg_LWG =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CH4_g_total_period_est,
        total_LWG_kg
      ),


    CO2_g_per_kg_LWG =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CO2_g_total_period_est,
        total_LWG_kg
      )
  ) |>


  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    Rotation_Period
  )


# ============================================================
# PERIOD DATASET DUPLICATE QC
# ============================================================

if (
  anyDuplicated(
    period_level_grazing_productivity[
      c(
        "Year",
        "Pasture_ID",
        "Rotation_Period"
      )
    ]
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Period-level final dataset contains duplicated analysis units."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# PERIOD METRIC AVAILABILITY QC
# ============================================================

period_metric_availability_qc <-
  period_level_grazing_productivity |>
  dplyr::transmute(

    Year,

    Pasture_ID,

    Rotation_Period,

    Period,

    BW_window_matches_period,

    BW_window_overlaps_period,

    GF_window_matches_period,

    GF_window_overlaps_period,

    LWG_available =
      is.finite(
        total_LWG_kg
      ),

    CH4_available =
      is.finite(
        CH4_g_animal_day
      ),

    CO2_available =
      is.finite(
        CO2_g_animal_day
      ),

    LWG_all_pasture_available =
      is.finite(
        LWG_kg_per_active_ha_all_pasture
      ),

    LWG_inside_rgp_available =
      is.finite(
        LWG_kg_per_active_ha_inside_rgp
      ),

    CH4_all_pasture_available =
      is.finite(
        CH4_g_per_active_ha_all_pasture
      ),

    CH4_inside_rgp_available =
      is.finite(
        CH4_g_per_active_ha_inside_rgp
      ),

    CO2_all_pasture_available =
      is.finite(
        CO2_g_per_active_ha_all_pasture
      ),

    CO2_inside_rgp_available =
      is.finite(
        CO2_g_per_active_ha_inside_rgp
      )
  ) |>

  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Rotation_Period,
    Pasture_ID
  )


cat(
  "\nPeriod-level LWG / CH4 / CO2 availability:\n"
)

print(
  period_metric_availability_qc,
  n = Inf
)


# ============================================================
# RGP5 QC
# ============================================================

rgp5_metric_qc <-
  period_level_grazing_productivity |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Rotation_Period == 5L
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(

    Year,

    Pasture_ID,

    Rotation_Period,

    period_start_date,

    period_end_date,

    BW_start,

    BW_end,

    BW_window_matches_period,

    BW_window_overlaps_period,

    GF_start,

    GF_end,

    GF_window_matches_period,

    GF_window_overlaps_period,

    animal_count,

    total_LWG_kg,

    CH4_g_animal_day,

    CO2_g_animal_day,

    active_ha_all_pasture,

    active_ha_inside_rgp,

    LWG_kg_per_active_ha_all_pasture,

    LWG_kg_per_active_ha_inside_rgp,

    CH4_g_per_active_ha_all_pasture,

    CH4_g_per_active_ha_inside_rgp,

    CO2_g_per_active_ha_all_pasture,

    CO2_g_per_active_ha_inside_rgp
  ) |>

  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID
  )


cat(
  "\nRGP5 metric QC:\n"
)

print(
  rgp5_metric_qc,
  n = Inf
)



# ============================================================
# 9.4 FINAL WHOLE-SEASON GRAZING AREA AND PRODUCTIVITY DATASET
# ============================================================
#
# Whole-season area is calculated directly from the pooled
# whole-season 10 × 10 m grazing grid.
#
# Period active areas are NOT summed.
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 9.4.1 ANIMAL-LEVEL WHOLE-SEASON SUMMARY
# ============================================================

rev_season_animal_summary <-
  shrunk_bw_season_analysis |>

  dplyr::group_by(

    Year,

    Pasture_ID,

    Pasture,

    TRT,

    SR,

    season_start_date,

    season_end_date,

    season_days
  ) |>

  dplyr::summarise(

    animal_count =
      dplyr::n_distinct(
        SEID
      ),

    animals_with_LWG =
      sum(
        is.finite(
          Chute_LWG_kg
        )
      ),

    mean_Initial_BW_kg =
      rev_safe_mean(
        Initial_BW_kg
      ),

    mean_Final_BW_kg =
      rev_safe_mean(
        Final_BW_kg
      ),

    mean_Shrunk_Initial_BW_kg =
      rev_safe_mean(
        Shrunk_Initial_BW_kg
      ),

    mean_Shrunk_Final_BW_kg =
      rev_safe_mean(
        Shrunk_Final_BW_kg
      ),

    mean_Whole_Season_Smooth_ADG_kg_day =
      rev_safe_mean(
        Whole_Season_Smooth_ADG_kg_day
      ),

    total_LWG_kg_observed =
      rev_safe_sum(
        Chute_LWG_kg
      ),

    total_LWG_kg =
      rev_safe_mean(
        Chute_LWG_kg
      ) *
      animal_count,

    CH4_animals_qualified =
      sum(
        is.finite(
          Whole_Season_CH4_g_day
        )
      ),

    CO2_animals_qualified =
      sum(
        is.finite(
          Whole_Season_CO2_g_day
        )
      ),

    whole_season_animal_avg_CH4_g_day =
      rev_safe_mean(
        Whole_Season_CH4_g_day
      ),

    whole_season_animal_avg_CO2_g_day =
      rev_safe_mean(
        Whole_Season_CO2_g_day
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ============================================================
# 9.4.2 WHOLE-SEASON PRODUCTIVITY DATASET
# ============================================================

whole_season_grazing_productivity <-
  season_active_summary |>

  dplyr::transmute(

    Year =
      as.integer(
        Year
      ),

    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        Pasture_ID
      ),

    pasture_area_ha =
      Pasture_area_ha,

    active_ha_whole_season =
      active_ha_whole_season,

    active_m2_whole_season =
      active_m2_whole_season,

    percent_pasture_active_whole_season =
      Percent_pasture_active_season,

    season_grazing_fixes =
      Season_grazing_fixes,

    GPS_recorded_days_all_states,

    GPS_grazing_days,

    grazing_fixes_outside_RGP_calendar =
      Grazing_fixes_outside_RGP_calendar
  ) |>


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Season dates
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dplyr::left_join(

    rev_season_dates,

    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID"
    ),

    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Animal / BW / gas season summary
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dplyr::left_join(

    rev_season_animal_summary |>
      dplyr::select(
        -Pasture,
        -season_start_date,
        -season_end_date,
        -season_days
      ),

    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID"
    ),

    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) |>


  # ==========================================================
  # WHOLE-SEASON PRODUCTIVITY METRICS
  # ==========================================================

  dplyr::mutate(

    Pasture =
      paste0(
        "Pasture_",
        Pasture_ID
      ),

    TRT =
      dplyr::case_when(

        TRT %in%
          c(
            "Continuous",
            "C_C",
            "CC",
            "CG",
            "Continuous grazing"
          ) ~
          "Continuous",

        TRT %in%
          c(
            "Rotational",
            "R_G",
            "RG",
            "VF-RG",
            "VF_RG",
            "Rotational grazing"
          ) ~
          "Rotational",

        TRUE ~
          as.character(
            TRT
          )
      ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Total season CH4
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    CH4_g_total_season_est =
      dplyr::if_else(

        is.finite(
          whole_season_animal_avg_CH4_g_day
        ) &
          is.finite(
            animal_count
          ) &
          is.finite(
            season_days
          ) &
          animal_count > 0 &
          season_days > 0,

        whole_season_animal_avg_CH4_g_day *
          animal_count *
          season_days,

        NA_real_
      ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Total season CO2
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    CO2_g_total_season_est =
      dplyr::if_else(

        is.finite(
          whole_season_animal_avg_CO2_g_day
        ) &
          is.finite(
            animal_count
          ) &
          is.finite(
            season_days
          ) &
          animal_count > 0 &
          season_days > 0,

        whole_season_animal_avg_CO2_g_day *
          animal_count *
          season_days,

        NA_real_
      ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # LWG per active ha
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    LWG_kg_per_active_ha_whole_season =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        total_LWG_kg,
        active_ha_whole_season
      ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CH4 per active ha
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    CH4_g_per_active_ha_whole_season =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CH4_g_total_season_est,
        active_ha_whole_season
      ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CO2 per active ha
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    CO2_g_per_active_ha_whole_season =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CO2_g_total_season_est,
        active_ha_whole_season
      ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Daily whole-season land productivity. The denominator is
    # the *unique whole-season* active area, not the sum of RGP
    # areas; the time denominator is the pasture-specific season
    # length (inclusive start/end dates). These are per-pasture-
    # year daily rates, not daily-averaged GPS cell areas.
    # --------------------------------------------------------
    CH4_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CH4_g_per_active_ha_whole_season,
        season_days
      ),

    CO2_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CO2_g_per_active_ha_whole_season,
        season_days
      ),

    ADG_Land_kg_per_active_ha_day_whole_season =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        LWG_kg_per_active_ha_whole_season,
        season_days
      ),


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Gas per kg LWG
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    CH4_g_per_kg_LWG_whole_season =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CH4_g_total_season_est,
        total_LWG_kg
      ),


    CO2_g_per_kg_LWG_whole_season =
      rev_safe_ratio(
        CO2_g_total_season_est,
        total_LWG_kg
      )
  ) |>


  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID
  )


# ============================================================
# WHOLE-SEASON DUPLICATE QC
# ============================================================

if (
  anyDuplicated(
    whole_season_grazing_productivity[
      c(
        "Year",
        "Pasture_ID"
      )
    ]
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Whole-season final dataset contains duplicated analysis units."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# WHOLE-SEASON METRIC QC
# ============================================================

whole_season_metric_qc <-
  whole_season_grazing_productivity |>

  dplyr::transmute(

    Year,

    Pasture_ID,

    active_ha_whole_season,

    total_LWG_kg,

    CH4_g_total_season_est,

    CO2_g_total_season_est,

    LWG_kg_per_active_ha_whole_season,

    CH4_g_per_active_ha_whole_season,

    CO2_g_per_active_ha_whole_season,

    CH4_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season,

    CO2_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season,

    ADG_Land_kg_per_active_ha_day_whole_season,

    season_days,

    Daily_land_rates_consistent =
      dplyr::if_else(
        is.finite(season_days) & season_days > 0 &
          is.finite(LWG_kg_per_active_ha_whole_season) &
          is.finite(ADG_Land_kg_per_active_ha_day_whole_season) &
          is.finite(CH4_g_per_active_ha_whole_season) &
          is.finite(CH4_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season) &
          is.finite(CO2_g_per_active_ha_whole_season) &
          is.finite(CO2_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season),
        abs(ADG_Land_kg_per_active_ha_day_whole_season * season_days -
              LWG_kg_per_active_ha_whole_season) <=
          1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(LWG_kg_per_active_ha_whole_season)) &
          abs(CH4_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season * season_days -
                CH4_g_per_active_ha_whole_season) <=
          1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(CH4_g_per_active_ha_whole_season)) &
          abs(CO2_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season * season_days -
                CO2_g_per_active_ha_whole_season) <=
          1e-8 * pmax(1, abs(CO2_g_per_active_ha_whole_season)),
        NA
      ),

    LWG_available =
      is.finite(
        LWG_kg_per_active_ha_whole_season
      ),

    CH4_available =
      is.finite(
        CH4_g_per_active_ha_whole_season
      ),

    CO2_available =
      is.finite(
        CO2_g_per_active_ha_whole_season
      )
  ) |>

  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID
  )


cat(
  "\nWhole-season LWG / CH4 / CO2 metric availability:\n"
)

print(
  whole_season_metric_qc,
  n = Inf
)

if (any(whole_season_metric_qc$Daily_land_rates_consistent %in% FALSE)) {
  stop("Daily land productivity does not reconcile with whole-season totals.")
}

```



### 9.4.1 Three-grid BW/LWG, CH4, and CO2 map exports

For each requested production/GHG metric, three spatial views are exported to
`04_Maps/Three_Grid_Metrics`: period all-pasture grid, period inside-RGP grid, and the unique
whole-season grid. The period maps use the matching active-hectare denominator;
the whole-season map uses the pooled unique whole-season denominator.

```{r requested-revision-three-grid-metric-maps, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# FIXED THREE-GRID BW/LWG, CH4, AND CO2 MAP CHUNK
#
# Uses native R pipe |> throughout, so %>% does not need to be
# attached via library(dplyr) or library(magrittr).
# ============================================================

if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'dplyr' is required.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'sf' is required.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("scales", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'scales' is required.")
}

# ============================================================
# RESET STALE INTERACTIVE GRAPHICS DEVICE
# This prevents the intermittent grid/ggplot "depth(NULL)" error
# that can occur in the RStudio Plots pane after many plots.
# ============================================================

if (interactive()) {
  try(grDevices::graphics.off(), silent = TRUE)
  invisible(gc())
}

# ============================================================
# THREE-GRID BW/LWG, CH4, AND CO2 MAPS
#
# FIXES:
#   1. Explicit labels for Year x RGP panels with no metric data
#   2. Correct units:
#        LWG = kg/active ha
#        CH4 = g/active ha
#        CO2 = g/active ha
#   3. Cleaner legend breaks / comma formatting
#   4. Short Windows-safe output path
#   5. Preserves the actual NA values; does NOT invent data
# ============================================================


# ============================================================
# 0. OUTPUT DIRECTORY
# ============================================================

# The final map-export chunk writes these nine objects once to
# 01_Grazing_Behavior_Spatial_Aera/04_Maps/Three_Grid_Metrics.
# Plot construction and QC do not create empty export directories.

# ============================================================
# 1. ACTIVE CELLS FOR THE THREE GRID DEFINITIONS
# ============================================================

metric_all_pasture_cells <-
  all_pasture_active_grid_sf |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Active_Cell_all
  )


metric_inside_rgp_cells <-
  inside_RGP_active_grid_sf |>
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(Active_Cell) ==
      "GPS-observed grazed"
  )


metric_whole_season_cells <-
  season_active_grid_sf |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Active_Cell
  )


# ============================================================
# 2. STANDARDIZE KEYS
# ============================================================

metric_all_pasture_cells <-
  metric_all_pasture_cells |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Year)
      ),
    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      ),
    Rotation_Period =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Rotation_Period)
      ),
    Rotation_Label =
      factor(
        paste0(
          "RGP",
          Rotation_Period
        ),
        levels =
          paste0(
            "RGP",
            1:5
          )
      )
  )


metric_inside_rgp_cells <-
  metric_inside_rgp_cells |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Year)
      ),
    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      ),
    Rotation_Period =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Rotation_Period)
      ),
    Rotation_Label =
      factor(
        paste0(
          "RGP",
          Rotation_Period
        ),
        levels =
          paste0(
            "RGP",
            1:5
          )
      )
  )


metric_whole_season_cells <-
  metric_whole_season_cells |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Year =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Year)
      ),
    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      )
  )


# ============================================================
# 3. PERIOD METRIC LOOKUP
# ============================================================

period_metric_lookup <-
  period_level_grazing_productivity |>
  dplyr::transmute(

    Year =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Year)
      ),

    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      ),

    Rotation_Period =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Rotation_Period)
      ),

    LWG_all =
      as.numeric(
        LWG_kg_per_active_ha_all_pasture
      ),

    LWG_inside =
      as.numeric(
        LWG_kg_per_active_ha_inside_rgp
      ),

    CH4_all =
      as.numeric(
        CH4_g_per_active_ha_all_pasture
      ),

    CH4_inside =
      as.numeric(
        CH4_g_per_active_ha_inside_rgp
      ),

    CO2_all =
      as.numeric(
        CO2_g_per_active_ha_all_pasture
      ),

    CO2_inside =
      as.numeric(
        CO2_g_per_active_ha_inside_rgp
      )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# One value per Year x Pasture x RGP is required
# ------------------------------------------------------------

period_metric_duplicates <-
  period_metric_lookup |>
  dplyr::count(
    Year,
    Pasture_ID,
    Rotation_Period,
    name = "N"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    N > 1L
  )


if (
  nrow(
    period_metric_duplicates
  ) > 0L
) {

  print(
    period_metric_duplicates
  )

  stop(
    "Duplicate Year x Pasture x RGP rows detected ",
    "in period_metric_lookup."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 4. WHOLE-SEASON METRIC LOOKUP
# ============================================================

season_metric_lookup <-
  whole_season_grazing_productivity |>
  dplyr::transmute(

    Year =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Year)
      ),

    Pasture_ID =
      as.integer(
        as.character(Pasture_ID)
      ),

    LWG_season =
      as.numeric(
        LWG_kg_per_active_ha_whole_season
      ),

    CH4_season =
      as.numeric(
        CH4_g_per_active_ha_whole_season
      ),

    CO2_season =
      as.numeric(
        CO2_g_per_active_ha_whole_season
      )
  )


if (
  anyDuplicated(
    season_metric_lookup[
      c(
        "Year",
        "Pasture_ID"
      )
    ]
  )
) {

  stop(
    "Duplicate Year x Pasture rows detected ",
    "in season_metric_lookup."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 5. JOIN METRICS TO GRID CELLS
# ============================================================

n_all_before <-
  nrow(
    metric_all_pasture_cells
  )


metric_all_pasture_cells <-
  metric_all_pasture_cells |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    period_metric_lookup,
    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID",
      "Rotation_Period"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )


if (
  nrow(
    metric_all_pasture_cells
  ) != n_all_before
) {

  stop(
    "All-pasture metric join changed cell count."
  )
}


n_inside_before <-
  nrow(
    metric_inside_rgp_cells
  )


metric_inside_rgp_cells <-
  metric_inside_rgp_cells |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    period_metric_lookup,
    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID",
      "Rotation_Period"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )


if (
  nrow(
    metric_inside_rgp_cells
  ) != n_inside_before
) {

  stop(
    "Inside-RGP metric join changed cell count."
  )
}


n_season_before <-
  nrow(
    metric_whole_season_cells
  )


metric_whole_season_cells <-
  metric_whole_season_cells |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    season_metric_lookup,
    by = c(
      "Year",
      "Pasture_ID"
    ),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )


if (
  nrow(
    metric_whole_season_cells
  ) != n_season_before
) {

  stop(
    "Whole-season metric join changed cell count."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 6. MISSING-DATA QC
# ============================================================

period_metric_qc <-
  period_metric_lookup |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    RGP =
      paste0(
        "RGP",
        Rotation_Period
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    Year,
    RGP
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(

    LWG_nonmissing =
      sum(
        is.finite(LWG_all)
      ),

    CH4_nonmissing =
      sum(
        is.finite(CH4_all)
      ),

    CO2_nonmissing =
      sum(
        is.finite(CO2_all)
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    Year,
    RGP
  )


cat(
  "\nPeriod metric availability by Year x RGP:\n"
)

print(
  period_metric_qc
)


# ============================================================
# 7. HELPER: MISSING PANEL LABELS
# ============================================================

make_missing_period_labels <- function(
    cell_sf,
    value_col,
    missing_label
) {

  panel_sf <-
    cell_sf |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      Year,
      Rotation_Label
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(

      N_cells =
        dplyr::n(),

      N_metric =
        sum(
          is.finite(
            .data[[
              value_col
            ]]
          )
        ),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      N_cells > 0L,
      N_metric == 0L
    )


  if (
    nrow(
      panel_sf
    ) == 0L
  ) {

    return(
      NULL
    )
  }


  panel_sf <-
    suppressWarnings(
      sf::st_point_on_surface(
        panel_sf
      )
    )


  xy <-
    sf::st_coordinates(
      panel_sf
    )


  panel_df <-
    sf::st_drop_geometry(
      panel_sf
    )


  panel_df$x <-
    xy[, 1]


  panel_df$y <-
    xy[, 2]


  panel_df$Missing_Label <-
    missing_label


  panel_df
}


# ============================================================
# 7B. MAP VALUE LABEL HELPERS
# ============================================================

format_metric_label <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    !is.finite(x) ~ NA_character_,
    abs(x) >= 100 ~ scales::label_number(
      big.mark = ",",
      accuracy = 1
    )(x),
    abs(x) >= 10 ~ scales::label_number(
      big.mark = ",",
      accuracy = 0.1
    )(x),
    TRUE ~ scales::label_number(
      big.mark = ",",
      accuracy = 0.01
    )(x)
  )
}

make_period_value_labels <- function(
    cell_sf,
    value_col
) {

  value_df <-
    cell_sf |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Year,
      Pasture_ID,
      Rotation_Period,
      Rotation_Label,
      Metric_Value = .data[[value_col]]
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(Metric_Value)
    )

  if (nrow(value_df) == 0L) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  polygon_sf <-
    active_period_sf |>
    dplyr::select(
      Year,
      Pasture_ID,
      Rotation_Period,
      Rotation_Label,
      geometry
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      Year,
      Pasture_ID,
      Rotation_Period,
      Rotation_Label
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      geometry = sf::st_union(geometry),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(
      value_df,
      by = c(
        "Year",
        "Pasture_ID",
        "Rotation_Period",
        "Rotation_Label"
      )
    )

  if (nrow(polygon_sf) == 0L) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  point_sf <-
    sf::st_point_on_surface(
      polygon_sf
    )

  xy <-
    sf::st_coordinates(
      point_sf
    )

  out <-
    point_sf |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      x = xy[, 1],
      y = xy[, 2],
      # Match the manuscript-style example: pasture on line 1,
      # metric value on line 2 (e.g., P1\n20.4).
      Label = paste0(
        "P", Pasture_ID, "\n",
        format_metric_label(Metric_Value)
      )
    )

  out
}

make_season_value_labels <- function(
    cell_sf,
    value_col
) {

  value_df <-
    cell_sf |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Year,
      Pasture_ID,
      Metric_Value = .data[[value_col]]
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct() |>
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(Metric_Value)
    )

  if (nrow(value_df) == 0L) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  polygon_sf <-
    pasture_sf |>
    dplyr::select(
      Pasture_ID,
      geometry
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(
      Pasture_ID
    ) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      geometry = sf::st_union(geometry),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::right_join(
      value_df,
      by = "Pasture_ID"
    )

  if (nrow(polygon_sf) == 0L) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble()
    )
  }

  point_sf <-
    sf::st_point_on_surface(
      polygon_sf
    )

  xy <-
    sf::st_coordinates(
      point_sf
    )

  out <-
    point_sf |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      x = xy[, 1],
      y = xy[, 2],
      # Match the manuscript-style example: pasture on line 1,
      # metric value on line 2 (e.g., P1\n20.4).
      Label = paste0(
        "P", Pasture_ID, "\n",
        format_metric_label(Metric_Value)
      )
    )

  out
}

# ============================================================
# 8. PERIOD MAP FUNCTION
# ============================================================

make_period_metric_map <- function(
    cell_sf,
    value_col,
    title_text,
    subtitle_text,
    legend_title,
    missing_label
) {

  missing_labels <-
    make_missing_period_labels(
      cell_sf =
        cell_sf,
      value_col =
        value_col,
      missing_label =
        missing_label
    )

  value_labels <-
    make_period_value_labels(
      cell_sf = cell_sf,
      value_col = value_col
    )


  p <-
    ggplot2::ggplot() +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Background pasture polygons
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data =
        pasture_sf,
      fill =
        "grey97",
      color =
        "grey70",
      linewidth =
        0.25
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Active cells
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data =
        cell_sf,
      mapping =
        ggplot2::aes(
          fill =
            .data[[
              value_col
            ]]
        ),
      color =
        NA
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RGP outlines
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data =
        active_period_sf,
      fill =
        NA,
      color =
        "black",
      linewidth =
        0.45
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Value labels
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ggplot2::geom_label(
      data =
        value_labels,
      mapping =
        ggplot2::aes(
          x = x,
          y = y,
          label = Label
        ),
      inherit.aes =
        FALSE,
      size =
        2.7,
      fontface =
        "bold",
      fill =
        scales::alpha("white", 0.92),
      color =
        "black",
      label.size =
        0.20,
      label.padding =
        grid::unit(0.10, "lines"),
      label.r =
        grid::unit(0.03, "lines"),
      lineheight =
        0.90,
      check_overlap =
        FALSE
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Facets
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ggplot2::facet_grid(
      Year ~ Rotation_Label,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Metric color scale
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(

      option = "C",

      na.value =
        "grey90",

      breaks =
        scales::breaks_pretty(
          n = 5
        ),

      labels =
        scales::label_number(
          big.mark = ",",
          accuracy = 1
        ),

      name =
        legend_title
    ) +

    ggplot2::coord_sf(
      datum = NA,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(
      title =
        title_text,
      subtitle =
        paste0(
          subtitle_text,
          "; labels show pasture (P1-P6) and metric value"
        ),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_bw() +

    ggplot2::theme(

      axis.text =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      axis.ticks =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      panel.grid =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      legend.position =
        "bottom",

      legend.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 10,
          face = "bold"
        ),

      legend.text =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 8
        ),

      strip.text =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 8
        ),

      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = 14
        ),

      plot.subtitle =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 10
        )
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Add explicit No-data label
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (
    !is.null(
      missing_labels
    ) &&
      nrow(
        missing_labels
      ) > 0L
  ) {

    p <-
      p +
      ggplot2::geom_label(

        data =
          missing_labels,

        mapping =
          ggplot2::aes(
            x = x,
            y = y,
            label =
              Missing_Label
          ),

        inherit.aes =
          FALSE,

        size =
          3,

        fontface =
          "bold",

        fill =
          "white",

        color =
          "grey20",

        label.size =
          0.2
      )
  }


  p
}

# 9. WHOLE-SEASON MAP FUNCTION

make_season_metric_map <- function(
    cell_sf,
    value_col,

    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data =

      fill =
        "grey97",
      color =
        "grey70",
      linewidth =
        0.25
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_sf(
      data =
        cell_sf,
      mapping =
        ggplot2::aes(
          fill =
            .data[[
              value_col
            ]]
        ),
      color =
        NA
    ) +

    ggplot2::geom_label(
      data =
        value_labels,
      mapping =
        ggplot2::aes(
          x = x,
          y = y,
          label = Label
        ),
      inherit.aes =
        FALSE,
      size =
        2.9,
      fontface =
        "bold",
      fill =
        scales::alpha("white", 0.92),
      color =
        "black",
      label.size =
        0.20,
      label.padding =
        grid::unit(0.10, "lines"),
      label.r =
        grid::unit(0.03, "lines"),
      lineheight =
        0.90,
      check_overlap =
        FALSE
    ) +

    ggplot2::facet_wrap(
      ~ Year,
      nrow = 1
    ) +

    ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(

      option = "C",

      na.value =
        "grey90",

      breaks =
        scales::breaks_pretty(
          n = 5
        ),

      labels =
        scales::label_number(
          big.mark = ",",
          accuracy = 1
        ),

      name =
        legend_title
    ) +

    ggplot2::coord_sf(

      expand = FALSE
    ) +

    ggplot2::labs(

      title =
        title_text,

      subtitle =
        paste0(
          "Unique occupied 10 × 10 m cells pooled across ",
          "the whole season; each cell counted once; ",
          "labels show pasture (P1-P6) and metric value"
        ),

      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +

    ggplot2::theme_bw() +

    ggplot2::theme(

      axis.text =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      axis.ticks =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      panel.grid =
        ggplot2::element_blank(),

      legend.position =
        "bottom",

      legend.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 10,
          face = "bold"
        ),

      legend.text =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 8
        ),

      strip.text =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 9
        ),

      plot.title =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          face = "bold",
          size = 14
        ),

      plot.subtitle =
        ggplot2::element_text(
          size = 10
        )
    )
}
```

## 9.6 Shared Gaussian mixed-model results

This section collects the retained analyses for manuscript reporting. Sections 1–5.5
remain the reference: the four monthly behavior/movement models and their existing
EMMs, post-hoc letters, and tests are reused. They are not replaced by models of newly
calculated season means. The whole-window spline ADG model and spatial-area models
already fitted in Section 6 are likewise reused when their response-specific analysis
rows match. Other scientifically distinct outcomes are fitted once with Gaussian LMMs.

`TRT` and `SR` are assigned to physical pastures. The design audit checks independent
pastures in each factorial cell, and each retained response has its own complete-case
sample count and replication audit. Animals, periods, and study years are not independent
pasture treatment replicates. When a cell has fewer than two independent pastures,
management P-values and management grouping letters are withheld from confirmatory
reporting; available raw model-based tests remain explicitly exploratory and may be
shown with that limitation in the publication tables.

All responses use the requested Year and physical Pasture random intercepts.
Period responses include `TRT * SR + Period` as fixed effects; whole-season and
preserved monthly reference responses retain `TRT * SR`. No additional pasture-year
or animal random intercept is included. Pasture-year and animal-year identifiers
remain available for observation keys and sample-count audits only. These requested
models may leave additional within-animal, pasture-year, or serial correlation
unmodeled; the publication and model documentation retain that limitation. Grouping
factors are not removed because of a singular fit. The three observed years give
limited precision for year variance. The protected monthly reference models and
their original results are preserved. The additive Period effect estimates a common
period pattern across treatment and stocking-rate cells. EMM requests still cover
all `TRT × SR × Period` cells; that prediction grid does not add Period interactions
to the fitted model.

Gaussian diagnostics, including applicable Shapiro–Wilk tests, are descriptive checks.
A significant normality test does not trigger deletion, transformation, or a different
family. Strong residual violations, non-estimability, or convergence failure are recorded
for scientific review. There is no distribution selection, AR(1) model selection,
fixed-model fallback, or silent removal of experimental grouping factors.

```{r statistical-results-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Helpers are defined in the initial setup chunk and used by all later sections.
stopifnot(is.function(afri_fit_lmm), is.function(afri_inference),
          is.function(afri_diagnose_lmm))
analysis_output_dir <- file.path(master_output_root, "06_Statistical_Analysis")

# Normalization changes labels/types only; the scientific outcomes are unchanged.
afri_normalize_trt <- function(x) {
  x <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("Continuous", "C_C", "CC", "CG", "Continuous grazing") ~ "Continuous",
    x %in% c("Rotational", "R_G", "RG", "VF-RG", "VF_RG", "Rotational grazing") ~ "Rotational",
    TRUE ~ x)
}
afri_normalize_sr <- function(x) {
  x <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  dplyr::case_when(x %in% c("Light", "L", "light") ~ "Light",
                  x %in% c("Moderate", "M", "moderate") ~ "Moderate",
                  x %in% c("Heavy", "H", "heavy") ~ "Heavy", TRUE ~ x)
}
afri_normalize_pasture <- function(x) {
  n <- suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(x)))
  ifelse(is.finite(n), paste0("Pasture_", as.integer(n)), as.character(x))
}
afri_model_id <- function(dataset_key, response) paste(dataset_key, response, sep = "__")
afri_set_sum_contrasts <- function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x) && nlevels(x) > 1L) contrasts(x) <- stats::contr.sum(nlevels(x))
  x
}
afri_pick_numeric <- function(tab, candidates) {
  hit <- intersect(candidates, names(tab))
  if (length(hit)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tab[[hit[1L]]])) else rep(NA_real_, nrow(tab))
}
afri_period_label <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  ifelse(grepl("^RGP", x), x, paste0("RGP", x))
}
```

## 9.8 Experimental-unit audit

The audit uses physical pasture mappings, not the number of records. It also detects
conflicting management assignments. Complete-case replication is rechecked separately
for every response below, because missing outcomes can change the available design.

```{r statistical-design-audit, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
analysis_design_map <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(c(statistical_reference_data, analysis_datasets), function(d) {
    missing <- setdiff(c("Year", "Pasture", "TRT", "SR"), names(d))
    if (length(missing)) stop("Analysis input lacks design columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
    dplyr::transmute(d, Year = as.character(Year),
      Pasture = afri_normalize_pasture(Pasture), TRT = afri_normalize_trt(TRT),
      SR = afri_normalize_sr(SR))
  })) |> dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(Year, Pasture, TRT, SR)) |> dplyr::distinct()
analysis_pasture_mapping <- dplyr::distinct(analysis_design_map, Pasture, TRT, SR)
analysis_pasture_mapping_conflicts <- analysis_pasture_mapping |>
  dplyr::count(Pasture, name = "N_factorial_assignments") |>
  dplyr::filter(N_factorial_assignments > 1L)
if (nrow(analysis_pasture_mapping_conflicts)) {
  stop("Physical pasture has conflicting TRT × SR assignments; correct the mapping before inference.")
}
afri_replication_audit <- function(d) {
  dplyr::distinct(d, Pasture, TRT, SR) |>
    dplyr::count(TRT, SR, name = "N_physical_pastures") |>
    dplyr::mutate(TRT = as.character(TRT), SR = as.character(SR)) |>
    tidyr::complete(TRT = c("Continuous", "Rotational"),
      SR = c("Light", "Moderate", "Heavy"), fill = list(N_physical_pastures = 0L))
}
analysis_cell_replication <- afri_replication_audit(analysis_design_map)
analysis_design_has_cell_replication <- all(analysis_cell_replication$N_physical_pastures >= 2L)
analysis_design_summary <- tibble::tibble(
  Item = c("Physical pastures", "Observed years", "Minimum pastures per TRT × SR cell",
           "Independent factorial cell replication", "Experimental unit"),
  Value = c(as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(analysis_design_map$Pasture)),
    paste(sort(unique(analysis_design_map$Year)), collapse = ", "),
    as.character(min(analysis_cell_replication$N_physical_pastures)),
    ifelse(analysis_design_has_cell_replication, "Yes", "No"), "Physical pasture"))
analysis_pasture_influence_audit <- analysis_pasture_mapping |>
  dplyr::mutate(Removing_pasture_removes_factorial_cell = !analysis_design_has_cell_replication,
    Influence_note = ifelse(analysis_design_has_cell_replication,
      "Evaluate influence with remaining independent pasture replication.",
      "Deleting this pasture deletes its factorial cell; routine pasture deletion cannot establish treatment robustness."))
if (!analysis_design_has_cell_replication) warning(
  "Pasture treatment cells are unreplicated. Management inference is exploratory; confirmatory P-values and letters are withheld.")
analysis_design_summary
analysis_cell_replication
```

## 9.9 Response-specific Gaussian LMMs and reuse audit

Incomplete rows are filtered for the variables required by that response only. The
specified random effects are retained even when their variances reach zero. A model
that lacks the observations needed for its design is marked unavailable; it is not
replaced by an unclustered regression. The requested Year/Pasture intercepts account
for those shared groups, but no animal intercept, pasture-year intercept, or AR(1)
residual process is modeled. Additional within-animal and within-pasture-year
correlation and residual time patterns require scientific review.

```{r statistical-response-models, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
afri_prepare_model_data <- function(data, response, scale, unit, subject_col = NULL) {
  required <- c(response, "Year", "Pasture", "TRT", "SR")
  if (scale == "period") required <- c(required, "Period")
  if (unit == "animal") required <- c(required, subject_col)
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(data))
  if (length(missing)) stop(response, ": missing required columns ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  # Retain only columns needed for fitting/auditing, avoiding full-dataset copies.
  d <- as.data.frame(data[, unique(required), drop = FALSE])
  d[[response]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[response]]))
  d$Year <- factor(d$Year)
  d$Pasture <- factor(afri_normalize_pasture(d$Pasture))
  d$TRT <- factor(afri_normalize_trt(d$TRT), levels = c("Continuous", "Rotational"))
  d$SR <- factor(afri_normalize_sr(d$SR), levels = c("Light", "Moderate", "Heavy"))
  if (scale == "period") d$Period <- factor(afri_period_label(d$Period), levels = paste0("RGP", 1:5))
  keep <- stats::complete.cases(d[, required, drop = FALSE]) & is.finite(d[[response]])
  d <- droplevels(d[keep, , drop = FALSE])
  if (!nrow(d)) stop(response, ": no complete finite observations remain.")
  if (nlevels(d$TRT) != 2L || nlevels(d$SR) != 3L) stop(response, ": incomplete factorial levels; model not silently simplified.")
  if (nlevels(d$Year) < 2L || nlevels(d$Pasture) < 2L) stop(response, ": required Year/Pasture grouping is not estimable.")
  d$Pasture_Year <- interaction(d$Pasture, d$Year, drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)
  if (unit == "animal") {
    d$Animal_Year_ID <- interaction(d$Year, d$Pasture, d[[subject_col]], drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)
  }
  observation_key <- c("Year", "Pasture")
  if (unit == "animal") observation_key <- c(observation_key, subject_col)
  if (scale == "period") observation_key <- c(observation_key, "Period")
  if (anyDuplicated(d[, observation_key, drop = FALSE])) {
    stop(response, ": more than one row for an expected analysis unit; inspect aggregation before fitting.")
  }
  # Metadata identifiers support keys/counts; they are not fitted random effects.
  if (scale == "period" && nlevels(d$Period) < 2L) stop(response, ": fewer than two Period levels.")
  d$TRT <- afri_set_sum_contrasts(d$TRT)
  d$SR <- afri_set_sum_contrasts(d$SR)
  if (scale == "period") d$Period <- afri_set_sum_contrasts(d$Period)
  d
}

# Equality checks compare complete-case observation keys and outcome values. Renamed
# grouping columns are normalized, but unequal rows are never declared duplicates.
afri_analysis_signature <- function(d, response, period_col = NULL, subject_col = NULL) {
  choose <- function(candidates) {
    hit <- intersect(candidates, names(d))
    if (!length(hit)) stop("Cannot compare model rows; missing ", paste(candidates, collapse = "/"))
    hit[1L]
  }
  year <- choose(c("Year", "YearFactor"))
  pasture <- choose(c("Pasture", "Pasture_ID"))
  ans <- data.frame(Year = as.character(d[[year]]),
    Pasture = afri_normalize_pasture(d[[pasture]]), TRT = afri_normalize_trt(d$TRT),
    SR = afri_normalize_sr(d$SR), Value = as.numeric(d[[response]]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(period_col)) ans$Period <- afri_period_label(d[[period_col]])
  if (!is.null(subject_col)) ans$Animal <- as.character(d[[subject_col]])
  ans <- ans[stats::complete.cases(ans) & is.finite(ans$Value), , drop = FALSE]
  ord <- do.call(order, ans[, setdiff(names(ans), "Value"), drop = FALSE])
  ans <- ans[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(ans) <- NULL
  ans
}
afri_same_analysis_rows <- function(d1, r1, d2, r2, p1 = NULL, p2 = NULL, s1 = NULL, s2 = NULL) {
  tryCatch(isTRUE(all.equal(afri_analysis_signature(d1, r1, p1, s1),
    afri_analysis_signature(d2, r2, p2, s2), tolerance = 1e-10, check.attributes = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) FALSE)
}
afri_model_counts <- function(d, unit) {
  tibble::tibble(N_obs = nrow(d),
    N_animals = if (unit == "animal") dplyr::n_distinct(d$Animal_Year_ID) else NA_integer_,
    N_pastures = dplyr::n_distinct(d$Pasture), N_years = dplyr::n_distinct(d$Year),
    N_pasture_years = dplyr::n_distinct(d$Pasture_Year))
}
# Normalize synonymous period columns and interaction ordering before comparing
# actual fitted terms. The EMM prediction grid is not a model-term specification.
afri_fixed_term_signature <- function(model) {
  terms <- attr(stats::terms(lme4::nobars(stats::formula(model))), "term.labels")
  sort(vapply(strsplit(terms, ":", fixed = TRUE), function(parts) {
    parts[parts %in% c("Period", "RGP", "RotationPeriod")] <- "Period"
    paste(sort(parts), collapse = ":")
  }, character(1)))
}
afri_requested_fixed_terms <- function(scale) {
  sort(c("TRT", "SR", "SR:TRT", if (scale == "period") "Period"))
}
afri_fit_one_response <- function(spec_row, fits) {
  key <- spec_row$Dataset_key[[1L]]
  response <- spec_row$Response[[1L]]
  scale <- spec_row$Scale[[1L]]
  unit <- spec_row$Unit[[1L]]
  subject <- spec_row$Subject[[1L]]
  fit <- list(dataset_key = key, dataset = spec_row$Dataset[[1L]], response = response,
    table = spec_row$Table[[1L]], scale = scale, unit = unit,
    distribution = "Gaussian", link = "identity", engine = "lme4::lmer / lmerTest",
    source = "new retained model", export_owner = "06_Statistical_Analysis",
    correlation_selection = "Requested Year/Pasture-only Gaussian LMM; no covariance/family selection.",
    correlation_limitation = if (scale == "period" && unit == "animal") {
      "Requested Year/Pasture intercepts omit animal and pasture-year intercepts; additional within-animal, pasture-year, or serial correlation may remain."
    } else if (scale == "period") {
      "Requested Year/Pasture intercepts omit a pasture-year intercept and serial residual covariance; additional repeated pasture-year correlation may remain."
    } else if (key == "table1") {
      "Preserved monthly reference Year/Pasture model omits an animal intercept; additional within-animal monthly correlation may remain."
    } else "Requested Year/Pasture intercepts; the small number of observed years limits year-variance precision.")
  if (key == "table1") {
    # These are the published reference objects: preserve their data/models/results.
    m <- statistical_reference_models[[response]]
    data <- statistical_reference_data[[response]]
    fitted_response <- if (response == "mean_DDT_day") response else "mean_hours"
    mf <- stats::model.frame(m)
    used <- match(rownames(mf), rownames(as.data.frame(data)))
    if (anyNA(used)) stop(response, ": cannot identify rows of the preserved reference model.")
    data <- as.data.frame(data)[used, , drop = FALSE]
    data$Year <- factor(data$Year)
    data$Pasture <- factor(afri_normalize_pasture(data$Pasture))
    data$TRT <- factor(afri_normalize_trt(data$TRT), levels = c("Continuous", "Rotational"))
    data$SR <- factor(afri_normalize_sr(data$SR), levels = c("Light", "Moderate", "Heavy"))
    data$Pasture_Year <- interaction(data$Pasture, data$Year, drop = TRUE)
    data$Animal_Year_ID <- interaction(data$Year, data$Pasture, data$REAL_ID, drop = TRUE)
    fit$model <- m
    fit$data <- data
    fit$fitted_response <- fitted_response
    fit$source <- "Preserved Sections 1–5.5 reference model/results"
    # The retained Table 1 occupies the first results-workbook sheet.
    # Its reference-model RDS export remains owned by the original behavior section.
    fit$export_owner <- "06_Statistical_Analysis/01_Tables/AFRI_Statistical_Results.xlsx"
    result <- table1_results[[statistical_reference_labels[[response]]]]
    if (is.null(result)) stop("Missing retained Table 1 result for ", response)
    fit$inference <- list(emmeans = result$emm_posthoc, cld = result$emm_posthoc,
      anova = result$anova, emm = statistical_reference_emm_objects[[response]],
      pairs = data.frame(), df_method = "Preserved reference tests; see test source")
    fit$repeated_structure <- "(1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture)"
  } else {
    data <- afri_prepare_model_data(analysis_datasets[[key]], response, scale, unit, subject)
    fixed <- if (scale == "period") "TRT * SR + Period" else "TRT * SR"
    random <- "(1 | Year) + (1 | Pasture)"
    formula <- stats::as.formula(paste(response, "~", fixed, "+", random))
    fit$data <- data
    fit$fitted_response <- response
    fit$repeated_structure <- random
    if (key == "season_pasture" && response %in% c("mean_Shrunk_Initial_BW_kg",
        "mean_Shrunk_Final_BW_kg", "mean_Whole_Season_Smooth_ADG_kg_day",
        "whole_season_animal_avg_CH4_g_day", "whole_season_animal_avg_CO2_g_day")) {
      fit$source <- "Prespecified pasture-mean aggregation sensitivity; observation unit and weighting differ from animal-level results."
    }
    fit$model <- NULL
    # Whole-window spline ADG has already been fitted and inferred in Section 6.
    if (key == "table2_adg" && response == "Smooth_Period_ADG") {
      if (!afri_same_analysis_rows(data, response, adg_model_data, response, s1 = "SEID", s2 = "SEID")) {
        stop("Whole-window ADG rows differ from the retained Section 6 model; resolve the inconsistency.")
      }
      fit$model <- smooth_adg_model
      fit$inference <- smooth_adg_inference
      fit$source <- "Retained Section 6 whole-window spline ADG model"
      fit$export_owner <- "02_Grazing_BW_AFRI"
    }
    # Section 6 is authoritative for these matched-grid area questions. A
    # missing/failed source or unequal observation rows requires reconciliation;
    # it must never fall through to a competing model with different settings.
    area_key <- switch(response,
      active_ha_all_pasture = "ALL_PASTURE_GRAZING__RGP",
      active_ha_inside_rgp = "INSIDE_RGP_GRAZING__RGP",
      active_ha_whole_season = "WHOLE_SEASON_GRAZING__Season", NULL)
    if (is.null(fit$model) && !is.null(area_key)) {
      if (!exists("pasture_use_models", inherits = TRUE) || !is.list(pasture_use_models)) {
        stop(area_key, ": required Section 6 pasture_use_models registry is unavailable; no replacement area model fitted.")
      }
      area <- pasture_use_models[[area_key]]
      if (is.null(area)) {
        stop(area_key, ": required Section 6 area-model entry is missing; no replacement area model fitted.")
      }
      if (!inherits(area$model, "lmerMod")) {
        source_note <- if (!is.null(area$audit$Note)) {
          paste(unique(stats::na.omit(as.character(area$audit$Note))), collapse = "; ")
        } else ""
        stop(area_key, ": retained Section 6 Gaussian area model is unavailable or failed",
          if (nzchar(source_note)) paste0(": ", source_note) else ".",
          " No replacement area model fitted.")
      }
      pd <- if (scale == "period") "Period" else NULL
      pa <- if (scale == "period") "RGP" else NULL
      if (!afri_same_analysis_rows(data, response, area$data, "Active_ha", pd, pa)) {
        stop(area_key, ": integrated area rows/values differ from the retained Section 6 model; reconcile the datasets before inference. No replacement area model fitted.")
      }
      fit$model <- area$model
      fit$inference <- area$inference
      fit$diagnostics <- area$diagnostics
      fit$source <- paste("Retained Section 6 matched-grid area model:", area_key)
      fit$export_owner <- "02_Grazing_BW_AFRI"
      fit$period_column <- pa
    }
    # Pasture-period gas means originate in the existing GreenFeed mean table.
    # They retain the original GF measurement window, which may differ from the
    # GPS/BW window. Matching response rows AND window provenance permits reuse;
    # the land-productivity ratios remain separate scientific questions.
    period_gas <- switch(response, CH4_g_animal_day = "CH4", CO2_g_animal_day = "CO2", NULL)
    if (is.null(fit$model) && key == "period_pasture" && !is.null(period_gas) &&
        exists("gf_rotation_inference", inherits = TRUE)) {
      source_data <- if (period_gas == "CH4") ch4_rotation_model_data else co2_rotation_model_data
      source_response <- paste0(period_gas, "_g_d")
      source_model <- if (period_gas == "CH4") ch4_rotation_year_random_model else co2_rotation_year_random_model
      original <- analysis_datasets[[key]]
      windows_match_source <- FALSE
      if (exists("rgp_gas_windows", inherits = TRUE) &&
          all(c("GF_start", "GF_end", "Rotation_Period", "Pasture_ID") %in% names(original))) {
        used_windows <- original |>
          dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data[[response]])) |>
          dplyr::transmute(Year = as.character(Year), Pasture_ID = as.character(Pasture_ID),
            Rotation_Period = as.character(Rotation_Period), GF_start = as.Date(GF_start), GF_end = as.Date(GF_end))
        source_windows <- rgp_gas_windows |>
          dplyr::transmute(Year = as.character(Year), Pasture_ID = as.character(Pasture_ID),
            Rotation_Period = as.character(Rotation_Period),
            Source_start = as.Date(GF_start), Source_end = as.Date(GF_end))
        compared <- dplyr::left_join(used_windows, source_windows,
          by = c("Year", "Pasture_ID", "Rotation_Period"), relationship = "many-to-one")
        windows_match_source <- nrow(compared) > 0L &&
          all(!is.na(compared$GF_start) & !is.na(compared$GF_end) &
              !is.na(compared$Source_start) & !is.na(compared$Source_end) &
              compared$GF_start == compared$Source_start & compared$GF_end == compared$Source_end)
      }
      rows_match_source <- afri_same_analysis_rows(data, response, source_data,
        source_response, "Period", "RotationPeriod")
      if (rows_match_source && !windows_match_source) stop(
        "Existing GreenFeed mean model has matching response rows but GF window provenance is unavailable or conflicting; no duplicate model fitted.")
      if (windows_match_source && rows_match_source) {
        fit$model <- source_model
        fit$inference <- gf_rotation_inference[[period_gas]]
        fit$source <- paste("Retained GreenFeed pasture-period mean model:", period_gas,
          "; matching mean observations and GF measurement-window provenance.")
        fit$export_owner <- "03_Grazing_GreenFeed_AFRI"
        fit$period_column <- "RotationPeriod"
      } else {
        fit$source <- "Period gas mean sensitivity: complete response rows or GF window provenance differ from the retained GreenFeed primary analysis."
      }
    }
    # Gas columns joined to endpoint data are aliases only when their keys and
    # values match; otherwise retain an explicitly stated subset sensitivity.
    gas_alias <- switch(response, Whole_Season_CH4_g_day = "CH4_Mean_g_d",
      Whole_Season_CO2_g_day = "CO2_Mean_g_d", NULL)
    if (is.null(fit$model) && key == "shrunk_season" && !is.null(gas_alias)) {
      prior <- fits[[afri_model_id("dressler", gas_alias)]]
      if (!is.null(prior) && !is.null(prior$model) &&
          afri_same_analysis_rows(data, response, prior$data, gas_alias, s1 = "SEID", s2 = "SEID")) {
        fit$model <- prior$model
        fit$inference <- prior$inference
        fit$diagnostics <- prior$diagnostics
        fit$source <- paste("Equivalent joined response; reuses", afri_model_id("dressler", gas_alias))
        fit$export_owner <- prior$export_owner
        fit$reuse_model_id <- afri_model_id("dressler", gas_alias)
      } else {
        fit$source <- "Endpoint-linked subset sensitivity; observation keys differ from full Dressler animal-season analysis."
      }
    }
    if (is.null(fit$model)) fit$model <- afri_fit_lmm(formula, data,
      question_id = afri_model_id(key, response), REML = TRUE)
    if (is.null(fit$inference)) fit$inference <- afri_inference(fit$model,
      emm_specs = if (scale == "period") ~ TRT * SR * Period else ~ TRT * SR)
  }
  # A later chunk must not silently reuse an old fit from before the requested
  # structure change. Re-run the source model chunks if this audit fails.
  fitted_groups <- names(lme4::ranef(fit$model))
  normalized_groups <- ifelse(fitted_groups == "YearFactor", "Year",
    ifelse(fitted_groups == "Pasture_ID", "Pasture", fitted_groups))
  if (!identical(sort(normalized_groups), c("Pasture", "Year"))) {
    stop(response, ": retained source model does not match the requested Year/Pasture-only random structure; rerun its source model chunks. No competing model fitted.")
  }
  fitted_terms <- afri_fixed_term_signature(fit$model)
  if (!identical(fitted_terms, afri_requested_fixed_terms(scale))) {
    stop(response, ": retained source model does not match the requested fixed-effects structure (TRT * SR",
      if (scale == "period") " + additive Period" else "", "); rerun its source model chunks. No competing model fitted.")
  }
  fit$fixed_structure <- if (scale == "period") "TRT * SR + Period" else "TRT * SR"
  fit$actual_fixed_terms <- fitted_terms
  fit$repeated_structure <- paste(paste0("(1 | ", fitted_groups, ")"), collapse = " + ")
  fit$formula <- paste(deparse(stats::formula(fit$model)), collapse = " ")
  fit$counts <- afri_model_counts(fit$data, unit)
  if (fit$counts$N_obs != stats::nobs(fit$model)) stop(response, ": model/data sample-size mismatch.")
  fit$cell_replication <- afri_replication_audit(fit$data)
  fit$management_replicated <- all(fit$cell_replication$N_physical_pastures >= 2L)
  fit$inference_note <- paste(if (fit$management_replicated) "Replicated physical-pasture factorial cells." else
    "Exploratory/conditional management inference: fewer than two independent physical pastures in a TRT × SR cell.",
    fit$correlation_limitation,
    if (scale == "period") "Period is additive: treatment/stocking-rate-specific period patterns are not estimated." else "")
  fit
}

analysis_fits <- list()
analysis_fit_status <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(analysis_specs))) {
  spec_row <- analysis_specs[i, , drop = FALSE]
  id <- afri_model_id(spec_row$Dataset_key, spec_row$Response)
  result <- tryCatch(afri_fit_one_response(spec_row, analysis_fits), error = identity)
  ok <- !inherits(result, "error")
  if (ok) {
    analysis_fits[[id]] <- result
    count <- result$counts
    status <- "Available retained Gaussian LMM"
    note <- result$source
  } else {
    analysis_fits[id] <- list(NULL)
    count <- tibble::tibble(N_obs = NA_integer_, N_animals = NA_integer_,
      N_pastures = NA_integer_, N_years = NA_integer_, N_pasture_years = NA_integer_)
    status <- "Unavailable; no fallback model fitted"
    note <- conditionMessage(result)
    warning(id, ": ", note)
  }
  analysis_fit_status[[id]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    dplyr::select(spec_row, Table, Dataset_key, Dataset, Response, Scale, Unit), count,
    tibble::tibble(Model_ID = id, Status = status, Fit_ok = ok, Note = note))
}
analysis_fit_status <- dplyr::bind_rows(analysis_fit_status)
analysis_grouping_column_audit <- analysis_fit_status |>
  dplyr::select(Model_ID, Dataset_key, Response, N_obs, N_pastures, N_years, N_pasture_years, Status)
analysis_random_effect_column_audit <- analysis_grouping_column_audit
analysis_response_cell_replication <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(analysis_fits, function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  dplyr::mutate(fit$cell_replication, Dataset = fit$dataset, Response = fit$response,
    Model_ID = afri_model_id(fit$dataset_key, fit$response), .before = 1)
}))
```

## 9.10 Inference from retained model objects

EMMs, omnibus tests, and grouping letters come from the retained inference objects.
Management tests are preserved as exploratory audit results when pasture cells are
unreplicated. For period responses, the distinct within-cell period comparison uses
the same EMM grid with Tukey adjustment; it does not fit another model or recalculate
the EMMs. Letters indicate failure to detect differences, not evidence of equality.

```{r statistical-retained-inference, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
afri_fit_identifiers <- function(fit) {
  dplyr::bind_cols(tibble::tibble(Table = fit$table, Dataset_key = fit$dataset_key,
    Dataset = fit$dataset, Response = fit$response, Scale = fit$scale, Unit = fit$unit,
    Model_ID = afri_model_id(fit$dataset_key, fit$response), Source = fit$source,
    Export_owner = fit$export_owner), fit$counts)
}
afri_add_identifiers <- function(tab, fit) {
  tab <- tibble::as_tibble(tab)
  if (!nrow(tab)) return(tab)
  ids <- afri_fit_identifiers(fit)
  ids <- ids[rep(1L, nrow(tab)), , drop = FALSE]
  tab <- dplyr::select(tab, -dplyr::any_of(names(ids)))
  dplyr::bind_cols(ids, tab)
}
afri_normalize_period_column <- function(tab) {
  tab <- as.data.frame(tab)
  if (!"Period" %in% names(tab) && "RGP" %in% names(tab)) tab$Period <- afri_period_label(tab$RGP)
  if (!"Period" %in% names(tab) && "RotationPeriod" %in% names(tab)) tab$Period <- afri_period_label(tab$RotationPeriod)
  if (!"Period" %in% names(tab)) tab$Period <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(tab))
  tab
}
afri_omnibus_tests <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  tab <- as.data.frame(fit$inference$anova)
  term_col <- intersect(c("term", "Term", "Effect"), names(tab))
  term <- if (length(term_col)) as.character(tab[[term_col[1L]]]) else rownames(tab)
  out <- tibble::tibble(Term = gsub("RGP", "Period", gsub("RotationPeriod", "Period", term, fixed = TRUE), fixed = TRUE),
    Statistic = afri_pick_numeric(tab, c("F_value", "F value", "Chisq", "F.ratio", "Statistic")),
    df1 = afri_pick_numeric(tab, c("NumDF", "df1", "Df")),
    df2 = afri_pick_numeric(tab, c("DenDF", "df2")),
    P_value_raw = afri_pick_numeric(tab, c("p.value", "Pr(>F)", "Pr(>Chisq)", "P_value"))) |>
    dplyr::filter(Term != "(Intercept)") |>
    dplyr::mutate(Management_effect = grepl("TRT|SR", Term),
      P_value = ifelse(Management_effect & !fit$management_replicated, NA_real_, P_value_raw),
      Inference_note = ifelse(Management_effect, fit$inference_note,
        paste("Model-based period effect; review diagnostics and estimability.", fit$correlation_limitation)),
      DF_method = fit$inference$df_method,
      Test = if (fit$dataset_key == "table1") "Preserved reference Type III test" else "lmerTest Type III F",
      Effect = Term, Raw_P_value = P_value_raw, Manuscript_P_value = P_value,
      NumDF = df1, DenDF = df2)
  afri_add_identifiers(out, fit)
}
afri_get_emmeans <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  tab <- afri_normalize_period_column(fit$inference$emmeans)
  estimate <- afri_pick_numeric(tab, c("EMM", "emmean", "response"))
  tab$EMM <- estimate
  tab$SE <- afri_pick_numeric(tab, c("SE", "asymp.SE"))
  tab$df <- afri_pick_numeric(tab, "df")
  tab$lower.CL <- afri_pick_numeric(tab, c("lower.CL", "Lower_95CI", "asymp.LCL"))
  tab$upper.CL <- afri_pick_numeric(tab, c("upper.CL", "Upper_95CI", "asymp.UCL"))
  tab$TRT <- afri_normalize_trt(tab$TRT)
  tab$SR <- afri_normalize_sr(tab$SR)
  tab$EMM_Spec <- if (fit$scale == "period")
    "TRT * SR * Period prediction grid; fitted fixed effects TRT * SR + Period" else "TRT * SR"
  tab$Distribution <- "Gaussian"
  tab$Link <- "identity"
  tab$Inference_note <- fit$inference_note
  tab <- dplyr::select(tibble::as_tibble(tab), -dplyr::any_of(c("emmean", "response", "RGP", "RotationPeriod")))
  afri_add_identifiers(tab, fit)
}
# Obtain relevant within-cell period comparisons once; reuse for letters/export.
if (!exists("afri_period_comparison_registry", inherits = FALSE)) {
  afri_period_comparison_registry <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
}
afri_period_comparisons <- function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit) || fit$scale != "period") return(NULL)
  grid <- fit$inference$emm
  cache_key <- paste(afri_model_signature(fit$model),
    digest::digest(grid@grid, algo = "xxhash64"), sep = "_")
  if (exists(cache_key, afri_period_comparison_registry, inherits = FALSE)) {
    return(get(cache_key, afri_period_comparison_registry, inherits = FALSE))
  }
  ans <- tryCatch({
    period_pairs <- as.data.frame(emmeans::contrast(grid, method = "pairwise", by = c("TRT", "SR"), adjust = "tukey"))
    period_letters <- as.data.frame(multcomp::cld(grid, by = c("TRT", "SR"),
      Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey", sort = FALSE))
    list(pairs = period_pairs, cld = period_letters)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(fit$response, ": within-cell period comparisons unavailable: ", conditionMessage(e))
    list(pairs = data.frame(), cld = data.frame())
  })
  assign(cache_key, ans, afri_period_comparison_registry)
  ans
}
analysis_period_comparisons <- lapply(analysis_fits, afri_period_comparisons)
afri_get_contrasts <- function(fit, period_comparisons) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  raw <- afri_normalize_period_column(fit$inference$pairs)
  if (nrow(raw)) {
    raw$Contrast_type <- "Retained EMM-grid pairwise comparisons"
    raw$P_value_raw <- afri_pick_numeric(raw, c("p.value", "P_value_raw"))
    raw$P_value <- if (fit$management_replicated) raw$P_value_raw else NA_real_
    raw$Inference_note <- fit$inference_note
  }
  within <- if (!is.null(period_comparisons)) afri_normalize_period_column(period_comparisons$pairs) else data.frame()
  if (nrow(within)) {
    within$Contrast_type <- "Period within TRT × SR"
    within$P_value_raw <- afri_pick_numeric(within, "p.value")
    within$P_value <- within$P_value_raw
    within$Inference_note <- paste("Tukey-adjusted within-cell period comparison, conditional on the requested model.",
      fit$correlation_limitation)
  }
  afri_add_identifiers(dplyr::bind_rows(raw, within), fit)
}
afri_get_cld <- function(fit, period_comparisons) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  if (fit$scale == "period") {
    tab <- if (!is.null(period_comparisons)) period_comparisons$cld else data.frame()
    scope <- "Period within TRT × SR"
    type <- "Period_within_TRT_SR"
  } else {
    tab <- fit$inference$cld
    scope <- "TRT × SR cells"
    type <- "Management_cells"
  }
  tab <- afri_normalize_period_column(tab)
  if (!nrow(tab)) return(NULL)
  group <- if (".group" %in% names(tab)) tab$.group else if ("PostHoc_Letter" %in% names(tab)) tab$PostHoc_Letter else rep(NA_character_, nrow(tab))
  group <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(group))
  if (fit$scale != "period" && !fit$management_replicated) group[] <- NA_character_
  tab$.group <- group
  tab$Group <- group
  tab$PostHoc_Letter <- group
  tab$CLD_Type <- type
  tab$Grouping_scope <- scope
  tab$TRT <- afri_normalize_trt(tab$TRT)
  tab$SR <- afri_normalize_sr(tab$SR)
  afri_add_identifiers(dplyr::select(tibble::as_tibble(tab), TRT, SR, Period,
    .group, Group, PostHoc_Letter, CLD_Type, Grouping_scope), fit)
}
analysis_omnibus_tests <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(analysis_fits, afri_omnibus_tests))
analysis_emmeans <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(analysis_fits, afri_get_emmeans))
analysis_contrasts <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(analysis_fits), function(id) {
  afri_get_contrasts(analysis_fits[[id]], analysis_period_comparisons[[id]])
}))
analysis_cld <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(analysis_fits), function(id) {
  afri_get_cld(analysis_fits[[id]], analysis_period_comparisons[[id]])
}))
# Explicit empty schemas allow the publication audit to report unavailable models.
if (!nrow(analysis_emmeans)) analysis_emmeans <- tibble::tibble(
  Table = character(), Dataset_key = character(), Dataset = character(), Response = character(),
  Scale = character(), Unit = character(), TRT = character(), SR = character(), Period = character(),
  EMM = double(), SE = double(), df = double(), lower.CL = double(), upper.CL = double(),
  N_obs = integer(), N_animals = integer(), N_pastures = integer(), N_years = integer())
if (!nrow(analysis_omnibus_tests)) analysis_omnibus_tests <- tibble::tibble(
  Table = character(), Dataset_key = character(), Dataset = character(), Response = character(), Term = character(),
  Statistic = double(), df1 = double(), df2 = double(), P_value_raw = double(),
  P_value = double(), Inference_note = character())
if (!nrow(analysis_cld)) analysis_cld <- tibble::tibble(
  Table = character(), Dataset_key = character(), Dataset = character(), Response = character(), TRT = character(),
  SR = character(), Period = character(), .group = character(), Group = character(),
  PostHoc_Letter = character(), CLD_Type = character(), Grouping_scope = character())
```
