## 9.11 Standard Gaussian residual diagnostics

Every retained model is diagnosed through the shared cache. Shapiro–Wilk is reported
only for 3–5000 nonconstant finite residuals; outside that range the numerical test is
explicitly unavailable, with no arbitrary subsampling. Residual-versus-fitted, normal
Q–Q, and scale-location plots accompany the normality check. Variance summaries,
convergence messages, singular fits, and extreme standardized residuals are retained.
Residual flags are for review and never automatically exclude observations.

```{r statistical-model-diagnostics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
analysis_diagnostic_objects <- list()
analysis_influential_observations <- list()
analysis_distribution_audit <- list()
for (id in names(analysis_fits)) {
  fit <- analysis_fits[[id]]
  if (is.null(fit)) next
  diag <- if (!is.null(fit$diagnostics)) fit$diagnostics else afri_diagnose_lmm(fit$model, id)
  analysis_diagnostic_objects[[id]] <- diag
  analysis_fits[[id]]$diagnostics <- diag
  residual <- as.numeric(stats::residuals(fit$model))
  residual_sd <- stats::sigma(fit$model)
  standardized <- if (is.finite(residual_sd) && residual_sd > 0) residual / residual_sd else rep(NA_real_, length(residual))
  flagged <- which(is.finite(standardized) & abs(standardized) > 3)
  if (length(flagged)) {
    model_rows <- rownames(stats::model.frame(fit$model))
    analysis_influential_observations[[id]] <- tibble::tibble(
      Model_ID = id, Dataset = fit$dataset, Response = fit$response,
      Model_row = model_rows[flagged], Residual = residual[flagged],
      Standardized_residual = standardized[flagged],
      Action = "Review only; observation retained. This flag is not a leverage/Cook-distance test.")
  }
  y <- fit$data[[fit$fitted_response]]
  analysis_distribution_audit[[id]] <- dplyr::bind_cols(afri_fit_identifiers(fit),
    tibble::tibble(Min = min(y, na.rm = TRUE), Median = stats::median(y, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE), Max = max(y, na.rm = TRUE), SD = stats::sd(y, na.rm = TRUE),
      N_zero = sum(y == 0, na.rm = TRUE), N_negative = sum(y < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      Distribution = "Gaussian; no automatic family switch"))
}
analysis_model_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(analysis_diagnostic_objects), function(id) {
  afri_add_identifiers(analysis_diagnostic_objects[[id]]$summary, analysis_fits[[id]])
}))
analysis_residual_variance_review <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(analysis_diagnostic_objects), function(id) {
  afri_add_identifiers(analysis_diagnostic_objects[[id]]$variance_review, analysis_fits[[id]])
}))
analysis_random_effect_variances <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(analysis_diagnostic_objects), function(id) {
  afri_add_identifiers(analysis_diagnostic_objects[[id]]$variances, analysis_fits[[id]])
}))

analysis_distribution_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(analysis_distribution_audit)
analysis_year_random_qc <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(analysis_fits, function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  groups <- names(lme4::ranef(fit$model))
  tibble::tibble(Dataset = fit$dataset, Response = fit$response,
    Has_Year_random_intercept = any(groups %in% c("Year", "YearFactor")),
    Formula = fit$formula)

analysis_random_structure_qc <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(analysis_fits, function(fit) {
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  groups <- names(lme4::ranef(fit$model))
  tibble::tibble(Dataset = fit$dataset, Response = fit$response,
    Has_physical_Pasture_random_intercept = any(groups %in% c("Pasture", "Pasture_ID")),
    Has_annual_repeated_cluster = any(groups %in% c("Pasture_Year", "PastureYear", "Year:Pasture_ID", "Pasture_ID:Year")),
    Has_animal_year_random_intercept = "Animal_Year_ID" %in% groups,
    Requested_random_groups = "Year; physical Pasture",
    Actual_random_groups = paste(groups, collapse = "; "),
    Matches_requested_random_structure = length(groups) == 2L &&
      any(groups %in% c("Year", "YearFactor")) && any(groups %in% c("Pasture", "Pasture_ID")),
    Requested_fixed_effects = if (fit$scale == "period") "TRT * SR + Period" else "TRT * SR",
    Actual_fixed_terms = paste(afri_fixed_term_signature(fit$model), collapse = "; "),
    Matches_requested_fixed_structure = identical(afri_fixed_term_signature(fit$model), afri_requested_fixed_terms(fit$scale)),
    Repeated_observation_note = fit$correlation_limitation,
    Formula = fit$formula, Source = fit$source)
}))
```

## 9.12 Model documentation and reporting inputs

The following tables are views of retained results, not another analysis. Final
publication exports are handled once in Section 9.12.1. Model files and diagnostics
are saved here only for newly owned statistical models; reused Section 5/6 outputs
remain at their existing designated locations.

```{r statistical-model-documentation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    `Final statistical model` = fit$formula,
    `R package/function used` = fit$engine,
    `Fixed effects` = fit$fixed_structure,
    `Random/repeated effects` = fit$repeated_structure,
    `Distribution and link` = "Gaussian / identity",
    `Model specification and limitations` = paste("Requested Year/Pasture-only random structure.",
      fit$correlation_limitation, fit$source, fit$inference_note),

    `Omnibus tests` = if (fit$dataset_key == "table1") "Preserved reference Type III tests" else paste("lmerTest Type III;", fit$inference$df_method),
    `Estimated marginal means` = if (fit$scale == "period") "Retained TRT × SR × Period prediction grid from the additive Period model" else "Retained TRT × SR grid",
    `Relevant pairwise comparisons` = if (fit$scale == "period") "Retained grid pairs; Period within TRT × SR" else "Retained TRT × SR grid pairs",
    `Compact-letter displays` = if (fit$scale == "period") "Period within TRT × SR; no management letters without pasture replication" else "Management letters withheld without pasture replication"), fit)
}))

    for (id in owned_ids) {
```

### 9.12.1 Publication-ready manuscript tables

The publication layer consumes the retained results above. It labels sample sizes,
experimental units, model limitations, and the scope of post-hoc letters. Missing or
non-estimable results remain missing; no statistical numbers are fabricated.


### 9.12 Publication tables and analysis audits

This layer formats the retained Gaussian mixed-model results. It does not fit
models, calculate EMMs, repeat post-hoc tests, or read exported files. The
behavior table and its model-specific sample sizes come directly from
`Table_1_Grazing_Behaviors` in Section 5.2; its retained presentation is the
first worksheet of the final statistical workbook. Seasonal individual-animal
responses appear in `Table2`, while season-total land responses appear in
`WholeSeason_Additional`. This routing does not change any fitted model.

Management comparisons with one physical pasture per treatment × stocking-rate
cell are conditional/exploratory. Numerical tests are retained with their
inference limitations visible in the table and audit. Missing or nonestimable
results remain missing; neither SEs nor P-values nor letters are substituted.

```{r publication-table-builders, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# One formatting implementation for all remaining response families.
publication_keys <- c("Table", "Dataset_key", "Dataset", "Response")
publication_cells <- c(
  "Continuous Light", "Continuous Moderate", "Continuous Heavy",
  "Rotational Light", "Rotational Moderate", "Rotational Heavy"
)
publication_terms <- c("TRT", "SR", "TRT:SR", "Period")
publication_term_labels <- c(
  "TRT" = "P: TRT", "SR" = "P: SR", "TRT:SR" = "P: TRT × SR",
  "Period" = "P: Period"
)

publication_require <- function(data, columns, label) {
  missing <- setdiff(columns, names(data))
  if (length(missing)) stop(label, " is missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
                             ". Run the preceding retained-model result chunk.")
  invisible(data)
}
publication_unique <- function(data, columns, label) {
  publication_require(data, columns, label)
  if (anyDuplicated(data[columns])) {
    stop(label, " has duplicate result keys; resolve the source results before reporting.")
  }
  invisible(data)
}
publication_ensure <- function(data, columns, fill = "—") {
  for (nm in setdiff(columns, names(data))) data[[nm]] <- rep(fill, nrow(data))
  data
}
publication_number <- function(x, digits = 2L) {
  digits <- rep_len(as.integer(digits), length(x))
  result <- rep("—", length(x))
  ok <- which(is.finite(x) & is.finite(digits))
  result[ok] <- vapply(ok, function(i) formatC(x[[i]], format = "f",
                       digits = digits[[i]], big.mark = ","), character(1))
  result
}
publication_p <- function(x) {
  result <- rep("—", length(x))
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  result[ok] <- ifelse(x[ok] < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", x[ok]))
  result
}
publication_optional <- function(name) {
  if (!exists(name, inherits = TRUE)) return(tibble::tibble())
  result <- get(name, inherits = TRUE)
  if (is.data.frame(result)) result else tibble::tibble()
}
publication_active_rows <- function(data) {
  # Individual chunks may run in a session that still contains older results.
  # Filter reporting copies to the current specifications without altering
  # source objects or recalculating models, EMMs, tests or diagnostics.
  if (!is.data.frame(data) || !"Response" %in% names(data)) return(data)
  join_keys <- intersect(publication_keys, names(data))
  active <- analysis_specs |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(join_keys)) |> dplyr::distinct()
  dplyr::semi_join(data, active, by = join_keys)
}

publication_retained_omnibus <- publication_active_rows(analysis_omnibus_tests)
publication_retained_cld <- publication_active_rows(analysis_cld)

publication_require(publication_retained_omnibus,

publication_unique(publication_retained_emmeans,

publication_unique(publication_retained_omnibus,

publication_sheet_for <- function(table, response) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    table == "TABLE 1" ~ "Table_1_Grazing_Behaviors",
    table == "TABLE 2" & response %in% publication_season_land_responses ~
      "WholeSeason_Additional",
    table %in% c("TABLE 2", "SHRUNK BW — SEASON") ~ "Table2",
    table == "WHOLE-SEASON TABLES" ~ "WholeSeason_Additional",
    table == "OTHER PERIOD TABLES" ~ "Pasture_RGP",
    table == "SHRUNK BW — PERIOD" ~ "Animal_RGP",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

publication_pvalue_block <- function(metadata, period = FALSE) {
  terms <- if (period) publication_terms else publication_terms[1:3]
  data <- professional_omnibus_long |>
    dplyr::semi_join(dplyr::select(metadata, dplyr::all_of(publication_keys)),
                     by = publication_keys) |>
    dplyr::filter(Term %in% terms) |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(publication_keys), Term, Display_P) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Term, values_from = Display_P, values_fill = "—")
  data <- publication_ensure(data, terms)
  names(data)[match(terms, names(data))] <- unname(publication_term_labels[terms])
  data
}
publication_inference <- professional_omnibus_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(publication_keys))) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Inference = paste(unique(Inference_note[!is.na(Inference_note) &
                                            nzchar(Inference_note)]), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

publication_make_table <- function(worksheet_name, period = FALSE) {
  scale <- if (period) "period" else "season"
  meta <- analysis_response_metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(Publication_sheet == worksheet_name, Scale == scale)
  result_keys <- c(publication_keys, if (period) "Period")
  means <- professional_emm_long |>
    dplyr::semi_join(dplyr::select(meta, dplyr::all_of(publication_keys)),
                     by = publication_keys) |>
    dplyr::filter(Scale == scale) |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(result_keys), Cell, `EMM ± SE`) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Cell, values_from = `EMM ± SE`, values_fill = "—")
  means <- publication_ensure(means, publication_cells)
  data <- meta |>
    dplyr::left_join(means, by = publication_keys) |>
    dplyr::left_join(analysis_model_n, by = publication_keys) |>
    dplyr::left_join(publication_pvalue_block(meta, period), by = publication_keys) |>
    dplyr::left_join(publication_inference, by = publication_keys)
  if (period) {
    data$Period <- factor(data$Period,
      levels = unique(c(paste0("RGP", 1:5), as.character(data$Period))))
    data <- dplyr::arrange(data, Spec_Order, Period)
  } else data <- dplyr::arrange(data, Spec_Order)
  terms <- if (period) publication_terms else publication_terms[1:3]
  p_columns <- unname(publication_term_labels[terms])
  data <- publication_ensure(data, c(publication_cells, p_columns)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(publication_cells, p_columns)),
                               ~ dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.x), "—")),
                  Inference = dplyr::coalesce(Inference,
                    "Inference unavailable: review model-fit status."))
  data |>
    dplyr::select(Variable = Professional_Label,
                  dplyr::any_of(if (period) "Period" else character()),
                  n = N_model, Observation_unit = Unit,
                  dplyr::all_of(publication_cells),
                  dplyr::all_of(p_columns), Inference)
}

# First behavior/movement analysis is authoritative, including monthly model n.
Table1_Professional <- Table_1_Grazing_Behaviors
Table2_Professional <- publication_make_table("Table2")
Whole_Season_Additional_Professional <- publication_make_table("WholeSeason_Additional")
Other_Period_EMMs_Professional <- publication_make_table("Pasture_RGP", period = TRUE)
Shrunk_BW_Period_EMMs_Professional <- publication_make_table("Animal_RGP", period = TRUE)

# One coverage audit supersedes the response-specific repeat QC blocks.
Professional_EMM_SE_Audit <- professional_emm_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(publication_keys))) |>
  dplyr::summarise(N_EMM = dplyr::n(), N_finite_estimates = sum(is.finite(EMM)),
    N_finite_real_SE = sum(is.finite(SE)), N_missing_real_SE = sum(!is.finite(SE)),
    N_letters = sum(!is.na(PostHoc_Letter) & nzchar(PostHoc_Letter)), .groups = "drop")
professional_pvalue_qc <- professional_omnibus_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(publication_keys))) |>
  dplyr::summarise(N_effects = dplyr::n(),
    N_finite_raw_P = sum(is.finite(P_value_raw)),
    Effects_with_P = paste(Term[is.finite(P_value_raw)], collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop")
publication_response_qc <- analysis_response_metadata |>
  dplyr::left_join(analysis_model_n, by = publication_keys) |>
  dplyr::left_join(Professional_EMM_SE_Audit, by = publication_keys) |>
  dplyr::left_join(professional_pvalue_qc, by = publication_keys) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Result_status = dplyr::case_when(
    !is.finite(N_model) | N_model <= 0 ~ "No retained fitted model/EMMs",
    is.na(N_finite_estimates) | N_finite_estimates == 0 ~ "EMMs missing/nonestimable",
    N_missing_real_SE > 0 ~ "Some SEs missing/nonestimable",
    is.na(N_finite_raw_P) | N_finite_raw_P == 0 ~ "Omnibus inference unavailable",
    TRUE ~ "Retained numerical results available; inspect diagnostic/inference flags"
  ))

Animal_RGP_PValue_Audit <- analysis_specs |>
  dplyr::filter(Table == "SHRUNK BW — PERIOD") |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(publication_keys)) |>
  tidyr::expand_grid(Term = publication_terms) |>
  dplyr::left_join(professional_omnibus_long,
                   by = c(publication_keys, "Term")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(P_status = dplyr::case_when(
    is.finite(P_value_raw) & !is.finite(P_value) ~ "Available, exploratory/conditional",
    is.finite(P_value_raw) ~ "Available; consult inference note",
    TRUE ~ "Unavailable/nonestimable; consult model-fit status"
  ))

required_daily_land_responses <- c(
  "CH4_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season",
  "CO2_g_per_active_ha_day_whole_season",
  "ADG_Land_kg_per_active_ha_day_whole_season"
)
Daily_Land_Response_Flow_Audit <- tibble::tibble(Response = required_daily_land_responses) |>

Professional_Exploratory_Management_P_values <- professional_omnibus_long |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("TRT|SR", Term),
                is.finite(P_value_raw), !is.finite(P_value))
Professional_Table_Notes <- tibble::tibble(Note = c(
  "Values are retained Gaussian LMM EMM ± SE. A dash denotes unavailable/nonestimable results; no replacement values are imputed.",
  "n is the number of fitted model observations. Observation_unit identifies animal versus pasture records; Scale in the raw results distinguishes season versus grazing-period observations. Physical pasture is the independent experimental unit for TRT/SR allocation, and Model_Summary retains animal, pasture and year counts. Repeated years/animals are not independent treatment replicates.",
  "P: TRT, P: SR and P: TRT × SR are retained Type III model tests. RGP tables show the additive period test; period differences are common across management combinations under this model.",
  "Management P-values displayed where pasture cells are unreplicated are exploratory/conditional. Their limitations are shown in the Inference column; raw and reporting P-values remain distinct in the omnibus audit.",
  "Different letter groups refer only to the retained comparison scope and multiplicity adjustment. The CLD sheet records Grouping_scope and CLD_Type. Shared letters do not establish equivalence.",
  "Random-effect structure follows the retained experimental-unit/repeated-measure model. Year is random where supported, with no fixed-effect P: Year reported.",
  "Table_1_Grazing_Behaviors preserves the Section 5.2 presentation and is the first worksheet of this workbook. Behavior EMMs and letters are included in the corresponding raw-result sheets; Table1_Reference_ANOVA preserves the full original reference Type III ANOVA rows and columns, including the intercept where present. Those behavior tests are not duplicated in Fixed_Effect_Omnibus, and no standalone Table 1 workbook is written.",
  "Table2 combines whole-season animal-performance and individual-animal responses. WholeSeason_Additional includes whole-season CH4 and CO2 per active hectare, area grazed and LWG per active hectare, alongside the distinct daily land rates. Moving a response between sheets does not change its dataset, model, sample size or inference.",
  "Whole-season daily land rates use whole-season gas totals or chute-derived pasture LWG divided by unique active hectares and pasture-specific season days. Missing/zero denominators yield missing responses.",
  "Residual Shapiro–Wilk tests, residual variance checks, Q–Q plots, convergence and singular-fit flags are evaluated together; a single normality P-value does not determine model validity."
))

publication_table_objects <- list(
  Table_1_Grazing_Behaviors = Table1_Professional,
  Table2 = Table2_Professional,
  WholeSeason_Additional = Whole_Season_Additional_Professional,
  Pasture_RGP = Other_Period_EMMs_Professional,
  Animal_RGP = Shrunk_BW_Period_EMMs_Professional
)
publication_table_qc <- tibble::tibble(
  Table = names(publication_table_objects),
  Rows = vapply(publication_table_objects, nrow, integer(1)),
  Has_required_columns = vapply(names(publication_table_objects), function(sheet) {
    required <- c("Variable", "n", publication_cells, "P: TRT", "P: SR")
    # Preserve the established behavior-table column names and presentation.
    required <- c(required, if (sheet == "Table_1_Grazing_Behaviors")
      "P: TRT * SR" else c("P: TRT × SR", "Observation_unit", "Inference"))

  }, logical(1)),
  Has_fixed_Year_P = vapply(publication_table_objects,

)
```

### 9.13 Final exports

One workbook contains the unique publication tables and numerical/QC records.
The same tables are not additionally saved as CSV or standalone HTML. Retained
model objects and diagnostic figures have their own unique reproducibility
exports in Section 9.11. Only nonempty sheets are written, and setting
`params$export_results: false` prevents all writes in this layer.

```{r publication-statistical-exports, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# The final workbook owns the behavior table and its retained numerical results.
# This is presentation/export reuse; no model or inference is recalculated here.
publication_reference_anova <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(table1_results), function(variable_label) {
  tab <- table1_results[[variable_label]]$anova
  if (!is.data.frame(tab) || !nrow(tab)) return(NULL)
  # Keep the original reference-test columns and every row, including intercept.
  dplyr::bind_cols(tibble::tibble(Variable = rep(variable_label, nrow(tab))),
                   tibble::as_tibble(tab))
}))

if (isTRUE(export_results)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'openxlsx' is required when export_results is TRUE.")
  }
  professional_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
  header_style <- openxlsx::createStyle(textDecoration = "bold",
                                        fgFill = "#E8EEF4", wrapText = TRUE)
  for (sheet in names(professional_tables_excel)) {
    data <- as.data.frame(professional_tables_excel[[sheet]])
    # Formula/model metadata can contain list columns; flatten their text only.
    for (column in names(data)) {
      if (is.list(data[[column]])) data[[column]] <- vapply(data[[column]],
        function(x) paste(as.character(x), collapse = "; "), character(1))
      if (is.factor(data[[column]])) data[[column]] <- as.character(data[[column]])
      if (is.character(data[[column]])) data[[column]] <- enc2utf8(data[[column]])
    }
    openxlsx::addWorksheet(professional_wb, sheet)
    openxlsx::writeData(professional_wb, sheet, data, headerStyle = header_style,
                        withFilter = TRUE, keepNA = FALSE)
    openxlsx::freezePane(professional_wb, sheet, firstRow = TRUE)
    openxlsx::setColWidths(professional_wb, sheet, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = "auto")
  }
  dir.create(dirname(professional_excel_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(professional_wb, professional_excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  if (!file.exists(professional_excel_file) || file.info(professional_excel_file)$size <= 0) {
    stop("Statistical workbook was not created: ", professional_excel_file)
  }
  professional_export_qc$Status <- "Created and nonempty"
  message("Statistical tables and audits: ", professional_excel_file)
}
professional_export_qc
```

## Final three-grid metric map exports

The nine final BW/LWG, CH4, and CO2 maps reuse the plot objects and build
checks in Section 9.4.1. Each map is written once to its designated location.
The independent period all-pasture, period inside-RGP, and pooled whole-season
denominators remain distinct. Compact filenames and metric subfolders avoid
long Windows paths; the inventory retains the full metric and grid identifiers.
No files or old output directories are deleted.

```{r final-three-grid-map-package, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
required_metrics <- c("BW_LWG", "CH4", "CO2")
required_grids <- c("ALL_PASTURE_RGP", "INSIDE_RGP", "WHOLE_SEASON")
if (!exists("three_grid_metric_plot_objects"))
  stop("Run the three-grid metric map construction chunk before final map export.")
for (metric in required_metrics) {
  if (!metric %in% names(three_grid_metric_plot_objects))
    stop("Missing metric plot collection: ", metric)
  missing <- setdiff(required_grids, names(three_grid_metric_plot_objects[[metric]]))
  if (length(missing)) stop("Missing ", metric, " grid plots: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
}
final_map_root <- file.path(master_output_root, "01_Grazing_Behavior_Spatial_Aera",
                           "04_Maps", "Three_Grid_Metrics")
final_map_dirs <- list(
  BW_LWG = file.path(final_map_root, "01_LWG"),
  CH4 = file.path(final_map_root, "02_CH4"),
  CO2 = file.path(final_map_root, "03_CO2")
)
# A temporary output prevents a failed device from destroying an existing map.
# Publish a successfully written PNG; do not unlink previous analysis outputs.
save_map_png <- function(plot_object, filename, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  if (!isTRUE(export_results)) return(invisible(NULL))
  destination <- filename
  tryCatch({
    directory <- dirname(destination)
    dir.create(directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    if (!dir.exists(directory)) stop("Could not create PNG output directory: ", directory)
    directory <- normalizePath(directory, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
    destination <- file.path(directory, basename(filename))
    temporary_png <- tempfile("m_", tmpdir = directory, fileext = ".png")
    on.exit(if (file.exists(temporary_png)) unlink(temporary_png), add = TRUE)
    if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows" &&
        max(nchar(destination), nchar(temporary_png)) >= 260L) {
      stop("Destination or temporary PNG reaches the usual Windows 260-character limit (temporary path: ",
        nchar(temporary_png), " characters). Use a shorter project path or params$output_dir.")
    }
    device <- if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) ragg::agg_png else "png"
    export_error <- NULL
    tryCatch(ggplot2::ggsave(temporary_png, plot = plot_object, device = device,
      width = width, height = height, units = "in", dpi = dpi,
      bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE),
      error = function(e) {export_error <<- conditionMessage(e)})
    if (!is.null(export_error) && !is.character(device)) {
      message("ragg failed for ", basename(destination), "; trying the standard PNG device: ", export_error)
      ggplot2::ggsave(temporary_png, plot = plot_object, device = "png",
        width = width, height = height, units = "in", dpi = dpi,
        bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
    } else if (!is.null(export_error)) stop(export_error)
    bytes <- if (file.exists(temporary_png)) as.numeric(file.info(temporary_png)$size) else 0
    if (!is.finite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) stop("Map device did not create a nonempty PNG.")
    signature <- readBin(temporary_png, what = "raw", n = 8L)
    if (!identical(signature, as.raw(c(137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10))))
      stop("Map device did not create a PNG file.")
    if (!file.copy(temporary_png, destination, overwrite = TRUE))
      stop("Could not publish completed map.")
  }, error = function(e) {
    stop("Final map export failed: ", destination, " (", nchar(destination),
      " characters). ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
  })
  invisible(destination)
}
map_grid_file_tags <- c(ALL_PASTURE_RGP = "all_rgp", INSIDE_RGP = "inside_rgp",
                       WHOLE_SEASON = "season")

map_export_inventory <- list()
if (isTRUE(export_results)) {
  for (metric in required_metrics) {
    for (i in seq_along(required_grids)) {
      grid <- required_grids[i]
      filename <- file.path(final_map_dirs[[metric]],
        sprintf("%s_%02d_%s.png", metric, i, map_grid_file_tags[[grid]]))
      seasonal <- identical(grid, "WHOLE_SEASON")
      saved_file <- save_map_png(three_grid_metric_plot_objects[[metric]][[grid]],
        filename, width = if (seasonal) 12 else 16,
        height = if (seasonal) 8 else 10, dpi = 300)
      map_export_inventory[[paste(metric, grid, sep = "__")]] <- tibble::tibble(
        Metric = metric, Grid = grid, File = saved_file,
        Exists = file.exists(saved_file),
        Size_bytes = as.numeric(file.info(saved_file)$size),
        Path_length = nchar(saved_file))
    }
  }
  map_export_inventory <- dplyr::bind_rows(map_export_inventory)
  if (nrow(map_export_inventory) != 9L ||
      any(!map_export_inventory$Exists | !is.finite(map_export_inventory$Size_bytes) |
          map_export_inventory$Size_bytes <= 0))
    stop("The final inventory must contain nine successfully written PNG maps.")
  inventory_dir <- file.path(master_output_root, "01_Grazing_Behavior_Spatial_Aera", "01_Tables")
  dir.create(inventory_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  inventory_file <- file.path(inventory_dir, "Three_grid_BW_CH4_CO2_map_inventory.csv")
  tryCatch({
    if (!dir.exists(inventory_dir)) stop("Inventory directory could not be created.")
    readr::write_csv(map_export_inventory, inventory_file)
  }, error = function(e) stop("Final map inventory export failed: ", inventory_file,
    ". ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE))
  knitr::kable(map_export_inventory, caption = "Final BW/LWG, CH4, and CO2 three-grid map exports")
} else {
  map_export_inventory <- tibble::tibble(
    Metric = character(), Grid = character(), File = character(), Exists = logical(),
    Size_bytes = numeric(), Path_length = integer())
  message("Final map objects are available; export_results is FALSE so files were not written.")
}
```

## Final reproducibility and export inventory

This inventory lists files written or refreshed during the current run. Old
output folders and files are retained on disk and are not included solely
because they exist. The complete session record is saved once after all models,
tables, and maps have been processed.

```{r final-reproducibility-inventory, include=FALSE}
if (isTRUE(export_results)) {
  afri_log_dir <- file.path(master_output_root, "06_Statistical_Analysis", "06_Logs")
  dir.create(afri_log_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  capture.output(utils::sessionInfo(),
    file = file.path(afri_log_dir, "Complete_Analysis_Session_Info.txt"))
  afri_result_files <- list.files(master_output_root, full.names = TRUE,
                                   recursive = TRUE)
  afri_result_info <- file.info(afri_result_files)
  afri_current <- !is.na(afri_result_info$mtime) & !afri_result_info$isdir &
    afri_result_info$mtime >= afri_run_started - 1
  afri_result_files <- afri_result_files[afri_current]
  afri_result_info <- afri_result_info[afri_current, , drop = FALSE]
  root_path <- normalizePath(master_output_root, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  final_export_inventory <- tibble::tibble(
    File = substring(normalizePath(afri_result_files, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE),
                     nchar(root_path) + 2L),
    Size_bytes = as.numeric(afri_result_info$size),
    Modified = as.character(afri_result_info$mtime)
  ) %>% dplyr::filter(!grepl("Final_Export_Inventory.csv$", File))
  readr::write_csv(final_export_inventory,
    file.path(afri_log_dir, "Final_Export_Inventory.csv"))
}
```
